title: Validation Engineer
description:
Posha builds cooking robots that live inside your kitchen and cook food for you completely autonomously. Posha robots use Artificial Intelligence enabled Computer Vision to consistently and reliably cook the best food for our users 🥘

See it in action: https://bit.ly/howposhaworks

Posha is backed by Tier-1 VCs 💙. These include Accel Partners, Waterbridge Ventures and a clutch of ambitious founders including Binny Bansal (Flipkart), Samay Kohli (Grey Orange Robotics)

**What can I expect from this role? 🤔**

* You'll be Posha’s first dedicated validation hire. Today, validation is performed informally by engineers and technicians alongside their regular design work - there is no independent validation function. You're being brought in to build that function from the ground up.
* This is an individual contributor role to start, working hands-on and coordinating technicians to execute tests. As you demonstrate ownership, judgement and results, there's a clear path to growing into a Validation Manager building out a team under you.
* Location is Bengaluru, and this is a work-from-office role - no remote or hybrid option.

**What will my work responsibilities look like if I join Posha?🔧**

* Translate product and system requirements into a formal Design Validation Plan (DVP) and Product Validation Plan (PVP) spanning mechanical, electrical and firmware/system-level behavior.
* Define test requirements, test specifications and pass/fail criteria for each requirement.
* Write test procedures and execute verification and validation testing across the product.
* Direct technicians to build test setups and test rigs needed to run these tests.
* Where a test needs external lab support ; compliance, environmental, reliability chambers and the like - own that engagement end-to-end: scoping, scheduling and interpreting results.
* Build validation processes, documentation and tooling essentially from zero, replacing today's informal "kitchen validation" approach with something rigorous and repeatable.
* Own the product development lifecycle from a product quality perspective end-to-end, not just execute tests handed down to you.
* Identify and source product/system requirements proactively, including going and finding them when they aren't already handed to you.
* Participate in DFMEA activities and build test plans driven by the risks identified there, combined with available specification sheets.
* Where spec sheets or formal requirements don't exist, develop reasonable estimates and theoretical justification to back the validation and verification approach rather than stalling for a spec.
* Define acceptance test protocols for incoming components and subassemblies.
* Root-cause test failures and work closely with design engineers to close the loop.
* Maintain a requirements-to-test-case-to-results traceability matrix.
* Set up systematic data logging and reporting for test results.
* Good at instrumentation and equipment for measurement

**What makes you a match for us? 😍**

* Experience can range anywhere from about 3 to 6 years - what matters far more than years on paper is the right approach: rigour, coverage-mindedness and a genuine drive to protect product quality.
* Background in consumer hardware or appliances is useful but not required. We're equally open to adjacent domains ; automotive, industrial, medical devices, electronics manufacturing and similar.
* Comfortable defining test methodology from a blank page, not just executing an existing plan handed to you.
* Able to manage technicians and external lab or vendor relationships to get tests done on time.
* Good to have: familiarity with compliance and certification processes such as UL and FCC.

**Working at Posha🚀**

* What users have to say about our Product
* Twitter love from users
* How does Posha cook
* Our Website
* Read Our Story 📕

**Why Posha?**

* Attractive Compensation, ESOPS, Personalized L&D budgets are some benefits that we offer - but these are par for the course. We go beyond this.
* We believe that Posha is a generational company with the opportunity to alter the trajectory of how food is cooked inside homes today. This opportunity is parallel to how autonomous cars have started making an impact.
* The Validation Engineer / Manager role will be at the forefront of this opportunity, standing up a function that doesn't exist yet and setting the bar for product quality as we scale toward production.

title: AI Reliability Operations Engineer
company: Acara Solutions India, An Aleron Company
description:
**OPPORTUNITY OVERVIEW**

An external threat mitigation cybersecurity company protects organizations from external threats across the public, deep, and dark web. Now we're redesigning how this external threat mitigation cybersecurity company itself works, using AI, and we're doing it alongside the executives who run the company. Teams across the external threat mitigation cybersecurity company already run AI agents and workflows as part of their daily work.

As an AI Reliability Operations Engineer, you own how well those AI solutions work, and you make them better every week, not just keep them running. You run the evaluations that show whether an agent still does its job after a change, find failures early, and turn each one into a test so it stays fixed. You also give business teams the tools to run and tune their own solutions, and you keep the shared AI platforms underneath them healthy.

**You're someone who:**

* Fixes things before being asked. When you see a weak result or a slow process, you improve it.
* Uses AI on everything, including your own work: evals, scripts, runbooks, and incident notes.
* Treats each solution you look after like your own product: you know how it performs and you push to make it better.

You'll work closely with our AI engineers in the US and with the business teams who use what we build. This role is for someone who wants to get very good at making AI systems reliable, and to see that work show up in how the company runs.

**Role and responsibilities**

* Own evaluation for every agent, prompt, and model change: run the suites and report results against agreed quality standards.
* Improve the test datasets every week, turning each real failure into a new test case.
* Find regressions, back them with clear evidence, and drive each one to a fix with the right people.
* Keep business teams' AI solutions working: catch drift in output, and fix failed runs, broken integrations, and expired access.
* Build tools that let business teams run and adjust their own solutions, such as dashboards, alerts, and simple ways to change settings.
* Fix breakage yourself, and own changes to how a solution behaves, working closely with the department that uses it and the US team.
* Hold every solution you take on to a complete handoff pack: a runbook, evals, and a named department owner.
* Own the runbooks for every solution and platform you work on, and keep them current.
* Own the health of the shared AI platforms: respond to alerts and incidents, and pull in the right people quickly when an issue needs them.
* Own deploys, environment setup, access requests, and configuration changes, following the approved change process.
* Keep tracing, logging, and dashboards current, so anyone can see what an agent did in production.
* Track and report platform cost and usage.
* Automate repeat operational tasks, using AI wherever it speeds up the work.

**Required qualifications and skills**

* 3+ years in production support, QA or test engineering, data-quality work, or cloud operations.
* Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and how their output varies.
* Experience with testing, evaluation, or data-quality work, including building or running test sets.
* Working skill in Python or TypeScript.
* Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), including identity and access, CI/CD (continuous integration and delivery pipelines), and monitoring.
* Calm incident handling and clear written escalation.
* Clear written English for runbooks, incident notes, and change notes.
* Good judgment about access and data sensitivity.
* Evidence of initiative and AI fluency: tools, tests, or automations you built without being asked, and daily hands-on use of AI tools in your own work.

**Desired qualifications and skills**

* Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and LLM-as-judge scoring (using one model to grade another model's output).
* Experience with managed agent runtimes on AWS, such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
* Experience with observability and tracing tools for LLM or agent systems.
* Experience with modern web hosting and deployment platforms, such as Vercel.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code.
* Experience supporting internal business users, or on a support or on-call rotation.
* Experience at a security company, or with security-sensitive systems.

**Brief Description**
**Job Title: Medior Manual Test Analyst**

**About Resillion**
Resillion is a global provider of digital assurance, cybersecurity, and testing services. We help organisations strengthen their security posture, protect critical assets, and deliver high-quality digital solutions. Our teams operate across multiple specialist disciplines, including Digital Forensics, Incident Response, SOC Operations, Quality & Compliance, and Technical Consultancy. We are committed to excellence, continuous improvement, and delivering trusted, customer-focused services that meet the highest professional and accreditation standards.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Medior Manual Test Analyst with 3–4 years of software testing experience, strong hands-on manual testing skills and exposure to test automation.
  
  
The role combines independent ownership of assigned manual testing activities with day-to-day client communication, including requirement clarification, progress updates and proactive reporting of defects, blockers and risks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse business requirements and clarify acceptance criteria directly with clients, business analysts and developers.
* Independently plan assigned testing activities, estimate effort and prioritise coverage based on business impact and risk.
* Design and maintain test scenarios, test cases and test data covering business workflows, edge cases and negative scenarios.
* Execute manual functional, integration, system, regression, smoke and exploratory testing, recording clear results and evidence.
* Identify, reproduce and track defects with clear steps and supporting evidence; retest fixes and verify closure.
* Work with developers and business analysts to investigate issues, explain business impact and agree defect priorities.
* Manage day-to-day client communication on testing, lead testing status discussions and follow up on queries and agreed actions.
* Provide concise client updates on test progress, coverage, defects and risks, explaining technical issues in clear business terms.
* Proactively flag blockers, requirement gaps and delivery risks, agree next steps with stakeholders and escalate when needed.


+ Participate in Agile ceremonies and defect triage discussions, coordinating testing priorities and dependencies with the team
+ Maintain test documentation and prepare test summaries highlighting outstanding defects and remaining risks to support release decisions.
+ Support existing automation by running suites and maintaining basic scripts where required, while keeping manual testing as the primary focus.
+ Identify practical improvements to test coverage, defect prevention and day-to-day testing processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–4 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.
* Strong practical experience in manual testing.
* 1–2 years of automation testing experience.
* Sound understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Strong knowledge of designing and executing test cases and managing defects.
* Hands-on experience with functional, regression, integration, smoke and exploratory testing.
* Experience with defect and test management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent.
* Familiarity with automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress or equivalent is an advantage.
* Sound understanding of development in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting and communication abilities.
* Ability to work effectively with development and product teams.

**Why Join Us?**
At Resillion, you'll have the opportunity to work on large-scale digital transformation programmes and enterprise SAP implementations. You'll collaborate with highly skilled professionals, utilise industry-leading automation tools, and help deliver high-quality solutions that enable our customers to achieve their business goals.

description:
**About Revantage**
Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.
  
  
With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.
  
  
Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.
  
  
In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.
  
  
**India**
With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.
  
  
Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly
**Build What Matters.**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester for , a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.
  
  
The QA Tester is responsible for the design, execution and documentation of testing across Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and the integrations, interfaces, reports and business processes that surround it. The role supports both the in-flight Oracle implementation – including system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data conversion validation and cutover readiness – and the ongoing steady-state testing that follows go-live, including enhancement testing, defect regression and validation of Oracle’s quarterly release updates. The QA Tester partners closely with US-based IT leadership, functional and technical analysts, system integration partners and business process owners to ensure that changes to the Oracle ecosystem are delivered accurately, are thoroughly documented and do not disrupt downstream finance and operations processes.
  
  
**Primary Role – Quality Assurance Testing: Oracle Fusion and Integrated Systems**

* Develop, maintain and execute test cases, test scripts and test scenarios for Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, based on functional design documents, configuration workbooks and business requirements.
* Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, as assigned by the QA Lead.
* Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, validating that business processes function correctly from source system, through Oracle, and out to downstream consumers.
* Test inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Fusion and property management, banking, treasury, payroll, procurement and reporting systems, including file-based interfaces, APIs and Oracle Integration Cloud flows; validate payload accuracy, error handling, reprocessing and exception reporting.
* Validate data conversion and migration activities, including reconciliation of converted balances, master data and historical transactions between legacy systems and Oracle.
* Test reports, dashboards and analytics developed in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio and Fusion Data Intelligence, reconciling output to source data and confirming correct parameters, security and formatting.
* Support user acceptance testing, including preparation of business-facing test scripts, coordination of tester schedules, hands-on support to business users during execution, and tracking of UAT results through to closure.
* Plan and execute regression testing for Oracle’s quarterly release updates, assessing the impact of new features and patches on existing configurations, integrations, reports and extensions.
* Log, triage, document and track defects through resolution in the program’s defect management tool, including clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence and appropriate severity and priority classification, and partner with functional and technical teams on root cause analysis and retest.
* Maintain the test case repository, requirements traceability matrices and test evidence to ensure complete coverage of requirements and to satisfy internal control, audit and SOX documentation standards.
* Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites where automation adds value, and maintain those assets as configurations and business processes change.
* Prepare and maintain test data sets across development, test and staging environments, coordinating environment readiness and refreshes with the technical team.
* Provide accurate daily updates on test execution progress, blockers and open defects to leadership.
* Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify testability gaps, ambiguous requirements and delivery risks early in the lifecycle.Validate security roles, user provisioning and segregation of duties configurations as part of testing cycles.
* Support cutover and post-go-live validation activities, including production smoke testing, hypercare defect triage and verification of fixes in the production environment.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA standards, templates, testing methodology and automation coverage across the Oracle program.
* Must be able to work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with a shift aligned to US Central Time and available until 11:00 AM CT Flexibility is expected during testing cycles, cutover events, quarterly update windows and other peak periods.
* daily.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, accounting or a related field is required.

Minimum of three years of software quality assurance and testing experience, including at least one year testing enterprise ERP applications, is required.
  
  

* Must have hands-on testing experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is required; coverage across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management or Procurement is preferred.
* Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing and cutover, is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience testing system integrations and interfaces, including file-based feeds, web services and APIs, and middleware such as Oracle Integration Cloud, is required.
* Experience validating reports and data in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio or Fusion Data Intelligence is preferred.
* Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to independently query and reconcile data between source systems and Oracle is preferred.
* Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Oracle Test Automation, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium or similar, is preferred; a willingness to develop and expand automation capability is required.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest or similar is required.
* Familiarity with Oracle’s quarterly update cycle and the associated regression testing approach is preferred.
* Working understanding of core finance and accounting processes, including record to report, procure to pay and order to cash, sufficient to test business scenarios meaningfully; real estate, property management or student housing experience is an advantage.
* Familiarity with SOX and IT general control requirements as they relate to testing documentation and evidence retention is preferred.
* ISTQB certification or an equivalent quality assurance credential would be a plus .
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the discipline to document findings clearly and completely.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain defects, test results and risks clearly to onshore technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent testing priorities against fixed delivery deadlines and to work independently with limited onshore supervision.
* Demonstrates a positive attitude and maintains a high level of professionalism when working with onshore stakeholders and leadership across time zones.

'

* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

title: System Test Engineer
description:
**Your Job**
This role focuses on validating embedded automotive systems through comprehensive system and system integration testing. The engineer is responsible for creating test strategies, developing and executing manual and automated test cases, analyzing results, and reporting defects. The position requires expertise in automotive communication protocols such as CAN and LIN, test automation using CAPL and Python, and compliance with ASPICE and V-Model processes. Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills are essential to ensure product quality and reliability.
  
  
**Our Team**
The System Test Team is responsible for ensuring that automotive embedded systems meet customer requirements, functional expectations, and quality standards. The team develops and executes system and integration test cases, validates hardware and software interactions, and identifies defects through manual and automated testing. Working closely with development, requirements, and project teams, they ensure compliance with automotive standards such as ASPICE and support the delivery of reliable, safe, and high-quality products
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Review of system test requirements
* Define and execute System and System Integration Test cases based on System Requirement for embedded automotive systems.
* Prepare system test plan/strategy/test cases, execute the test cases (manual/automation), analyze, and submit the test reports.
* Review and update of test scripts as necessary.
* Execute, Analyze and review the test results and report issues.
* Create test automation concepts based on defined test strategy.
* Documentation, pre-analysis, and reporting of test results
* Setup and maintain traceability in compliance with Automotive SPICE

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelors or master’s in Engineering in the field of Electrical / Electronics & Communications Engineering or Computer science or equivalent
* Good understanding of embedded Systems (electronics and software)
* Good understanding of automotive communication protocols such as CAN and LIN
* Experience with tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, and other CAN-based tools
* Good understanding and expertise on black- and grey box system testing (Functional/Nonfunctional/Safety/Performance)
* Strong expertise in black-box and grey-box system testing (functional, non-functional, safety, and performance)
* Good knowledge of automotive processes, including V-Model, ASPICE, and Agile methodologies
* Experience in system testing of features like CAN, UDS, Power Module, USB, NFC, Thermal, SIT, Software Update, WCH, and functional safety-related system requirements.
* Experience in developing CAPL, Python-based test automation scenarios, and scripts using Robot Framework.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* ISTQB certification or similar
* Knowledge of wireless charging technology, Qi standards, or automotive USB applications is beneficial.
* Proficiency with tools such as Polarion, DOORS, Git, and SVN.

If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.*

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.
  
  
Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

**About The Role**
Position Title : KYC QA Analyst
  
  
Corporate Title: Senior Analyst
  
  
Reporting to : Assistant Vice President
  
  
Location : Bengaluru
  
  
**Job Profile**
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Review and adherence of KYC Policy, Operating Manual, QA Workbooks, and any other Process documentation.
* Discuss with the KYC MO and identify a representative sample of customers for review.
* Review the sampled customers for the characteristics outlined in the KYC QA workbook.
* KYC QA workbook needs to be completed for KYC review.
* QA reviewer needs to opine on the Accuracy, Completeness, and Timeliness aspect of each review criteria for the sampled customers.
* Any variances observed should be documented and shared with the KYC MO.
* A summary of the variances along with recommendations should be shared with the KYC MO.
* QA reviewer to discuss the variances with the process owner.
* Any variances remediated by the Bank should be revalidated by the QA reviewer and closed if it is addressed satisfactorily. Variances that require significant time to remediate will be included in the next quarterly review.
* Summarize the QA results and work with the Bank to develop a plan to address the Exceptions/Errors/Recommendations
* Assign each of the variances into different themes by customer type.
* For each of the QA themes document the recommendations to address the variances
* Classify the impact of each recommendation as “Improving the quality” or “Improving the efficiency”.
* Compare the current quarter results with the previous quarter to assess the impact of the recommendations

title: System Test Engineer
description:
BTL India is looking for a
**System Test Engineer**
to verify product-level requirements and ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of embedded products throughout the product development lifecycle. The role focuses on system-level functional testing, requirement-based test design, risk-informed test coverage, and effective defect management. Experience in the medical device or healthcare domain is preferred, but not mandatory.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As part of the medical product testing team, you will plan, identify, and execute system-level testing activities in an embedded product development environment to meet project goals through the following actions:

* Understand the complete product development lifecycle and the product’s intended use, features, operating modes, and system behavior.
* Review and analyze product requirements and software requirements to identify test conditions, expected results, and acceptance criteria.
* Design, review, execute, and maintain clear, robust test cases for system-level and functional verification.
* Apply black-box test design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary-value analysis, decision-table testing, and state-transition testing where appropriate.
* Understand the risk management process and use product risks, hazardous situations, risk controls, and risk-control verification needs to guide test-case design and test coverage.
* Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements, risks/risk controls where applicable, test cases, and test results using a test management tool.
* Plan and execute system-level, functional, and integration tests; document results and report deviations clearly.
* Manage defects through the defect lifecycle, collaborate with developers and cross-functional teams on investigation, and verify fixes.
* Identify test coverage gaps, challenge the design through effective test scenarios, and contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes.
* Follow applicable safety, quality, and regulatory processes and support project delivery milestones.

**ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**QUALIFICATION:**

* Engineering degree or above in Electrical & Electronics (EEE), Electronics & Communication (ECE), Biomedical Engineering, Bioelectronics, or equivalent.

**TECHNICAL COMPETENCY: (ESSENTIALS)**

* 4–5 years of professional experience in system testing of embedded products.
* Practical experience in requirement analysis, test-case design, test execution, defect reporting, and test closure.
* Good understanding of product development and structured verification processes.
* Working knowledge of risk-based testing and the ability to translate identified risks and risk controls into suitable verification scenarios.
* Strong understanding of black-box test design techniques and test coverage principles.
* Experience with Jira or an equivalent defect-tracking tool.

**ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE (DESIRABLES)**

* Experience in medical device/healthcare domain and familiarity with medical industry standards is highly preferred but not mandatory.
* Experience using Test management tools such as Codebeamer or Doors for requirement traceability.
* Working knowledge of agile development methodologies.
* Basic exposure to scripting or test automation (e.g. Python) for embedded environments.

* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Collaborate effectively with Developers, Test Engineers, Product Owners/Product Managers, and DevOps Engineers to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle.
* Participate in defect triage and communicate quality risks, dependencies, blockers, and release-readiness concerns clearly to stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the team's testing processes, automation architecture, coding standards, and overall quality engineering practices.
* Use modern AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to improve engineering productivity while following appropriate code-review, security, and quality practices.
* Mentor and support other test engineers by sharing automation and quality engineering best practices.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7+ years of professional experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering, including significant hands-on experience in automation.
* Strong expertise in Test Automation and automation framework development.
* Strong hands-on experience with Selenium and/or Playwright.
* Strong programming/scripting skills in at least one of the following:

+ Python
+ TypeScript
+ Java

* Strong experience in Functional Testing, including requirements analysis, test design, test execution, defect identification, and regression testing.
* Experience designing and documenting a comprehensive Test Strategy for a product, application, release, or major feature.
* Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, and Scrum practices.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams and delivering quality software across multiple sprints/releases.
* Hands-on experience with Git and GitHub for source-control and collaborative development.
* Experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD solutions for automated test execution.
* Exposure to GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted software engineering/testing tools.
* Ability to analyze automation failures and debug issues across application, automation, API, test-data, and environment layers.
* Good understanding of test design techniques, defect lifecycle, regression strategy, risk-based testing, and test coverage.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Development, QA, Product, and DevOps teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical issues and quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with API testing and API automation, for example REST APIs.
* Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of modern automation patterns such as Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable test components, test-data management, and parallel execution.
* Experience with test reporting and automated quality metrics.
* Exposure to testing applications deployed using cloud and containerized environments.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for test-case generation, automation-code development, code review, debugging, or test analysis.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers or providing technical guidance on test automation.
* Familiarity with non-functional quality considerations such as performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and usability testing would be an advantage.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline from a recognised institution.

**What We Are Looking For**
The successful candidate should be a
**hands-on Senior Test Engineer**
, not someone focused only on test coordination or management. We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Can write automation code, not just execute automated suites.

title: Lead WLAN Test Engineer
description:
**Lead WLAN Test Engineer**

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Experience:**
8–12 years

**About the Company**

Rohde & Schwarz is a telecommunications company working to ensure a safer and connected world. Its business is organized around Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks. Across these divisions, the company develops solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers facing technology and connectivity challenges. This work places testing, communications, and dependable technical systems at the center of the company’s business. Rohde & Schwarz states that it stands for independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners. These commitments reflect an emphasis on sustained customer and partner engagement alongside its work in technology markets. The company’s activities span multiple areas where reliable connectivity and technical performance matter, from measurement and communications to infrastructure and networks. The Bengaluru-based engineering opportunity supports its work in wireless testing and validation within the telecommunications domain, contributing to the development and assessment of WLAN technologies. Rohde & Schwarz operates under its own name and brings together its divisions to address complex connectivity needs across the sectors it serves.

**About the Role**

As a full-time, on-site WLAN Test Engineer in Bengaluru, you will lead wireless test strategy and validation in a telecommunications engineering environment. You will develop test plans, build Python-based automation, and assess Wi-Fi performance and RF behavior against relevant 802.11 standards. The role combines hands-on network and protocol testing with analysis, troubleshooting, and clear documentation of test procedures and findings. You will work with engineering teams to investigate defects and resolve wireless connectivity issues, while mentoring junior test engineers and strengthening test execution. This position suits an experienced engineer with a background in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing who can take ownership of test quality and help deliver reliable wireless systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead WLAN test strategy development and translate product and validation needs into effective test coverage. Align test priorities with engineering objectives and relevant wireless standards.
* Design wireless test plans covering Wi-Fi performance, network behavior, protocols, and RF system validation. Define test scenarios and procedures that support consistent, repeatable execution.
* Build and maintain Python test automation frameworks for WLAN validation. Use automation to improve test execution and support reliable assessment of wireless system behavior.
* Execute Wi-Fi performance, network, protocol, and RF tests against applicable 802.11 standards. Record outcomes and identify defects or unexpected system behavior.
* Analyze test results and defects, troubleshoot wireless connectivity issues, and support engineering teams in investigating root causes. Communicate findings clearly to enable resolution.
* Document test procedures, execution details, and findings to maintain useful validation records. Share relevant results and technical observations with engineering stakeholders.
* Collaborate with engineering teams throughout test planning and execution, and mentor junior test engineers. Support effective knowledge sharing and consistent testing practices.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Strong WLAN and Wi-Fi testing capability, including practical wireless validation experience. Apply relevant 802.11 standards when planning and assessing test coverage.
* Experience with radio frequency testing and RF system behavior. Evaluate wireless performance and interpret results in the context of system validation.
* Python programming skills for building test automation frameworks. Develop automation that supports structured, repeatable WLAN test execution.
* Knowledge of network testing and protocol testing for wireless systems. Design and execute test scenarios that assess connectivity and protocol behavior.
* Test planning and test execution skills, including designing wireless test plans and carrying them through to documented results. Maintain clarity and consistency across validation activities.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for investigating wireless connectivity issues, reviewing test results, and assessing defects. Explain findings to support engineering resolution.
* Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Relevant specialization in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience across telecommunications, telecom or ISP environments, or computers and electronics manufacturing can provide useful context for wireless product validation.
* Background in mentoring junior test engineers and collaborating with engineering teams can support effective knowledge sharing and coordinated defect investigation.

**What You'll Bring**

* Eight to twelve years of relevant experience in WLAN, wireless communications, or RF testing, with the ability to take ownership of test strategy and validation outcomes.
* A Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering, complemented by relevant wireless or RF specialization.
* Practical strength in Python automation, 802.11 standards, network and protocol testing, test planning, execution, and defect analysis.
* Professional English communication skills, sound documentation habits, and the ability to work on-site in Bengaluru while collaborating with engineering teams and mentoring junior colleagues.

**Why Join Us**

Join Rohde & Schwarz and contribute to work that supports a safer, connected world. The company operates across Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks, developing solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers with technology and connectivity challenges. In this engineering role, your work will focus on WLAN strategy, Wi-Fi performance testing, RF validation, and Python test automation. You will help turn test requirements into structured plans, investigate connectivity issues, and communicate findings that engineering teams can act on. The opportunity brings together hands-on wireless testing and technical leadership through collaboration and mentorship. Rohde & Schwarz identifies independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners as company values. You can apply your experience in a telecommunications environment where connectivity and dependable technical systems are central to the work. The position is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru, with scope to contribute directly to wireless validation and improve the quality and consistency of testing practices.

**What We Offer**

* A full-time, on-site engineering opportunity in Bengaluru, focused on WLAN validation, Wi-Fi performance, RF behavior, and test automation.
* Ownership of WLAN test strategy and plans, with practical scope to execute testing, analyze defects, and collaborate with engineering teams.
* The opportunity to contribute to telecommunications work supporting Rohde & Schwarz’s broader focus on connectivity and technology challenges.

title: Lead/Staff AI/ML Validation Engineer
description:
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
**Together, we advance your career.**
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**SMTS Software Quality Engineer**
to join the
**HIP Runtime Quality Engineering**
team within the ROCm ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on
**defect triage, root‑cause analysis, and scalable test automation**
for the HIP runtime, ensuring robustness, portability, and performance across AMD and NVIDIA GPU backends.
  
  
The role sits at the intersection of
**runtime systems, GPU APIs, and CI-driven quality assurance**
, working closely with HIP runtime developers, compiler teams, and system software engineers to improve test coverage and accelerate issue resolution across a fast-evolving open‑source stack.
  
  
HIP is a C++ runtime API and kernel language designed for CUDA portability and heterogeneous GPU programming in the ROCm platform.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis
  
  

* Own end-to-end triage of HIP runtime failures observed in CI, nightly, and release testing pipelines.
* Analyze failures across HIP runtime APIs, including memory management, streams, events, kernels, graphs, and device management.
* Perform log analysis, repro reduction, and backtrace debugging across Linux and Windows environments.
* Correlate failures across:

+ ROCr system runtime
+ HIP runtime
+ Driver / firmware interfaces
+ Compiler (hipcc / clang) interactions

* File high‑quality bug reports with clear reproduction steps, root cause hypotheses, and impact assessment.

Test Automation & Framework Development
  
  

* Design, enhance, and maintain automated test frameworks for HIP runtime validation using existing HIP test infrastructure (Catch2-based and custom harnesses).
* Expand functional, negative, stress, and regression coverage for:

+ HIP Runtime APIs
+ Graph APIs
+ Memory copy variants (1D/2D/3D, async/sync)
+ Multi-GPU and peer-to-peer use cases

* Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines with actionable failure reporting.
* Develop Python, C++, and shell-based automation for test execution, result aggregation, and trend analysis.
* Drive test flakiness reduction and improve signal-to-noise ratio in large-scale CI.

Cross-Team Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with HIP runtime developers to:

+ Review test gaps for new features and APIs
+ Validate bug fixes and performance-sensitive code paths

* Collaborate with:

+ Compiler and language runtime teams
+ ROCr system runtime teams
+ Release engineering and CI infrastructure teams

* Contribute test fixes and enhancements upstream in open-source HIP/ROCm repositories.

Quality Metrics & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Define and track quality metrics such as failure escape rate, test coverage, and mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR).
* Identify systemic issues and propose data-driven quality improvements.
* Participate in release readiness assessments for HIP runtime drops.

**Required Qualifications**
Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles.
* Solid proficiency in C++ with debugging experience (gdb/lldb).
* Working knowledge of HIP or CUDA runtime concepts, including kernels, streams, memory models, and device execution.
* Experience with Linux-based development and debugging.
* Familiarity with CI systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for low-level systems or runtime libraries.

Debugging & Analysis Skills
  
  

* Ability to reason about runtime abstractions, concurrency, and asynchronous execution.
* Strong skills in failure reproduction, minimization, and log-driven debugging.
* Experience triaging issues across hardware–software boundaries is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GPU programming models (HIP, CUDA, OpenCL).
* Familiarity with ROCm stack components (HIP, ROCr, compilers, drivers).
* Experience testing graph APIs, async execution models, or multi-GPU systems.
* Prior contributions to open-source system software or test frameworks.
* Knowledge of Python-based test orchestration and reporting tools.
* Knowledge and application of AI tools in validation and testing.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Faster, higher-quality issue triage with actionable root cause insights.
* Improved automation coverage for HIP runtime APIs and edge cases.
* Reduced CI noise and faster feedback for developers.
* Strong collaboration with runtime and compiler engineers to ship stable, high-quality HIP releases.

title: Senior QA Engineer - Vehicle Networks and Telematics
description:
**Netradyne**
harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
  
  
**Senior QA Engineer - Vehicle Networks and Telematics**
**Role Overview**
As a Senior QA Engineer in the CAN QA team, you will own validation of how our devices read, interpret and report vehicle data, from the CAN bus through the device to the cloud. You will develop test strategies for J1939 and OBD-II integrations, automate protocol and signal-level testing, investigate complex field issues, and provide evidence-based release-readiness recommendations.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone equally at home with a CAN trace, a bench power supply and a truck cab, and who can convert requirements, DBCs, logs and field evidence into reliable qualification coverage.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Validation strategy and release qualification for CAN-based vehicle features, new vehicle onboarding and customer configurations.
* Requirement-to-test coverage for vehicle signals, diagnostics, power modes and end-to-end telematics workflows.
* Root-cause investigation of signal mismatches, intermittent CAN failures and vehicle-specific field issues.
* Reusable CAN simulation, trace replay, fault-injection and automated regression capabilities.
* Technical guidance through test-design reviews, automation reviews and structured defect triage.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Vehicle Networks and Diagnostics**

* Validate SAE J1939 PGN/SPN decoding for vehicle speed, odometer, engine hours, fuel, DM1/DM2 faults and other supported signals.
* Validate OBD-II modes, PIDs, DTCs and VIN handling using SAE J1979 and ISO 15765-4.
* Verify scaling, offsets, units, ranges, rollover, timeouts, stale data, source-address handling and not-available values.
* Test J1939 transport protocol (BAM and RTS/CTS), request messages, address claim and bus-off recovery.
* Correlate device-decoded values with trusted CAN tools and OEM or dealer diagnostic systems.

**Power Modes and CAN Wake-up**

* Validate wake-up on CAN traffic and ignition, sleep after bus silence, shutdown and recovery across supported configurations.
* Measure quiescent current and verify that the device causes no unwanted wake-ups, excessive bus traffic or vehicle battery drain.
* Validate ignition (KL15) and battery (KL30) scenarios, brownouts, power interruptions and repeated ignition cycles.

**Bench, HIL and Vehicle Testing**

* Set up and execute bench, HIL and in-vehicle tests using CAN interfaces, programmable power supplies, ignition control and harnesses.
* Simulate ECUs, replay recorded traces, inject protocol and signal faults, and reproduce field scenarios in the lab.
* Validate integrations across commercial and passenger vehicles, makes, models and model years, including in fleet yards and at customer sites.

**End-to-End Feature Validation**

* Validate CAN-derived data from vehicle bus to cloud for fleet features such as fuel consumption, fuel-level trends, idle fuel, refueling and suspected fuel theft.
* Validate CAN-derived inputs supporting ELD/HOS workflows, including engine power state, vehicle motion, distance, engine hours and malfunction scenarios, against product requirements and the FMCSA ELD rule.
* Support validation of EV signals (state of charge, charging state, energy usage) and OTA/firmware regression for vehicle-specific releases.

**Test Design, Automation and Debugging**

* Translate product requirements, protocol specifications, DBC files and field use cases into risk-based, traceable test plans.
* Build maintainable Python, CAPL or equivalent automation for CAN simulation, trace replay, signal verification, negative testing and regression.
* Analyze CAN traces, device and application logs, power measurements and cloud telemetry to isolate failures across the vehicle, harness, firmware, configuration and cloud layers.
* Create clear defect reports with reproducible steps, trace evidence, expected versus actual behavior and impact.
* Work with development teams to close gaps in testability, diagnostics and observability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in QA or validation of embedded, automotive, telematics or IoT products, with substantial hands-on CAN work and a track record of owning test strategy, traceability and release-readiness decisions.
* Strong CAN 2.0A/B fundamentals, including 11-bit and 29-bit identifiers, arbitration, error handling and bus-off behavior.
* Hands-on expertise in SAE J1939, with working knowledge of OBD-II.
* Experience interpreting DBC files and validating raw frames, decoded signals, scaling, timing and invalid-data behavior.
* Hands-on experience with one or more CAN analysis and simulation platforms, such as Vector CANalyzer/CANoe, Intrepid Vehicle Spy, PEAK PCAN or Kvaser, and scripting in Python, CAPL or an equivalent language.
* Strong embedded-system debugging and root-cause analysis skills across hardware, firmware, network and backend boundaries, with the ability to explain technical risks and evidence clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of CAN wake-up and sleep behavior, ignition concepts, power-state transitions and sleep-current measurement.
* Comfort working with vehicle harnesses, multimeters, programmable power supplies and bench equipment.
* Working knowledge of UDS (ISO 14229) and ISO-TP, including diagnostic sessions, reading and clearing DTCs, and reading data identifiers.
* Awareness of CAN FD and experience with HIL systems or ECU/network simulation.
* Exposure to J1708/J1587 on older heavy-duty vehicles.
* Python experience with libraries and frameworks such as python-can and pytest, including data-driven and parameterized testing.
* Experience with Linux-based environments, SocketCAN and can-utils (candump, cansend), shell tools, log analysis, Git and code-review workflows.
* Experience in fuel management, ELD/HOS (FMCSA), vehicle diagnostics, EV telemetry or other CAN-based fleet features.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for test design, log triage or trace analysis.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence and CI-based automated testing for traceability, defect management and qualification reporting.

title: Systems Testing Building Management  system (Fire / Life  /Smoke)
description:
**Building Management Systems | Product Qualification | UL 864 Readiness**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced System Integration HW & SW Test Engineer to qualify Building Management System (BMS) products and solutions, with a particular focus on system-level testing and UL 864 certification readiness.

The role combines hands-on hardware and software testing with the design and development of physical system test environments. The successful candidate will build representative BMS test systems, integrate hardware and software components, develop structured test suites, and execute system-level qualification testing.

A key responsibility will be preparing products and systems for UL 864 certification through comprehensive pre-certification testing, as well as executing applicable self-certification and internal qualification testing.

The engineer will work closely with software development, hardware development, system engineering, product management, and certification specialists to identify issues early and ensure that products meet functional, system, and certification requirements.

The role will initially have a strong focus on establishing the test environment and performing hands-on testing. Over time, the engineer will develop repeatable test suites and identify opportunities for test automation, either implementing automation directly or working together with test automation and software development colleagues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, configure, and maintain physical system integration test environments for BMS products and solutions.
* Integrate hardware, software, controllers, networks, field devices, and other required system components into representative test configurations.
* Perform HW/SW system integration testing to verify functionality, interoperability, stability, and expected system behavior.
* Develop and maintain structured system-level test plans, test cases, and reusable test suites.
* Perform pre-certification testing to identify issues before formal UL 864 certification activities.
* Execute applicable self-certification, qualification, and compliance test activities.
* Interpret UL 864 requirements and translate relevant requirements into practical system test scenarios and test cases.
* Reproduce, analyze, document, and communicate defects discovered during system testing.
* Work closely with software and hardware development teams to support root-cause investigation and verification of corrections.
* Maintain test configurations and ensure that test setups are repeatable and representative of intended product configurations.
* Document test results and provide clear evidence of system behavior and compliance.
* Identify opportunities for test automation and develop test cases with automation in mind.
* Automate suitable system tests directly or collaborate with software developers and test automation engineers to implement automated testing.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of system integration, qualification, and certification processes.
* Support formal certification activities by providing tested configurations, test evidence, technical information, and engineering support.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in system testing, system integration testing, or HW/SW integration testing.
* Strong hands-on experience working with systems containing both hardware and software components.
* Experience designing, setting up, configuring, and troubleshooting physical test systems.
* Strong knowledge and practical experience with UL 864 requirements and testing.
* Ability to translate system and certification requirements into structured and repeatable test cases.
* Experience developing test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test reports.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across hardware, software, communication, and system boundaries.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex system-level test activities.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively with hardware engineers, software developers, system engineers, and certification specialists.
* Good English communication skills, both spoken and written, including the ability to clearly document test procedures, results, issues, and technical findings.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), fire systems, smoke-control systems, or related building-control technologies.
* Experience preparing products or systems for third-party certification.
* Experience working directly with certification organizations or certification laboratories.
* Experience with automated system testing and test frameworks.
* Programming or scripting experience, for example Python or similar technologies used for test automation.
* Experience testing communication networks, field buses, controllers, I/O, sensors, actuators, or other connected building-system components.
* Experience with issue-tracking, requirements-management, test-management, and CI/CD tools.
* Experience with Agile software and product-development processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A robust and representative physical system test environment is established and maintained.
* HW/SW integration issues are identified early in the product-development lifecycle.
* Product releases are systematically pre-tested against applicable UL 864 requirements before formal certification activities.
* Certification-related test cases are documented, repeatable, and traceable.
* Test suites evolve from individual manual tests into structured and reusable system test suites.
* Suitable tests are progressively automated, reducing repetitive manual testing and improving regression-test coverage.
* Test results and identified issues are clearly documented and effectively communicated to engineering teams.
* Software, hardware, systems, and certification teams have a common understanding of product readiness and remaining technical risks.
* Certification activities become more predictable because issues are discovered during internal qualification rather than during formal certification.

description:
Job Details
  
  
**Description**
**About Archer**
A new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage.
  
  
Mandates like the EU AI Act and the SEC cybersecurity disclosure rules are driving the most significant GRC buying cycle we have seen in years. That demand is why we are growing this team.
  
  
This is hard work that matters. Our customers span energy, utilities, financial services, pharmaceuticals, and the public institutions communities depend on. People choose Archer because they get to partner with the most trusted brands in the world, on work that protects the customers and communities those brands serve.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of work, let's chat.
  
  
**The Role**
Quality is not something we inspect at the end of a release; it's something we build into every stage of engineering. As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for elevating product quality through intelligent test strategies, automation, continuous validation, performance engineering, and close partnership with engineering and product teams. You'll help teams identify risks early, find defects quickly, and ensure every release meets high standards for functionality, performance, security, and reliability. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of quality engineering by leveraging modern CI/CD practices, AI-powered engineering tools, and data-driven decision making while collaborating with globally distributed teams
  
  

* Name the team, key stakeholders this person will work with, who they report to and the one or two main areas of ownership.

**What You’ll Do**
**Quality Strategy & Risk-Based Testing**

* Lead quality planning and risk assessment activities across product initiatives and releases.
* Analyze code changes, feature implementations, and architectural impacts to determine optimal test coverage and identify high-risk areas before defects reach customers.
* Drive a shift-left quality culture by partnering with engineering teams to prevent defects early in the software development lifecycle.

**Test Automation Excellence**

* Build and evolve scalable automation frameworks that improve test coverage, execution speed, and maintainability.
* Drive automation across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing layers.
* Continuously optimize automated validation to reduce manual effort and accelerate release confidence.
* Expert knowledge in Playwright tool

**CI/CD & Continuous Quality Engineering**

* Own quality gates within CI/CD pipelines to provide fast, actionable feedback on every change.
* Partner with engineering and DevOps teams to integrate automated testing, code quality checks, and release validation into deployment workflows.
* Drive improvements that reduce production defects, improve deployment confidence, and shorten feedback cycles.

**Performance Engineering & Reliability**

* Lead performance testing initiatives to validate scalability, reliability, and responsiveness of applications under varying workloads.
* Build performance benchmarks and proactively identify bottlenecks before they impact customers.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve application resilience, capacity planning, and operational readiness.
* Knowledge in performance testing tools such as K6, JMeter or similar platforms.

**Security & Secure Development Reviews**

* Drive quality reviews focused on security, vulnerability prevention, and secure coding practices.
* Partner with development teams to identify potential security gaps through code reviews, automated scanning, and risk assessments.
* Ensure security validation becomes an integral part of the software delivery lifecycle rather than a release-stage activity.

**AI-Driven Quality Innovation**

* Evaluate and adopt AI-powered solutions that improve test creation, defect detection, root cause analysis, and engineering productivity.
* Experiment with emerging AI technologies to modernize quality engineering practices.
* Champion innovative approaches that improve quality outcomes while reducing engineering effort.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution**

* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and global stakeholders to deliver high-quality customer outcomes.
* Drive resolution of complex quality challenges with a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability.
* Influence technical decisions through collaboration, data-driven insights, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**What You Bring**

* Extensive experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or Software Quality Assurance within modern Agile development environments.
* Proven ability to quickly identify product risks, uncover defects, perform root cause analysis, and drive issues to resolution.
* Strong hands-on experience with automation frameworks and programming/scripting languages used for test automation.
* Experience integrating automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze source code changes, pull requests, and feature implementations to determine effective test coverage and risk areas.
* Strong understanding of performance testing concepts and tools used to validate scalability and reliability.
* Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional and globally distributed teams.
* A proactive, execution-oriented mindset with strong ownership, urgency, and a passion for continuously improving quality

**Even Better If You Have**

* Experience applying AI/GenAI technologies to software testing, quality engineering, or developer productivity.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud-native application architectures.
* Experience with security testing, vulnerability management, and secure software development practices.
* Experience leading quality transformation initiatives, mentoring engineers, or driving enterprise-scale quality programs.
* Experience with modern observability, monitoring, and reliability engineering platforms such as Coralogix, Grafana, Datadog or similar tools

* Test execution: Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing across project releases; maintain clear traceability to requirements.
* Defect management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through closure; provide concise evidence and work constructively with delivery teams on resolution.
* Security-focused validation: Support testing of security-related solutions and integrations, including negative scenarios, access controls, data handling, and agreed security requirements.
* Automation and efficiency: Contribute to reusable automated tests, test-data management, and integration of suitable tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Quality governance: Follow agreed QA standards, maintain audit-ready evidence, and contribute to quality metrics, status reporting, and release-readiness decisions.
* Collaboration: Partner with product, engineering, operations, information security, and vendor teams across locations and time zones.
* Continuous improvement: Actively identify gaps, suggest pragmatic improvements, share knowledge, and strengthen team practices.

**Mindset and behaviours**




+ Ownership and accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, follows through on commitments, and raises risks early.
+ Commitment and reliability: Demonstrates consistent effort, discipline, and dependability, especially during critical delivery periods.
+ Learning agility: Quickly understands unfamiliar technologies, business processes, and security concepts; actively seeks and applies feedback.
+ Quality mindset: Looks beyond happy-path validation, asks thoughtful questions, and focuses on preventing defects rather than only detecting them.
+ Collaboration and respect: Communicates clearly, works well with diverse stakeholders, and contributes to a supportive, high-performing team environment.
+ Pragmatic problem solving: Uses evidence and sound judgement to balance risk, speed, and quality.

**Required Qualifications And Capabilities**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 5 years of professional experience. Experience may come from software development, application support, infrastructure, cybersecurity, business analysis, operations, testing, or a comparable technology role.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand requirements, identify risk, and communicate findings clearly.
* Good written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to organize work, manage priorities, meet commitments, and operate effectively with appropriate guidance.
* High attention to detail and a demonstrable commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality outcomes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience in software testing, test management, defect management, or quality engineering.
* Exposure to Agile or Scrum delivery and collaboration in cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with APIs, databases, web applications, integrations, or cloud-based solutions.
* Exposure to test automation frameworks, scripting, source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Awareness of information security principles, security testing approaches, vulnerability management, or secure development practices.
* Experience working with distributed teams, vendor partners, or global stakeholders.

**Typical deliverables**

* Test strategy or test approach aligned to project risk and scope.
* Test plans, scenarios, cases, scripts, test data, and requirement traceability.
* Clear defect records with reproducible steps and supporting evidence.
* Test execution results, quality metrics, risk summaries, and release-readiness input.
* Automation assets and reusable QA documentation, where applicable.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Consistent delivery against agreed commitments and quality standards.
* Clear, accurate, and timely reporting of progress, defects, dependencies, and risks.
* Effective collaboration and constructive challenge within cross-functional teams.
* Growth in domain knowledge, QA capability, and ability to work with increasing independence.
* Meaningful improvement in test coverage, repeatability, and team efficiency.

Why join this team
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to build deeper quality-engineering and information-security expertise while contributing to business-critical initiatives. You will work with global stakeholders, learn across technologies and platforms, and help shape practical QA practices in a team that values accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: QA Engineer (Automation + Manual)
description:
**Hiring JD QA Engineer**

**Job Title**
QA Engineer (Automation + Manual)

**Overall experience:**
3-6 years

**Location - Bangalore - Work from Office**

**Role Overview**

The Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer plays a vital role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products and customer satisfaction. This role involves planning, implementing, and automating various testing strategies throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). QA Engineers work closely in cross-functional teams, including stakeholders, developers, and delivery team members, to ensure that the product meets stakeholder expectations and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Planning & Execution**

* Design and implement comprehensive test plans to verify functional requirements, performance, and usability of both new and existing software products.
* Perform regression, integration, functional, performance, manual, and exploratory testing to identify unexpected issues and gain a deeper understanding of the system.
* Perform regression testing of the system to ensure new functionality does not impact existing functionality.
* Assist business stakeholders or end users in conducting user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the software meets business requirements.
* Document test results, analyze findings, and recommend corrective actions.
* Apply knowledge of accessibility standards and guidelines (such as WCAG, ADA, and Section 508) in software testing.

**Test Automation & Integration**

* Plan, create, execute, and automate test cases using specialized tools and scripts to ensure thorough testing of the software.
* Identify opportunities to reduce testing time and effort by automating repeatable tests, and enhance and maintain the test automation framework.
* Work with CI/CD pipelines to integrate automated tests into the build process.
* Ensure test environments are set up for optimal testing conditions.

**Collaboration & Defect Management**

* Collaborate with delivery team members, product management, and other stakeholders to integrate testing into the development process and provide valuable input on potential quality issues early in the SDLC.
* Manage defect (bug) tickets, including clear steps to reproduce and expected results, and advocate for the resolution of found defects.
* Utilize Agile/Scrum practices to enhance the development process.

**Quality Advocacy**

* Contribute and promote quality and testing best practices throughout the organization.
* Collaborate and share information with other software QA engineers by participating in a community of practice.
* Stay updated with the latest testing methodologies and tools, and research, recommend, and implement new testing technologies and practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 3-6 years of development and/or QA testing experience.
* Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Experience writing test automation scripts, and designing and implementing test plans.
* Familiarity with test automation frameworks, specifically Playwright.
* Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python).
* Experience with SQL, and familiarity with RESTful API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
* Experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools (e.g., New Relic, Dynatrace).
* Experience with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) tools.
* Strong knowledge of agile practices.
* High attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work effectively in a team and take ownership of tasks.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., ISTQB) are advantageous.
