title: Quality Engineer
description:
Job Details
  
  
**Description**
**About Archer**
A new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage.
  
  
Mandates like the EU AI Act and the SEC cybersecurity disclosure rules are driving the most significant GRC buying cycle we have seen in years. That demand is why we are growing this team.
  
  
This is hard work that matters. Our customers span energy, utilities, financial services, pharmaceuticals, and the public institutions communities depend on. People choose Archer because they get to partner with the most trusted brands in the world, on work that protects the customers and communities those brands serve.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of work, let's chat.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a Quality Engineer who is passionate about building quality into software throughout the development lifecycle. In this role, you will help deliver reliable, secure, and scalable products by combining strong testing skills, automation expertise, and a proactive approach to problem solving. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and global teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, and ensure customers receive high-quality experiences. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on technical work while continuously learning modern quality engineering practices, cloud technologies, and AI-powered tools
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Quality Engineering & Risk Assessment**

* Review product requirements, user stories, and code changes to identify potential quality risks.
* Design and execute effective test strategies that provide meaningful coverage for new features and enhancements.
* Investigate defects, perform root cause analysis, and partner with developers to drive resolution.

**Test Automation**

* Build and maintain automated tests across UI, API, and integration layers.
* Expand automation coverage by identifying repetitive and high-value test scenarios.
* Contribute to automation framework improvements that increase reliability and efficiency.
* Good knowledge in Playwright

**CI/CD & Continuous Testing**

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback on code changes.
* Support release validation activities and ensure quality checkpoints are met before deployment.
* Monitor test results and collaborate with engineering teams to address quality issues quickly.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and global stakeholders to deliver quality outcomes.
* Contribute ideas that improve quality processes, tooling, and engineering efficiency.
* Demonstrate ownership and urgency in resolving quality issues and supporting successful releases

**What You Bring**

* Experience in software testing, quality engineering, or test automation in an Agile development environment.
* Hands-on experience with test automation tools, frameworks, and scripting/programming languages.
* Ability to analyze code changes, understand feature impact, and determine appropriate test coverage.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated ownership, proactiveness, and commitment to delivering quality outcomes.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and globally distributed teams

**Even Better If You Have**

* Experience with AWS services and cloud-based applications.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as K6, JMeter or similar platforms.
* Exposure to security testing, vulnerability assessment, or secure development practices.
* Familiarity with AI-powered testing tools, test generation, or developer productivity solutions.
* Experience working with observability and monitoring platforms such as Coralogix, Grafana, Datadog or similar tools
* Execute performance, load, and reliability tests to validate application behavior under expected workloads.
* Participate in security validation activities, vulnerability reviews, and secure testing practices to help reduce risk.

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Memory Controller Silicon Validation Engineer**
for the silicon validation of memory controllers and subsystems at the full-system level, from pre-silicon environments through first-silicon bring-up and post-silicon qualification.
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Participate in silicon bring-up of memory controllers, including board power-on, clocks, resets, boot flow, JTAG access, and firmware initialization
* Developing and executing validation plans, firmware- and software-based tests, and system-level workloads to verify controller functionality, initialization, training, data integrity, performance, power management, reliability, and error handling
* Creating test content and low-level firmware using C, Python, and other scripting languages, if suitable
* Validating controller features including ECC, error injection, refresh, scrambling, encryption, address mapping, interleaving, arbitration, and low-power states
* Measuring and optimizing memory bandwidth, latency, timing, calibration, and performance across supported configurations
* Execute stress and corner testing across voltage, frequency, temperature, workloads, and memory configurations
* Debugging issues, correlate results between pre-silicon and silicon, and drive controller validation through product qualification and production readiness
* Building automation for test execution, regression tracking, result analysis, and failure triage
* Collaborating with design, firmware, PHY, board, architecture, manufacturing, and customer teams to drive issues to closure and support qualification and production readiness

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree & 5 years or Master's degree & 3 years of experience in memory subsystem validation with hands-on exposure to validating memory technologies such as DDR4, DDR5, LPDDR4/LPDDR5, HBM, or related interfaces, controllers, and system integration.
* Strong understanding of memory controller architecture and protocols, including DDR4/DDR5, LPDDR4/LPDDR5, HBM
* Knowledge of DFI, JEDEC standards, ECC/RAS, power management
* Proficiency in C for firmware and low-level testing, plus Python, Perl, Shell, or similar scripting languages for automation
* Understanding of embedded processors, memory maps, registers, interrupts, DMA, boot flows, and Linux or embedded operating systems
* Experience debugging hardware/software interaction issues using logs, register dumps, waveforms, protocol traces, and failure signatures
* Experience with lab and debug tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, protocol analyzers, trace tools, and debug probes
* Strong analytical, debugging, documentation, and communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with first-silicon bring-up, evaluation boards, reference platforms, and post-silicon validation
* Strong knowledge of embedded systems, hardware–software interaction, firmware, operating-system behaviour, board-level debug, system performance analysis, AMBA protocols, and silicon characterization.
* Familiarity with UVM/System Verilog, FPGA or emulation platforms, automated regression, CI, silicon characterization, and production or system-level qualification.

title: Lead Data Governance & Quality Analyst
description:
**Job Requisition: Lead Data Governance & Quality Analyst – Service & Operational Data**
**Location: Bangalore**
(Hybrid); collaborate with AMERS/EMEA/APAC stakeholders as needed.
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-time; Lead-level (hands-on Individual Contributor)
  
  
We're hiring a
**Lead Data Governance & Quality Analyst**
to strengthen how we define, manage, and trust enterprise Service & Operational data across platforms such as ServiceNow, Datadog, and other IT-related systems. In this role, you'll own governance execution and data quality practices for core Service & Operational domains (e.g., IT Service Management (Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, CMDB, Request, Knowledge, SLAs/SLOs), observability telemetry (metrics, logs, events, synthetics, RUM). Where end-to-end service and operational metrics span multiple systems, you’ll partner partner with Customer Experience and Engineering teams (e.g., Salesforce, Azure DevOps) to align cross-domain definitions and quality requirements – driving outcomes through collaboration with business owners, data stewards, product teams, and engineering to ensure data is well-defined, measurable, compliant, and fit for purpose.
  
  
You'll translate policy into action by establishing clear data definitions, ownership, and measurable controls – implementing data quality rules, monitoring, issue management workflows, and governance operating rhythms that improve decision-making, reduce risk, and enable scalable analytics and AI.
  
  
**About The Role**
As our
**Lead Data Governance & Quality Analyst**
, you will:
  
  

* Lead governance execution for Service & Operational data domains (e.g., Incident/Problem/Change/Request, Observability/Telemetry, Availability/SLA/SLO), ensuring consistent definitions, ownership, and controls.
* Develop and maintain data quality (DQ) standards: profiling, rule design, thresholds, completeness/accuracy/timeliness checks, and automated monitoring/alerting for priority datasets.
* Define and maintain data product expectations / contracts (schema, definitions, freshness, SLAs/SLOs, usage guidance) and partner with engineering to implement controls and alerts to ensure compliance.
* Partner with Data Owners and Stewards to define critical data elements (CDEs), business glossaries, and data product/service expectations (e.g., incident categorization, assignment group, CI mapping, SLA clocks, telemetry tags).
* Create and manage DQ scorecards and reporting, tying issues to business impact and tracking progress against KPIs; run a regular review cadence with owners/stewards to drive decisions and prioritization.
* Run data issue management with ITSM-style rigor: intake, triage, severity/priority definitions, root-cause analysis coordination, remediation tracking, and post-fix validation; prevent recurrence via upstream controls and process improvements.
* Support metadata management: lineage, definitions, classifications, retention, and usage documentation in data catalog tools.
* Ensure compliance and responsible data use by applying privacy/security classifications (e.g., PII), access controls, and audit-ready documentation.
* Influence upstream processes (data entry, standards, integrations, reconciliation logic, product changes) to prevent defects and reduce rework (e.g., mandatory fields, controlled vocabularies, CI normalization, tag standards).
* Contribute to governance operating model: standards, playbooks, training, and change management to increase adoption across teams.
* Facilitate governance forums (working sessions, steward councils) and drive decisions on definitions, quality thresholds, and prioritization; maintain decision logs and backlog transparency.
* Partner closely with Service Management, SRE/Observability, Engineering, Data & Analytics teams to align on definitions, controls, and overall plans.

**About You**
To be our
**Lead Data Governance & Quality Analyst**
, you will likely have:
  
  

* 5+ years in data governance, data quality, analytics, or related data management roles; experience in a lead capacity strongly preferred, ideally with operational/ITSM/telemetry datasets.
* Demonstrated experience defining and implementing data quality controls (profiling, rules, monitoring, scorecards, issue workflows) and partnering with teams to operationalize them.
* Strong knowledge of data governance concepts: data ownership/stewardship, CDEs, metadata, lineage, data lifecycle, and controls – and how they apply to event/ticketing/telemetry data.
* Advanced SQL skills: comfort analyzing data in relational warehouses/lakes, ability to work with semi-structured data (e.g., JSON/log-like structures) is a plus.
* Working knowledge of data pipelines and common failure modes (APIs, ELT/ETL, streaming vs batch) and ability to partner effectively with data engineering.
* Experience working cross-functionally with business partners and technical teams (e.g., Service Management, Engineering, Architecture, Product, Compliance, Security).
* Strong documentation, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills; ability to drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Comfortable being hands-on: profiling data, writing SQL checks, documenting definitions, and running working sessions.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Familiarity with governance frameworks and best practices (e.g., DAMA/DMBOK concepts).
* Experience with catalog/governance platform tools such as Alation, or similar catalog/governance platforms.
* Experience with workflow tools (ADO, ServiceNow).
* Experience with ServiceNow data model (Incident/Problem/Change/CMDB) and/or observability/telemetry (metrics/logs/traces), including entity/identity mapping concepts, is a plus.
* Experience defining metrics for service reliability/operations (e.g., MTTR, Change Failure Rate, Availability, SLA attainment) and standardizing calculation logic.
* Understanding of privacy/security practices (PII concepts), data retention, and access governance.
* Experience supporting AI/ML or BI environments where data trust is critical.

**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**

* Established clear ownership and definitions for priority Service & Operational datasets and critical data elements (e.g., core ITSM practices (Incident/Change/Problem/Request), Assignment Groups, CI mapping, telemetry tags).
* Implemented automated DQ monitoring and scorecards for key domains with measurable improvements in quality KPIs; introduced alerting and an agreed response process when thresholds are breached.
* Reduced recurring DQ incidents through effective RCA coordination and upstream prevention controls (e.g., validation rules, standard vocabularies, reconciliation improvements).
* Increased adoption of the catalog/glossary and governance workflows across teams; established a recurring governance rhythm with decision logs and prioritized backlog)

**Why This Role Matters**
Service & Operational data governance and quality are foundational to trustworthy reporting, operational decisions, and responsible AI. This role turns governance from a "policy document" into practical standards, data contracts, controls, and measurable improvements that teams rely on every day.
  
  
**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

description:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements.

OR
  
  
Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced CPU/SoC Validation Engineer with strong knowledge of
**ARM Generic Interrupt Controller (GIC)**
architecture and hands-on experience in post-silicon validation, system-level debugging. The engineer will own validation of interrupt-controller functionality across CPU, firmware, power-management, and OS interactions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for ARM GICv3/GICv4 and CPU interrupt subsystems.
* Validate GIC components including: Distributor (GICD)Redistributor (GICR)CPU interface and system registersInterrupt Translation Service (ITS)SGI, PPI, SPI and LPI interrupt flows
* Validate interrupt routing, prioritization, masking, preemption, affinity, acknowledgement and EOI behavior.
* Develop stress scenarios covering: Concurrent interrupt generationHigh interrupt ratesMulti-core interrupt routingSGI broadcast and targeted SGIsInterrupt migration and CPU hotplugInterrupt handling during CPU idle and low-power transitions
* Validate GIC behavior across CPU power collapse, suspend/resume, reset and DVFS transitions.
* Debug complex issues involving lost interrupts, unexpected routing, interrupt latency, stuck interrupts and incorrect GIC state.
* Analyze key GIC registers such as GICD, GICR, ICC system registers, ICH virtualization registers and ITS state.
* Validate interactions between the GIC and OS/kernel, firmware, hypervisor and power-management software.
* Work closely with CPU architecture, firmware, kernel, power-management, design and verification teams to root-cause silicon issues.
* Use hardware/software debugging techniques including register dumps, trace, kernel logs, crash dumps and waveform/trace correlation.
* Develop automation and stress workloads for interrupt validation and regression testing.
* Track validation coverage, defects, risks and closure status through engineering tracking systems.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of ARMv8/ARMv9 architecture.
* Strong understanding of ARM GICv3/GICv4 architecture.
* Good knowledge of: SGI / PPI / SPI / LPIInterrupt affinity and routingPriority masking and preemptionGroup 0 / Group 1 interruptsSecure and Non-secure interrupt handlingGIC Distributor and RedistributorCPU interface registersITS and MSI-based interruptsVirtual interrupts / vGIC concepts
* Understanding of CPU power states, clock/power collapse, reset sequences and low-power entry/exit.
* Programming/scripting experience with C/C++, Python and shell scripting.
* Experience with JTAG/debuggers and SoC debug methodologies is desirable.

**Preferred Experience**

* 7 to 16 years of experience in CPU/SoC post-silicon validation or silicon bring-up experience.
* Validation of ARM-based multicore SoCs.
* Knowledge of virtualization, hypervisors and virtual interrupt handling.
* Experience debugging interactions among GIC, CPU low-power states, DVFS and firmware.
* Ability to convert architectural requirements into validation scenarios, stress tests and measurable coverage.

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.
  
  
The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.
  
  
We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about
**our What and our Why**
and how we can work
**together**
.
  
  
**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.
  
  
ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.
  
  
ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market-development activities.
  
  
The Global Business Center - Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.
  
  
ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.
  
  
To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.
  
  
**What Role You Will Play In Our Team**
The Wells Quality Engineer - OCTG is a broad role definition for individuals, generally with strong manufacturing quality background, supporting the global Wells business with a focus on Oil Country Tubular Goods (OCTG) products including but not limited to casing, tubing and accessories. This role focusses on application of risk mitigations through quality best practices and processes to ensure integrity and compliance of materials, products, and equipment to industry and specified requirements and provides guidance on fit-for-purpose quality implementation. This position is embedded in the technical center (based in Bengaluru), provides quality expertise and support to business units and the global Wells Quality network.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Responsible for review and approval of supplier Quality Control Plans and Inspection Test Plans for, OCTG and API / Proprietary Threading (VAM, JFE, Tenaris, etc.,).
* Steward supplier evaluations and assessments, facility qualifications (such as OCTG Mill and Threading facility) and API Q1 compliance audits.
* Provide assistance to Wells procurement teams to incorporate Wells Quality Manual (WQM) and associated Appendices into quality exhibits for tender documentation packages.
* Lead or support supplier assessments to ensure compliance with the ExxonMobil Quality specifications, API Q1 and industry standards such as API 5CT, API 5L and API 5CRA etc.,
* Conduct Pre-Production or kick-off meetings with suppliers to ensure their processes and products meet all quality requirements.
* Ensure all OCTG equipment (e.g., Casing, Tubing and Accessories) is manufactured, inspected and tested as per ExxonMobil and API specifications.
* Organize, plan, and supervise verification programs via Third Party Inspectors (TPIs) to ensure conformance with the applicable ExxonMobil specifications and industry codes and standards.
* Ensure appropriate budget allocation for Third Party inspection agencies in collaboration with Wells Teams.
* Assist Wells Engineering staff with resolution of Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) and Requests-for-Exception (RFEs).
* Lead or participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and failure investigations for Downhole Completion Equipment’s failures or non-conformities.
* Review TPI inspection reports, ensure outstanding concerns and issues are effectively addressed by the supplier prior to releasing the equipment for dispatch to project site locations.
* Maintain sound understanding of API specifications and ExxonMobil Quality procedures.
* Maintain strong relationships with ExxonMobil Principal Engineers, Wells team, and suppliers to resolve quality-related issues and ensure compliance with quality requirements.

**About You**
**Skills and Qualifications**

* Must have a bachelor’s degree from a recognized university in engineering (Mechanical or Manufacturing or Equivalent) as a minimum.
* Minimum 5-10 years of relevant experience in oil and gas OCTG equipment manufacturing / services in the field of Quality.
* Candidate must have a minimum CGPA of 7.0 out of 10.
* Must have experience in manufacturing and inspection of casing, tubing and accessory along with maintenance, handling, preservation, storage and major certification requirements.
* Must have strong knowledge in API specifications such as API 5CT, API 5CRA, API 5L and material testing specifications such as ASTM, NACE, etc.,
* Must hold NDT Level II certification in MPT, UT, LPT, RT, and VT. Knowledgeable in MFL inspection is preferable.
* Experienced and familiar with API and proprietary premium connection (VAM, Tenaris, JFE and Hunting), rotary connection inspection and threading operations.
* Certification as a Lead Auditor to ISO 9001 or API Q1 or Q2.
* Certification or welding experience (through a recognized body like AWS/CSWIP 3.1/3.2) is preferable.
* Knowledge of Materials selection, processing and corrosion is preferrable.
* Candidate must have strong interpersonal, communication and influencing skills.

**Your Benefits**
An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:
  
  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
* Retirement benefits
* Global networking & cross-functional opportunities
* Annual vacations & holidays
* Day care assistance program
* Training and development program
* Tuition assistance program
* Workplace flexibility policy
* Relocation program
* Transportation facility

Please note benefits may change from time to time without notice, subject to applicable laws. The benefits programs are based on the Company’s eligibility guidelines.
  
  
**Stay connected with us**

* Learn more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and Energy Factor India.
* Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
* Like us on Facebook
* Subscribe our channel at YouTube

title: Engineer III, Software
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
**About Team:**
We are the Digital Foundation Platform team - the software centre of excellence (CoE) for ThermoFisher Scientific. We are responsible for developing and delivering foundational components and SaaS-based applications and digital lab (Cloud-based) tools, foundational AI and agentic AI solutions, to help scientists do their work more efficiently and with precision, enabling them to make our world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Our elite software products and solutions accelerate scientific discovery and lab productivity. These solutions
  
  

* Provide rich content, selection tools, teamwork tools, and scientific apps that allow our customers to focus on innovation and the complexities of their science.
* Build a connected world for our customers where discoveries happen in a thoughtful way — where every device/product is connected, self-aware, and self-healing—thereby enabling efficient workflows and collaborative science.
* Enable our customers to efficiently handle their labs by providing them with insight into workflow processes, asset uptime, and product availability.

We give them the flexibility to access what they need when they need it, allowing them to select and receive products and services across multiple channels. We apply industry-standard methodologies to the design, development, and deployment of best-in-class software products built to demonstrate the power and scalability of the cloud.
  
  
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Purpose:**
The role is for a hands-on developer who is motivated to combine the art of design with the art of programming, thereby actively contributing to the development of new features. This person will be a member of a multi-functional team delivering Connect Platform & Ecosystem, Customer tenancy, Authorization, and Digital product subscriptions and entitlements. The role is expected to make a difference to the product in terms of the design and contribute towards identifying technical risks and alternative solutions to various problems. In addition to that, the role also demands leading, motivating, mentoring, and providing ample guidance to the other team members concerning technical challenges.
  
  
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Active participation in various Scrum ceremonies such as Story grooming, sprint planning sessions, etc., and working towards identifying technical risks, alternative solutions to various problems, etc.
* Responsible for E2E ownership (Design to support) of multiple significant software modules
* Responsible for owning the integrity of technical work on significant concurrent projects.
* Plans to participate and perform the technical work of an assignment.
* Guides develop activities for other programmers on technical aspects relating to the project.
* Leads the implementation, automated unit and integration testing, code reviews, debugging, and integration of code of utmost complexity across multiple concurrent projects.
* Proactively looks for ways and patterns to continuously automate feature testing with measurable and tangible goals
* Candidate is authentic, open, and leads by example, holding self and others accountable. Encourages, motivates , and collaborates with others
* Anticipates needs and problems while creating solutions. Is willing to ask difficult questions and do things differently. Greets challenge and change as an opportunity
* A highly motivated, fast learner who can self-start and “figure out what needs figuring out”
* Actively participate in the development community of practices in sharing and learning standard methodologies, leading initiatives within the community, and being involved in other organization initiatives
* Strong abilities in both spoken and written communication. Ability to effectively document artifacts and processes and then explain them to others.

**Candidate Requirement:**
Education: Bachelor's in engineering or master's in computer science with 7+ years of relevant experience
  
  
**Mandatory Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:**

* Minimum 6 years of experience in Web Application Development using Java/J2EE related technologies and/or Python; Expertise in OOAD principles and methodologies
* Extensive experience in Java application development frameworks and technologies: Apache Tomcat, Jetty, Guice, Spring, and JSON/XML/Ajax
* Minimum 2 years of experience in developing Java/JEE-based web applications based on microservices architecture (using Spring Boot, REST APIs)
* Strong in programming subject areas like object-oriented principles, design patterns, data structures, and unit testing (TDD using JUnit), Domain-driven Design (DDD)
* Minimum 2 years of experience in Cloud computing using AWS (Amazon Web Services) , such as S3, DynamoDB, SNS, SES, EC2
* Validated experience of 3 or more years with databases (Postgres/MySQL/Oracle/NoSQL DB), persistence frameworks, and SQL
* Proficient in handling sophisticated data organization and adept at developing multithreaded applications
* Minimum 1-year experience with GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD frameworks (Jenkins)
* 3 years or more of experience using Scrum-based software development methodologies
* Experience, instincts, and enthusiasm around testing, testability , and automation
* Outstanding oral and written communication abilities. Proficiency in accurately recording artefacts and processes and articulating them to others
* Experience with defining and implementing Non-Functional Requirements (NFR – Security, Performance, Cost, etc.)

**Nice to Have Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:**

* Experience in designing and architecting large-scale and highly available distributed software
* Frontend development experience with JavaScript, Ajax, Bootstrap, HTML5,  CSS,  AngularJS , and an understanding of browser compatibility issues.
* Experience with development on one or more mobile platforms is a plus.
* Experience with quality, code analysis , and Configuration tools like SonarQube, Semmle, Veracode, Netsparker, Ansible, etc.

title: Contact Center Architect -Manager
description:

You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage a broad understanding of various software solutions to assist clients in optimizing operational efficiency through analysis, implementation, training, and support. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, providing consulting services for a wide range of business applications.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for CCaaS applications, covering voice, digital, and omni-channel journeys

* Strong hands-on experience in contact center testing across IVR flows, conversational AI, chatbots, agent desktops, and CRM integrations
* Proven expertise in Cyara automation testing or comparable CCaaS test automation platforms
* Strong command of core testing practices including functional, regression, sanity / smoke, system integration, performance, and manual QA
* Solid experience in test planning, test case design / test case writing, and test script development
* Hands-on experience in API testing using Postman, including REST endpoint validation and authentication flows
* Proficiency in SQL for data validation, backend verification, and reporting
* Experience coordinating and executing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders
* Strong defect management skills using standard ALM / defect tracking tools
* Working knowledge of CCaaS platform features including IVR, ACD, routing strategies, QM, WFM, and digital channels
* Exposure to Gen AI / Agentic AI and prompt engineering applied to test design and automation
* Strong understanding of LLM architectures (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral) and their tradeoffs
* Hands-on exposure to agentic AI frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar
* RAG architecture design (vector databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma)
* Prompt engineering, fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), and evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, custom eval harnesses)
* Cloud platforms: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service, GCP Vertex AI
* Programming: Python (must-have); familiarity with APIs, microservices architecture
* Understanding of MLOps/LLMOps tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases, LangSmith)
* Knowledge of multi-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, and autonomous workflow design
* Certification in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP are required

**Platforms & Technologies**

* CCaaS platforms: Amazon Connect, NICE CXone Mpower, Genesys CX
* Cloud & serverless: AWS (Connect, Lambda, Lex, AWS AI Agents), Azure
* AI & Gen AI: Amazon Bedrock, Google CCP, OpenAI, Kore.ai
* Tools: Cyara and Selenium
* Version control: GitHub
* Cisco UCCE, PCCE, and Webex is a plus

**Methodologies & Tools**

* Experience working in SAFE Agile / Agile / Scrum development environments
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into continuous delivery workflows is a plus

What You Must Have
  
  

* B. Engg./ B. Tech., M. Engg./ M. Tech. from a premier Technical/ Engineering School
* 9 - 11 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* At least one of the following: DevOps Engineer certifications, Agile certifications, SAFe or other scaling methodology certifications, Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Scrum Manager (CSM), or similar PM-related certification
* Demonstrating proficiency in business data analytics and strategic planning
* Utilizing advanced analytical reasoning to solve complex problems
* Implementing technology solutions to drive business transformation

* Embracing change and innovation in technology integration

title: AEM QA Engineer
description:

Domain Knowledge

title: Senior Test Engineer, IMS & AI Communication Products
description:
Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end-to-end, cloud-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Test Engineer with 5-6 years of experience in testing IMS-based telecom products and next-generation AI-powered communication applications, including Voice Translation, Speech Processing, Conversational AI, and Real-Time Media platforms
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**IMS & Telecom Testing**

* Perform functional, integration, system, performance, and regression testing of IMS-based products.
* Validate end-to-end call flows across IMS network elements.
* Analyze and troubleshoot telecom signaling and media issues.
* Execute interoperability testing with various IMS components and network elements.
* Perform capacity, load, scalability, failover, resiliency, and soak testing.

**AI Product Testing**

* Test AI-powered communication products such as:

+ Voice Translation
+ Speech-to-Text (STT)
+ Text-to-Speech (TTS)
+ Conversational AI / Voice Bots
+ Real-time Media Processing

* Validate AI inference accuracy, latency, scalability, and multilingual capabilities.
* Develop test scenarios for AI model validation and user experience verification.

**Automation & Cloud-Native Testing**

* Design and implement automation frameworks using Python.
* Develop test scripts for validating APIs, SIP call flows, and media scenarios.
* Execute testing in Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.
* Validate deployment, upgrade, rollback, and high-availability scenarios.

**Protocol & Media Validation**

* Analyze SIP traces using Wireshark, HOMER, or equivalent tools.
* Validate RTP, SRTP, RTCP media flows.
* Debug signaling and media issues across distributed systems.

Review logs, packet captures, and KPIs to identify product defects
  
  
**Job Requirements**

* Telecom / IMS: IMS Architecture, SIP, SDP, RTP/SRTP, RTCP, Diameter, HTTP/REST APIs, WebRTC
* IMS Network Elements: SBC, TAS/Application Server, MRF, IMS Core Components
* Cloud & Containerization: Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, Helm, Microservices, Cloud-Native Deployments, OpenShift (Plus)
* Automation: Python (Mandatory), API Automation, PyTest/Robot Framework, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions)
* Testing & Monitoring Tools: Spirent Landslide, Spirent Abacus, Ixia, Wireshark, HOMER, SIPp, Prometheus/Grafana (Preferred)
* Experience: 5 - 8 years of relevant experience
* Candidates available to join immediate and currently working in Bangalore are preferred

**Accessibility**
Mavenir is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you require any assistance, please state in your application or contact your recruiter.
  
  
Mavenir is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes qualified applicants from around the world, regardless of their ethnicity, gender, religion, nationality, age, disability, or other legally protected status.

title: Test Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
MantaRay NM is a cutting-edge network management platform that empowers telecommunications providers to efficiently operate, optimize, and assure their complex network infrastructures. It offers advanced automation, analytics, and fault management capabilities, crucial for delivering high-performance and reliable services in today's dynamic digital landscape.
  
  
As a Test Engineer, you will independently own test automation, continuous integration, and regression for specific feature areas, ensuring high-quality product verification. Your responsibilities will include building and maintaining pipelines, test environments, and release verification processes, covering feature, system, deployment, upgrade, security, and release testing. You will leverage Agentic AI tools to accelerate test design and automation, and coach junior engineers on best practices in Robot Framework, Python, CI, and test reliability. This role requires expertise in cloud-native software testing on containerized platforms, utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
As a Test Engineer you will:
  
  

* Independently own test automation, CI and regression for a feature area
* Build and maintain pipelines, environments and release verification
* Cover feature, system, deployment, upgrade, security and release testing
* Use Agentic AI tools to accelerate test design and automation
* Coach juniors on Robot Framework, Python, CI and test reliability

**Key Skills And Experience**
Must-Have Skills:
  
  

* A Graduate / Master degree in Engineering or equivalent with 5+years of experience in SW/telecom product verification and test automation using Robot Framework, Python, and Bash for scripting and test environment setup.
* Proficiency in cloud-native software development on containerized platforms, including Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Strong foundation in core development and CI/CD tools such as Linux, Git, and GitLab CI/Jenkins for pipelines and automated test execution.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, and leveraging Agentic AI/AI-assisted development tools.

Good-to-Have Skills:
  
  

* Familiarity with Helm for deployment and orchestration.
* Comprehensive experience across various testing types, including feature, entity, system, deployment, and upgrade testing.

title: QA Engineer- 1
description:
**About Fam (previously FamPay)**

  

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
  
  
We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.
  
  
Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

  
  

**About this Role**

  
  

Our team is looking for builders of the 1st order, who are detail oriented and passionate about the quality and is enthusiastic about the new cutting edge technologies offered to users. An anti-OK approach. You hate good enough. You understand that an OK service and an OK experience may lead to customer satisfaction, but that’s never enough. Instead, you focus on exceeding expectations and delivering experiences that breed customer loyalty. When it breaks, they cannot sleep without finding that pesky little condition in some forgotten corner.

  
  

Let's get on the ship together?

* Identify test data requirements and generate required data to support testing
  
* Strong knowledge of QA methodologies and processes
  
* Create and manage bug reports
  
* Maintains documentation of test results. Analyse test results and recommends corrective actions.
  
  

**Must Haves**

  
* Having 0-4 Years experience
  
* Possess good core testing skills which involve test cases designing, test strategy, test data creation
  
* Hands-on manual, exploratory, regression and end-to-end testing
  
* Designs, implements maintains functional testing coverage model and delivers quality features
  
* Should possess sound debugging and troubleshooting skills
  
* Experience in mobile testing (Android & iOS)
  
* Should know aspects of functional and non functional testing
  
* Work closely with product managers, developers to analyse and solve product issues
  
* Understanding of RDBMS fundamentals and working knowledge of database testing
  
* Experience/Understanding of API Testing

* Clear understanding of STLC / SDLC

* Experience and knowledge in the Financial Services domain would be a big plus

  
  

**Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck**

  

• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.

  

• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).

  

• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.

  

• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.

  

• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.

  

• Access the latest gadgets and tools.

  

• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.

  

• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.

  

• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.

  
  

**Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️**

  

FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.

  
  

**Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech**

  

FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.

  
  

**Trusted by leading investors**

  

We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer III
description:
**Quality Assurance Engineer**

  
  

**Position Summary**

  
  

Are you a problem solver with a desire to develop, automate and test? We’re in need of a creative and passionate Quality Assurance Engineer on a high performing agile software development team. You’ll work with a dynamic team comprising of Quality Engineers, Developers, Business System Analysts, and Software Project Managers and report to the Product Engineering Manager. You’ll be asked to test software using an automation framework, create reports, perform software analysis, perform functional, regression and performance testing, apply black box and white box testing techniques and become a subject matter expert in your teams’ owned applications. title: Quality Assurance Engineer, FBA
description:
**Description**
READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?
  
  
How would you build the next generation of mission critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?
  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon’s vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, creating a seamless experience to leverage our world-class infrastructure. Sellers, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, in 135 countries worldwide, rely upon our world-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon’s Marketplaces.
  
  
Our team is working to solve what is arguably the most difficult eCommerce problem that exists today: building sophisticated, scalable technology to effectively simplify the complexity of connecting millions of FBA sellers with hundreds of millions of consumers who buy their products. Even small improvements result in millions of dollars in savings for our sellers and customers. Given the importance of small and medium sized businesses, these savings are what helps drive the global economy.
  
  
Specifically, the Send to Amazon - STA Platforms (STAP) team is part of the broader Inbound Workflows and Platforms organization. The STAP team owns the user interface platform that enables sellers to inbound products to Amazon. As the owners of this platform, the STAP engineering team is responsible for the codebase, development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and providing on-call support. The team is also accountable for the inbounding workflow built on this platform, which supports a wide range of marketplaces categorized as "Worldwide" (WW). This encompasses the end-to-end engineering and quality assurance for the seller-facing UI on Seller Central. Additionally, the STAP team owns various services that they have inherited over time from other teams. The QA team within STAP specifically owns manual feature and regression testing across multiple initiatives, both within the inbound workflows organization and beyond.
  
  
We operate as a startup within Amazon, providing our team great flexibility in product and technology direction. Come, join us and build the future!

* Design and develop comprehensive test strategies, test plan, automation, and methodologies to ensure the quality and reliability of software products.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience in manual testing
* Experience scripting or coding
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* 5+ years of delivering test frameworks, test tools, leading the QA projects and initiatives experience

* Excellent English written and verbal skills

* Knowledge of at least one modern object-oriented programming language such as C++, Java, Objective C

title: Software QA Engineer
description:

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence.
  
  
You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing.

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.

* Experience or interest in Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or Knowledge Graph technologies.

(TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Lead/Senior QA Engineer to design, architect and lead end-to-end integration testing and validation strategies across our OSS (Operations Support Systems) platforms. In this role, you will drive quality governance for complex multi-vendor ecosystems spanning Configuration Management (CM / Config Manager), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM), Performance Management (PM), Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Cloud Observability workflows. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise in telecom service assurance, network synchronization parameters and a strong background in validating highly distributed data layers— specifically leveraging Graph databases for complex network topologies alongside Redis for high through put, real-time caching and data streaming pipelines.

**Key Responsibilities :**

•
**Integration & E2E Validation: Architect and execute comprehensive integration testing strategies across highly interconnected OSS environments, ensuring flawless structural data orchestration between northbound/southbound APIs, multi-vendor EMS/NMS and physical/virtual network elements.**

**• Configuration Management (CM) Validation: Design and drive automated validation frameworks for CM engines to audit network configurations, track baseline drift, validate parameters (e.g., cell parameters, routing tables) and verify automated network provisioning rollbacks.**

• Database & Network Topology Testing: Validate large-scale Graph databases (e.g., Janus Graph)utilized for real-time network topology mapping, complex entity relationship queries and cross domain dependency modeling.

• Performance & Cache Validation: Performance-test and validate distributed Redis DB implementations, ensuring active data structures, eviction policies, session states and high frequency pub/sub message queuing behave reliably under simulated peak telecom traffic loads.

• Test Automation Frameworks: Design, build and scale custom test automation frameworks from scratch using Java and/or Python leveraging industry-standard tools such as Selenium, Playwright, PyTest, TestNG and REST Assured.

• Observability & Streaming Validation: Validate cloud-native observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry) along with high-throughput distributed messaging and event data logs streams orchestrated via Apache Kafka clusters.

• AIOps & Closed-Loop Automation: Lead end-to-end quality validation initiatives for AI/ML-driven root cause analysis (RCA), predictive network analytics, anomaly detection algorithms and closedloop self-healing operational workflows.

• CI/CD/CT Quality Gates: Embed robust automated quality validation gates, automated continuous regression suites and infrastructure tests seamlessly into DevOps deployment pipelines via Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD/CT engines.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies:**

**OSS & Telecom Domain Expertise**

• Comprehensive understanding of the FCAPS structural framework and modern Telecom Service Assurance principles.

• Hands-on validation experience covering Configuration Management (CM), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM) and Performance Management (PM) domains.

• Expertise in parsing network topology nodes, checking delta configurations and validating multivendor EMS/NMS integration points.

Database & Architectural Skills

• Strong querying and structural knowledge of Graph Databases along with graph query languages.

• Deep understanding of Redis DB core architecture, including data structures, replication, eviction policies, clustering and Pub/Sub functionality.

• Proven experience verifying log, search and transactional accuracy across distributed data backends including Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL and Cassandra.

Automation Engineering

• Advanced proficiency using Python or Java to design test libraries, custom keywords and object oriented testing suites.

• Robust hands-on framework experience with programmatic API Testing Tools (REST Assured, Postman) and message brokers (Kafka).

• Solid architectural knowledge of containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes orchestration and Helm charts.

**Experience & Qualifications**

• 5-10 years of direct, hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering, with a heavy emphasis on Telecom OSS and Service Assurance systems.

• Proven background validating highly distributed distributed systems with demanding high availability, real-time telemetry and complex data persistence requirements.

• Excellent analytical, root-cause isolation and communication skills to collaborate efficiently across multi-vendor technical domains.

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical engineering field.

**Rakuten Shugi Principles:**

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world.

We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

• Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.

• Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.

• Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.

• Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.

• Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

title: Software Engr II
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Senior Test Automation Engineer with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience to join our Quality and Automation Team. The role will be approximately 80% automation and 20% manual testing, with primary responsibility for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automation solutions for cloud-based and web-based cybersecurity applications, complemented by focused exploratory, functional, and release-validation activities. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with product development, cybersecurity, DevOps, quality, and validation teams to accelerate delivery, improve coverage, and strengthen product quality
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Spend approximately 80% of the role owning the architecture, design, development, and maintenance of automation frameworks for cloud and web-based cybersecurity applications.
* Build reusable automation libraries, utilities, services, and test infrastructure that support functional, integration, API, UI, system, and end-to-end validation.
* Develop reliable automation using appropriate programming languages and frameworks, with emphasis on clean code, modular design, maintainability, and scalability.
* Automate REST API, web UI, backend service, and cloud workflow validation across supported environments.
* Integrate automated suites with CI/CD pipelines and enable scheduled, on-demand, and release-gating execution.
* Analyze failures, identify product and framework defects, perform root-cause analysis, and drive timely resolution with cross-functional teams.
* Spend approximately 20% of the role on risk-based manual testing, including exploratory testing, complex scenario validation, usability checks, and release verification where automation is not practical or has not yet been implemented.
* Define automation strategy, coding standards, review practices, quality metrics, and technical roadmaps.
* Review code, mentor engineers, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide technical leadership within the automation team.
* Collaborate with product development, cybersecurity, DevOps, quality, and validation stakeholders to understand requirements and improve testability.
* Translate suitable manual test scenarios into maintainable automated coverage, while documenting justified manual-only coverage and associated risks.
* Maintain clear technical documentation, execution reports, dashboards, traceability, and evidence required for releases.
* Evaluate tools and technologies, lead proof-of-concept activities, and continuously improve automation efficiency, reliability, and coverage.
* Follow secure coding, credential-management, data-protection, and cybersecurity best practices throughout the automation lifecycle.

**Qualifications**
Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Instrumentation, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in software testing and test automation, with demonstrated delivery in roles primarily focused on automation and supported by hands-on manual testing.
* Demonstrated experience as a core contributor or technical lead for automation solutions supporting cloud-based or web-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, data structures, design patterns, debugging, and source-control practices.
* Practical experience in test design, exploratory testing, defect reporting, regression testing, and release validation, with the ability to determine which scenarios should remain manual and which should be automated.
* Experience working in Agile product-development environments and collaborating with geographically distributed teams.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

* The following skills and experience are mandatory for this role:
* Advanced proficiency in at least one automation-oriented programming language as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with web automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
* Strong experience in API automation and validation using REST clients, libraries, or frameworks.
* Experience with unit and test frameworks such as PyTest, JUnit, TestNG, NUnit, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including services, identity, networking, logging, and deployment concepts.
* Experience in integrating automation into CI/CD systems such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Proficiency with Git-based workflows, code reviews, branching strategies, and build pipelines.
* Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Good understanding of web technologies, authentication and authorization mechanisms, certificates, APIs, databases, and distributed-system fundamentals.
* Ability to diagnose failures using logs, traces, monitoring data, and systematic debugging techniques.
* Understanding of secure software-development practices and common cybersecurity concepts relevant to cloud and web applications.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience automating cybersecurity products, security platforms, connected systems, or enterprise software.
* Knowledge of security testing concepts, including vulnerability management, identity and access management, encryption, audit logging, and role-based access control.
* Experience with performance, reliability, resilience, or security-focused automation.
* Experience designing automation for multi-tenant SaaS platforms or microservices-based applications.

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Lead Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
DESCRIPTION:
  
  
Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you'll help develop and test software for scientific instruments and laboratory solutions. As a Software Test Engineer III, you'll ensure the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive testing strategies. Working in an adaptable environment, you'll collaborate with teams to validate software for mass spectrometers, electron microscopes, and other analytical instruments that help make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
  
  
You'll participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis through final release. Your role includes designing and executing test plans, automating test procedures, documenting defects, and verifying resolutions. You'll work closely with developers, product owners, and stakeholders to ensure our software meets the highest quality standards while supporting continuous improvement in our testing processes.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a highly experienced
**Lead Quality Assurance Engineer**
with 6–15 years of software testing and quality assurance experience, with strong expertise in
**functional testing, regression testing, test case design, defect management, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support**
. The role also requires strong hands-on test automation expertise, including Squish GUI Tester for desktop GUI automation and Playwright with Python/Pytest for web, end-to-end, and regression automation.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have extensive experience validating complex enterprise applications, defining comprehensive test strategies, managing test execution, and ensuring high-quality product releases. The candidate will work closely with product owners, business analysts, developers, UX teams, and other stakeholders to ensure that software solutions meet functional, business, and quality requirements. The candidate should be able to define and evolve maintainable automation frameworks, select appropriate automation coverage, and integrate automated regression suites into CI/CD workflows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute functional testing activities for complex software applications and business workflows.
* Define test approaches, test scenarios, and detailed test cases based on functional and business requirements.
* Perform comprehensive regression testing to ensure that application changes do not impact existing functionality.
* Review requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and design specifications to identify test scenarios and potential gaps.
* Develop and maintain reusable manual and automated test cases, test suites, test data, and traceability between requirements and tests.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated GUI tests using Squish GUI Tester for desktop applications, including robust object identification, synchronization, reusable components, and data-driven execution.
* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end browser automation using Playwright with Python and Pytest for web application workflows.
* Build and evolve maintainable Pytest-based automation frameworks using fixtures, parametrization, markers, reusable utilities, page-object/component patterns, and clear test reporting.
* Integrate automated regression suites into CI/CD pipelines, support headless and parallel execution where appropriate, and analyze failures, flaky tests, and environment-related issues.
* Execute manual and automated tests, analyze results, and document test evidence and failures appropriately.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects throughout the defect lifecycle.
* Perform detailed defect analysis and work closely with development teams to facilitate timely resolution.
* Conduct defect triage meetings and support prioritization based on severity, business impact, and release requirements.
* Verify defect fixes and perform appropriate regression testing before closure.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios, coordinating testing activities, and assisting business users.
* Analyze UAT findings and coordinate with product and development teams for issue resolution.
* Validate end-to-end workflows and integrations across multiple application components and systems.
* Participate in release planning and provide recommendations regarding application quality and release readiness.
* Monitor testing progress, defect trends, coverage, and overall quality metrics.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor QA team members and promote consistent testing standards and quality practices.

**Required Skills**

* 12–15 years of overall experience in software testing and quality assurance.
* Strong hands-on experience in functional testing of enterprise software applications.
* Extensive experience in regression testing and end-to-end system validation.
* Strong hands-on experience with Squish GUI Tester for desktop GUI automation, including object recognition, synchronization, reusable scripts/components, and maintenance of stable regression suites.
* Strong hands-on experience with Playwright for browser-based UI and end-to-end test automation, preferably using Python.
* Strong hands-on experience with Pytest, including fixtures, parametrization, markers, test organization, reusable utilities, and test reporting.
* Strong Python scripting skills for test automation, framework development, troubleshooting, and test-data utilities.
* Experience designing and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks with reusable abstractions, page-object/component patterns, configuration management, logging, and reporting.
* Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD pipelines and version-control workflows, with the ability to diagnose automation, application, data, and environment failures.
* Strong expertise in designing effective test scenarios, test cases, and test data.
* Ability to analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria from a testing perspective.
* Strong experience with defect identification, reporting, prioritization, tracking, and closure.
* Experience with defect and test management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, ALM, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Good understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience supporting and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Experience validating complex business workflows and application integrations.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and distinguish application defects from configuration, data, environment, and integration issues.
* Strong understanding of test coverage, requirements traceability, and risk-based testing.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Ability to communicate testing status, quality risks, and release concerns clearly to stakeholders.

**Testing & Quality Leadership Expectations**
The candidate should be capable of operating beyond an individual contributor role and should:
  
  

* Provide testing and quality leadership for complex software products and projects.
* Define appropriate test strategies, test approaches, and quality standards.
* Define the test automation strategy across desktop and web applications, including automation scope, framework standards, maintainability, execution model, and CI/CD integration.
* Review automation architecture, test code, and framework changes; mentor engineers on Squish, Playwright, Pytest, Python, and automation engineering best practices.
* Identify testing risks early and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Review and improve test scenarios and test cases developed by team members.
* Ensure adequate functional, automated, and regression coverage for product releases.
* Establish effective defect-management and defect-triage practices.
* Coordinate testing activities across development, product, business, and other QA teams.
* Provide clear quality assessments and recommendations for release readiness.
* Mentor QA engineers and promote testing best practices across the team.
* Drive continuous improvement in testing processes, documentation, metrics, and overall product quality.
* Work effectively with globally distributed and cross-functional engineering teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience testing large-scale enterprise, scientific, healthcare, engineering, or data-intensive applications.
* Experience testing complex web and desktop applications.
* Experience validating REST APIs and backend integrations.
* Familiarity with database validation and basic SQL queries.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent solutions.
* Experience with API automation, automation reporting, test-result dashboards, parallel execution, and strategies for reducing flaky tests.
* Hands-on familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing practices for executing Squish and Playwright/Pytest regression suites.
* Experience testing applications involving complex workflows, dashboards, configuration, or data visualization.
* Understanding of usability, accessibility, performance, and security testing concepts.
* Experience with requirements and test traceability in regulated or quality-driven environments.
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed development and business teams.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to product quality.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate them into effective test scenarios.
* Ability to identify risks and communicate quality concerns effectively.
* Strong ownership and accountability for testing deliverables.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, business analysts, product owners, and end users.
* Strong mentoring and team-coordination capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and testing activities across releases.
* Strong customer-focused and quality-oriented mindset.

**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
**Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**
.

title: QA Engineer - Core Business Systems
description:

**CBS platform estate — ServiceNow (ITSM), Salesforce and NetSuite (CRM/ERP), Boomi (integrations), OpenAir, and Anaplan — alongside the enterprise-level integrations connecting them.**
This role requires a strong focus on test automation, integration testing, and data validation, alongside leadership to define best practices and ensure system reliability across the estate. The ideal candidate will also bring an understanding of cloud-native testing principles and security testing requirements at a high level.

You will work as a
**hands-on contributor within CBS**

**Test Automation Framework Development**

**Design, Develop, And Maintain Robust Test Automation Frameworks For:**

* UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright — covering ServiceNow, Salesforce, and NetSuite front ends

* Maintain clean, reusable, and well-documented test scripts for consistent results across all platforms.

* Achieve 70–80% test automation coverage for critical CBS workflows within 12 months.

**Metrics:**

* Maintain <10% defect leakage post-production, improving to <5% as automation matures.

**Performance and Load Testing**

* Use tools like JMeter or Locust to conduct performance testing to measure response times and system scalability across CBS platforms.

**Metrics:**

* Ensure 98% deployment success rates for automated CI/CD test integrations.

* Guide platform owners and stakeholders on QA best practices.
* Define and document testing strategies, frameworks, and processes to ensure consistency across the CBS platform estate.

  of experience in QA automation with a strong focus on test automation frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with tools and technologies:
* UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright
* API Testing: Postman, REST Assured
* Performance Testing: JMeter or Locust
* Strong scripting skills in Python and SQL for data validation and automation.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with cloud-native testing principles for system monitoring and statistics.

* Proven ability to define, implement, and optimise QA strategies from the ground up.
