You will work across multiple layers of the engineering ecosystem, helping teams validate APIs, services, data flows, and user journeys, while building the supporting tooling that makes testing faster, more reliable, and more insightful.

* Test execution reporting dashboards
* Quality metrics and trend analysis
* Integration with observability platforms

**System-Level Validation**

Work across the full system stack to validate behaviour including:

* APIs and service interactions

* Data pipelines and persistence layers
* Integration points between internal and external services

**CI/CD & Engineering Integration**

* CI/CD pipelines
* Pull request validation
* environment readiness checks
* deployment verification processes

Collaborate with platform and DevOps teams to ensure quality checks are automated, scalable, and reliable.

title: Engineer
description:
Role Summary
  
  

* We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility
  
  

* Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts.
* Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes.
* Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues.
* Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings.
* Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable.
* Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e.g., Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering).
* Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e.g., date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues).
* Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC.
* Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies.
* TMS & Localization Tool

title: Software QA Engineer - Performance Testing
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
We are looking for a Software QA Engineer – Performance Testing to design, automate, and execute performance testing strategies for cloud-based enterprise applications, APIs, platforms, and distributed services.
  
  
In this role, you will evaluate system performance, identify bottlenecks, analyze scalability and reliability, and establish performance baselines to support release readiness. Working closely with Software Development, Architecture, DevOps, and QA teams, you will help embed performance engineering into the software development lifecycle and explore AI-assisted performance analysis and anomaly detection.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design performance test strategies: Plan and execute load, stress, scalability, endurance, spike, capacity, and benchmark tests using realistic workload models.
* Develop performance automation: Build and maintain reusable performance test scripts, frameworks, and workload-generation solutions using tools such as JMeter, k6, Locust, or equivalent technologies.
* Analyze and troubleshoot performance: Investigate latency, throughput, resource utilization, and system behavior to identify bottlenecks and perform root-cause analysis.
* Establish performance baselines: Compare results across builds and releases, identify regressions, and provide data-driven recommendations for performance and release readiness.
* Test cloud-native and distributed systems: Evaluate APIs, microservices, databases, and enterprise applications across containerized and cloud-based environments.
* Leverage monitoring and observability: Use metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards to correlate performance results with system behavior and communicate actionable findings.
* Integrate performance engineering into delivery: Embed automated performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate across engineering teams to improve performance standards, test efficiency, and continuous quality.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in performance testing or performance engineering, including workload design, execution, analysis, and reporting.
* Hands-on experience with performance testing tools such as Apache JMeter, k6, Locust, RPT, or equivalent.
* Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, or Groovy, with the ability to develop and maintain test automation.
* Experience testing web applications, APIs, and distributed services, with knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP, databases/SQL, and relevant communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of performance metrics, workload modelling, statistical analysis, performance baselining, regression detection, and root-cause analysis.
* Experience with cloud-native or enterprise application architectures, CI/CD integration, and monitoring/observability tools, along with strong analytical and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience performance-testing microservices, Kubernetes-based applications, containers, and large-scale distributed systems.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI.
* Experience with observability and application performance monitoring tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, Telegraf, Loki, Tempo, Kibana, Dynatrace, or AppDynamics.
* Experience with distributed load generation, performance dashboards, and automated performance regression testing.
* Knowledge of Git/GitLab, Jira, and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Exposure to desktop application performance testing, WebSockets, GraphQL, CLI-based testing, or other relevant protocols.
* Experience with AI/ML-assisted performance analytics, anomaly detection, or automated root-cause analysis.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**#DISWSIM**

title: AI Quality Engineer
description:

**Sailfin Accounts Receivable (AR) Team**

The team works with modern engineering practices, AI/ML capabilities, automation, and deep integrations across platforms such as Salesforce, Celonis, and other enterprise systems.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of
**Quality Engineering + AI-driven automation + enterprise data integration**
.
  
  
**The Role: ()**

**AI Quality Engineer**
who can build next-generation intelligent automation and quality frameworks. You will architect automation frameworks, drive end-to-end quality strategy, and build smart testing capabilities powered by LLMs and AI agents.

- Frontend/UI

- complex business logic

- multi-step data transformations

+ Ensure consistency across pipelines, APIs, and event flows.

+ AI-Driven Quality Engineering
+ Leverage LLMs and AI tools to:

- auto-generate test cases
- summarize failures
- enable root-cause analysis

* Solid understanding of:

+ QA methodologies
+ regression strategies
+ risk-based testing
+ CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred)

AI / LLM Skills

Plus Factors (Big Advantage)
  
  

* Experience working with Salesforce, Apex, or Salesforce data models.
* Understanding of Celonis or other process mining / data transformation platforms.
* Experience with performance testing tools like k6, JMeter, or Locust.
* Exposure to enterprise data pipelines or ETL validation.

This is not a typical QA role.
  
  
You will be validating a
**mission-critical integration between two global platforms (Salesforce ↔ Celonis)**
that must remain stable, accurate, and high-performing for Fortune 500 customers.
  
  
You will also be part of the journey of transforming QA using
**AI, LLMs, and autonomous agents**
, making quality engineering faster, smarter, and more predictive.
  
  
**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Senior Staff - IT Quality Assurance
description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Corporate Functions**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Position Purpose :**
We are looking for a hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our NeXus Core backend team. You will own and improve automated testing for distributed services supporting accounts, balances, trades and positions. Working closely with engineers, product and DevOps, you will build reliable component, integration, end-to-end and performance coverage, identify quality risks early, and help the team deliver correct, resilient services. This is a coding-focused role with technical ownership, code review and mentoring responsibilities.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities Include**

* Own the backend test strategy, prioritising by business risk and choosing appropriate component, integration and end-to-end coverage.
* Extend shared TypeScript automation frameworks and reusable helpers; build maintainable suites, deterministic test data and isolated component environments.
* Validate gRPC contracts and behaviour, including authentication, authorisation, errors, deadlines, streaming and backward compatibility.
* Test Kafka-driven ingestion and processing, including eventual consistency, duplicate or out-of-order events, retries, recovery and reconciliation with database state.
* Develop and maintain k6 performance suites; investigate latency, throughput, error rates and resource behaviour using Datadog.
* Integrate functional and performance tests into Azure DevOps pipelines; diagnose failures, improve feedback and reduce flaky tests.
* Maintain TestRail traceability and automated reporting; communicate meaningful coverage gaps, defects and release risks.
* Work with engineers and product on acceptance criteria and testability; drive defect investigation through resolution.
* Review automation pull requests, mentor QA engineers and lead practical improvements to shared tooling and testing practices.

**Qualifications**
**To Land this role**

* 5+ years of QA automation experience, with a strong backend/API focus and demonstrated independent ownership of automation frameworks or substantial test suites.
* Strong hands-on TypeScript / JavaScript skills: writing reusable test code, reviewing changes and debugging asynchronous behaviour. Experience with Mocha / Chai or comparable frameworks.
* Practical experience testing gRPC / Protocol Buffers, including client setup, metadata, status codes and service contracts; a solid understanding of REST API testing.
* Experience designing component and integration tests using controlled fixtures, mocks or service simulation, alongside end-to-end coverage.
* Experience testing Kafka or comparable event-driven systems, with an understanding of asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency.
* Strong SQL skills for validating persisted data and investigating discrepancies; experience with PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database.
* Hands-on performance testing experience using k6 or a comparable tool, including workload design, interpreting results and investigating regressions.
* Experience running tests in Docker-based environments and integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines; confident use of Git and pull-request workflows.
* Ability to diagnose failures across tests, service logs, APIs, messaging and databases, distinguishing product defects from environment or test issues.
* Clear communication of quality risks and release confidence, effective collaboration across teams, and experience reviewing test code or mentoring other QA engineers.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with our specific tooling: Azure DevOps, Docker Compose, WireMock, TestRail, Allure and Datadog.
* Familiarity with Java / Spring Boot code, Kubernetes deployments, health/readiness checks and service recovery scenarios.
* Experience validating schema evolution, API compatibility and authentication/authorisation across distributed services.
* Domain knowledge in financial services, trading systems or regulated environments, particularly account, balance, trade or position data.

**Working Environment**
4 days from office

title: Test Engineer (UFT)
description:
To build an engineering or QA team capable of managing, configuring, and executing automated testing using OpenText ALM Quality Center, ALM Octane, and UFT One, your resources will need a specific blend of test automation skills, DevOps pipeline knowledge, and test management expertise.
  
  
The essential skill set can be broken down into three core pillars:
  
  

* Test Automation Core (UFT One)

Since UFT One is the engine that executes the automation, engineers must have strong scripting and framework architecture skills:
  
  

* VBScript Proficiency: UFT One relies primarily on VBScript for advanced customization, descriptive programming, and custom function libraries.
* Object Repository Management: Deep understanding of Shared Object Repositories, object identification, and configuring Object Identification Rules or Smart Identification.
* Descriptive Programming: Ability to write scripts that interact with application objects dynamically without relying solely on the object repository.
* Framework Design: Experience designing and maintaining Data-Driven, Keyword-Driven, or Hybrid automation frameworks using UFT Excel Data Tables or external databases.
* AI & Multi-Platform Testing: Familiarity with UFT’s modern AI-driven object identification capabilities for cross-browser testing and mobile automation (via OpenText Digital Lab).

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Execute automated regression test scenarios
* Analyze test results, identify failures, perform initial triage, and document defects.
* Coordinate with functional and technical teams to investigate and resolve test failures.
* Support regression cycles and project-specific testing activities.
* Prepare and maintain test data required for regression execution.
* Participate in defect triage, retesting, and closure activities.
* Track testing progress and provide daily/weekly status updates.
* Perform dry runs and validate automated scenarios.
* Maintain testing artifacts in tools such as UFTand qTest

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Micro Focus UFT/QTP with 1 to 4 years of experience.
* Strong understanding of Regression Testing.
* Experience with SAP applications and integrated enterprise systems.
* Knowledge of Test Management tools such as qTest, and Jira.
* Ability to analyze test results and troubleshoot automation failures.
* Strong defect management and reporting skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder coordination skills

scribe notes, and claims.

title: Evaluation Engineer - Intern
description:
Aura Cloud is an AI-embedded, cloud-native Core and Agentic platform for the financial sector. API-first and cloud-agnostic, the Aura platform spans Loans, Deposits, Cards, Payments and more, with multi-currency and multi-entity support for global scalability. Over 2,000 APIs, ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified, and trusted by financial institutions to run and grow their core business.

We are embedding AI across the platform — in how it's built, how it's evaluated, and increasingly in how it operates. That changes what software quality means, and it's why this role exists.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for curious, analytical, AI-oriented Evaluation Engineers to evaluate features across our AI-embedded banking platform. You'll turn requirements into evaluation scenarios, define what correct looks like, exercise the platform against it, and analyse results to establish functionality, accuracy and reliability — using AI tools throughout to design scenarios, generate data and extend coverage.

As more of the platform becomes agentic, so does the scope of this role — and the engineers who know the platform best will be the ones defining how we evaluate it.

The ideal candidate has a genuine interest in AI-assisted development of software, and correctness as a problem worth solving.

**Key Responsibilities**

* AI Evaluation Frameworks: Build AI-based frameworks for evaluation of AI-generated code.
* AI-Assisted Scenario Design: Use AI tools to design use cases, evaluation scenarios and workflows for validating platform features.
* Feature Evaluation: Understand platform requirements and evaluate whether new features meet them.
* Analysis — Run evaluation scenarios, compare actual against expected outcomes, and identify gaps, inconsistencies and failure modes.
* AI Tool Utilisation — Generate scenarios and data, automate and improve coverage and speed.
* Failure Analysis — Diagnose failures to the point of knowing what broke and why; classify failure modes, document them, and drive issues to closure.
* Evaluation Automation — Build the harnesses and pipelines that operate repeatably and at scale.
* Documentation — Maintain clear records of use cases, evaluation criteria, results, observations and issues.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with Engineering through the feature lifecycle.
* Continuous Improvement — Explore new AI tools, evaluation techniques and methodologies to strengthen coverage and effectiveness.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* B.Tech / B.E. / B.Sc. (2026 & 2025 batches) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of generative AI tools, Large Language Models, backed by project work on GitHub.
* Sound grasp of software development concepts, programming fundamentals and evaluation principles.
* Working ability in at least one language — Python, JavaScript, to call an API, parse the response and assert something about it.
* Strong analytical and logical reasoning, with the ability to identify patterns, inconsistencies and likely failure scenarios.
* The instinct to ask "how would I know if this were wrong?"
* Clear written and verbal communication, with attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation.
* Willingness to learn quickly and work in a fast-paced product.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Using AI tools to design evaluation scenarios, generate data, and assess software output.
* Automating repeatable checks, debugging, and working with Git.
* REST APIs, JSON, SQL and database fundamentals.
* Reasoning about coverage: functional, regression and edge-case scenarios.

**Key Competencies**

* Translating requirements into evaluation scenarios that actually catch failures.
* Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving.
* Precision, and a bias toward proving correctness rather than assuming it.
* Ownership, adaptability, and speed of learning.
* Clear communication and cross-functional collaboration.

**Learning & Growth Opportunities**

* Depth in evaluation design, automation and API-level validation on a production core banking platform.
* Hands-on work with AI-assisted development and evaluation workflows.
* Experience evaluating AI-embedded systems in a regulated domain — a capability few engineers have today.
* Direct collaboration with senior platform engineers, Product and Business Analysis.

title: QA Engineer - O2C & Enterprise Billing Testing
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
  
  
We are looking for a highly analytical and technically proficient QA Engineer to take ownership of our Opportunity-to-Cash (O2C) and Enterprise Billing testing. In this role, you will act as a quality gatekeeper for the financial systems that drive our business.
  
  
You will join the BOBA Frameworks QA team — a small, high-ownership team embedded in the Finance engineering organization — where quality directly impacts revenue accuracy and customer trust.
  
  
You will not just be executing test cases; you will be mapping out complex data flows that span across Salesforce CPQ, our middleware, our Billing Platform, our payment gateways (Braintree), and our NetSuite ERP. If you are a critical thinker who understands the financial domino effect of a failed sync, loves unraveling usage-based billing logic, and thrives in cross-functional collaboration, we want you on our team.
  
  
**What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)**

* End-to-End Pipeline Ownership:

+ Execute comprehensive test strategies for our entire Opportunity-to-Cash lifecycle.
+ Trace data payloads from the moment an order is created in Salesforce CPQ to the moment the final journal entry hits NetSuite.

* Complex Billing Lifecycle Validation:

+ Take ownership of testing our Enterprise Billing Platform.
+ Rigorously validate invoice generation, taxation (Avalara), proration, discounts, credits, tiered and usage-based pricing models, credit memo issuances, and dunning (collections) workflows.

* Test Plan & Coverage Ownership:

+ Own and maintain structured test plans in Xray for all buying programs (PAYG, Savings Plan, Volume Plan).
+ Ensure traceability from requirements to execution across every billing lifecycle stage.

* Payment Gateway & Ledger Allocation Testing:

+ Take ownership of end-to-end payment flows through Braintree.
+ Validate successful authorizations, settlements, and complex edge cases like partial refunds on multi-invoice payments.
+ Ensure funds are accurately handled (e.g., proper allocation vs. unallocated amounts) and invoice statuses remain correct across systems.

* Usage & Consumption Testing:

+ Deep-dive into our usage-based billing models.
+ Simulate high-volume usage data, validate tier drawdown logic, and ensure overages are calculated with absolute precision.

* Cross-System Integration Testing:

+ Perform robust integration testing across our financial tech stack.
+ Validate API payloads, investigate failed background syncs, and ensure data integrity between Salesforce, Billing Platform, NetSuite, and Braintree.

* Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis:

+ Investigate system logs and identify exactly where a data sync broke down.
+ Provide developers with clear, actionable reproduction steps beyond just reporting bugs.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration:

+ Act as the bridge between Engineering, Product, and Finance.Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex revenue rules and translate them into foolproof test scenarios.

What Success Looks Like (Your First Year)
  
  

* Day 30 — Architecture & Ownership: You've mapped the full Quote-to-Cash pipeline end-to-end: Salesforce CPQ → Boomi/PASS provisioning → Billing Platform → NetSuite → Avalara & Braintree. You've taken full ownership of the Xray test repository and can explain which test cases cover which buying program, workstream, and billing lifecycle stage without being asked.
* Day 60 — Independent Execution: You independently execute QA for a complete enterprise billing lifecycle — from contract activation through invoice approval, tax calculation, and payment processing — and close it without escalation. You've begun triaging Billing Platform → NetSuite sync failures and Boomi provisioning errors on your own, and you understand the difference between a defect and expected system behavior.
* Day 90 — Primary Sign-Off: You are the QA gate for all cross-system financial deployments. Engineering ships nothing that touches CPQ, Billing Platform, or NetSuite without your sign-off. You've established a defect triage process in Jira and Xray that gives Engineering and Finance a shared, real-time view of quality — eliminating the back-and-forth that slows down deployments.
* Year 1 — Measurable Impact: Critical post-deployment data sync errors between CPQ and NetSuite have dropped measurably. Every active buying program — PAYG, Savings Plan, and Volume Plan — has standardized, Xray-tracked test coverage for usage-based billing, commitment invoicing, contract lifecycle boundaries, and edge cases. The team ships faster because QA is a multiplier, not a bottleneck.

**What You Bring To The Table (Required Experience)**

* O2C Domain Expertise: 4+ years of QA experience with a heavy focus on Quote-to-Cash / Order-to-Cash business processes. You understand the "why" behind financial transactions, not just the "how."
* Salesforce CPQ: Hands-on experience configuring and testing quotes, product bundles, amendments, and contract renewals within Salesforce CPQ.
* Enterprise Billing Platforms: Proven experience testing complex billing systems such as BillingPlatform, Zuora, or similar financial engines.
* Payment Processing & Gateways: Hands-on experience testing enterprise payment gateways (Braintree heavily preferred; Stripe or Adyen acceptable). You possess a deep functional understanding of payment lifecycles (Auth, Capture, Settle, Refund) and how gateway actions impact Accounts Receivable (AR) balances.
* Integration Middleware: Familiarity with provisioning and event-driven middleware (Boomi or equivalent). You can read a payload log and identify where in the chain a sync broke.
* Test Management & Agile Tools: Proficient in Jira for defect tracking and Agile workflows, with strong hands-on experience using Xray as a test management tool. You know how to navigate structured test plans, manage test executions, and maintain strict traceability between bugs, test cases, and product requirements.
* Usage-Based Models: Familiarity with testing consumption-based pricing, tiered pricing, drawdown models, and metered billing logic.
* Integration & API Verification: Experience validating data transfers between systems (using tools like Postman or validating middleware logs). You know how to prove a system sent the right data even if the UI hasn't updated yet.
* Taxation & Compliance Tools: Familiarity with enterprise taxation calculation software like Avalara.

**Who You Are (Soft Skills)**

* A System-Level Thinker: You understand that missing a prerequisite step — like failing to approve a usage invoice before uploading the next month's consumption — breaks the entire downstream flow.
* Self-Driven Investigator: When a test fails, you don't just throw it back to Dev. You dig into the documentation and logs to help figure out exactly what went wrong.
* Exceptional Communicator: You can clearly explain a complex API sync failure to an engineer, and then turn around and explain the business impact of that failure to a Finance Manager.
* Detail-Obsessive Under Ambiguity: Financial test data is rarely clean. You know how to set up a controlled test environment, isolate variables, and still reach a confident pass/fail verdict even when upstream systems are noisy.

title: AI Test Engineer - VLabs
description:
**Company Description**
Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.
  
  
To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.
  
  
**About Vialto Labs (VLabs)**
Vialto Labs (VLabs) is responsible for redesigning how work is delivered in the tax and immigration service lines, as well as driving operational efficiency across Vialto’s functional areas using AI. The team builds and deploys novel AI-enabled solutions that directly improve productivity and increase delivery quality for our clients. VLabs is accountable for rapidly turning innovative experiments into production-ready deliverables at scale and embedding them into day-to-day operations. This team focuses on the highest-impact workflows, creating standardized, repeatable capabilities that can be deployed globally. Operating with a mandate for speed and measurable outcomes, VLabs works alongside service line, product, and platform leaders.
  
  
**About The Role**
AI Test Engineering is a hands-on role within VLabs Quality Engineering, responsible for validating the performance, reliability, and integrity of AI-enabled solutions in production environments. This role operates at the intersection of AI engineering and quality assurance, ensuring that outputs from LLMs, OCR pipelines, document classification models, and agentic workflows perform as expected at scale and meet defined business performance thresholds. Working closely with the Programme Test Manager and partnering with engineering, product, and delivery teams, this role translates AI testing strategy into executable frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and reusable assets embedded into the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Success requires independent execution, strong technical depth, and the ability to proactively identify risks, patterns, and performance gaps while enabling rapid, production-grade deployment of AI capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Evaluation & Test Design**

* Translate AI testing strategy into executable test scenarios across LLM outputs, document classification, extraction accuracy, agent workflows, and edge cases
* Design adversarial and boundary test inputs to expose hallucination, misclassification, and failure modes
* Validate AI outputs for structure, consistency, accuracy, and production readiness against defined performance thresholds

**Evaluation Engineering & Automation**

* Build reusable Python-based evaluation frameworks, including output validation, hallucination detection, and scoring mechanisms
* Develop parameterized test scripts reusable across features, models, and releases
* Implement AI-as-Judge frameworks, including prompt design, scoring logic, and calibration of evaluation reliability
* Embed evaluation frameworks into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and deployment

**Drift Detection & Quality Monitoring**

* Design and operate drift detection frameworks using fixed baseline datasets and scheduled re-evaluation
* Establish thresholds to distinguish acceptable variation from performance degradation
* Enable release gating by identifying regressions prior to production deployment

**Ground Truth & Data Quality**

* Build and maintain ground truth datasets in partnership with subject matter experts
* Define standards for classification, extraction accuracy, and acceptable output characteristics
* Continuously update datasets to reflect evolving business requirements and use cases

**Workflow & Integration Testing**

* Test end-to-end agentic workflows, validating data integrity, error propagation, and fallback behavior
* Perform API-level testing of AI pipeline endpoints using Python and Postman/Newman
* Validate data persistence and integrity across system layers using SQL
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure testability, observability, and system reliability

**Standardization & Scaling**

* Define and scale standardized AI evaluation patterns and reusable quality frameworks across VLabs

description:

* Location Bengaluru IPEC India

title: Systems Engineering Technical Coordination Lead
description:
**About Acron Aviation (Avionics – Surveillance)**
Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Within Avionics, the Surveillance product line develops and sustains systems that enable aircraft awareness, collision avoidance, and airspace interoperability. Our portfolio includes TCAS, Mode S transponders, ADS-B, and integrated surveillance solutions deployed across commercial, military, and rotorcraft platforms. This work is performed in highly regulated environments and demands deep expertise across systems, hardware, software, and RF throughout the full product lifecycle.
  
  
**Job Title**
**Systems Engineering Technical Coordination Lead India**
**Position Summary**
Acron Aviation is seeking a Systems Engineering Functional Lead & HCL Coordinator to lead independent systems development and verification and validation (IV&V) activities for safety-critical avionics products. This role serves as the primary offshore focal point between Acron Aviation engineering teams and HCL delivery teams, ensuring execution quality, technical rigor, schedule alignment, and certification readiness.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine hands-on technical development and verification expertise with team leadership, partner coordination, and day-to-day execution management. This individual will provide technical direction, oversee work assignments, review deliverables, drive issue resolution, and maintain alignment across software, systems, hardware, certification, and program stakeholders.
  
  
This is a highly visible role requiring strong ownership, technical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively with minimal supervision across globally distributed teams. This role may require occasional international travel to Acron Aviation sites, customer locations, certification events, and engineering integration activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Leadership & Coordination
* Act as the primary interface between Acron Aviation U.S. engineering teams, Acron India engineering teams, and HCL delivery teams, ensuring alignment of priorities, resources, deliverables, and schedules.
* Lead daily execution of systems activities for avionics products
* Plan, assign, review, and monitor Development and V&V work packages while ensuring quality, schedule, and technical objectives are achieved
* Identify and escalate technical risks, resource constraints, dependencies, and schedule impacts proactively
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, including process optimization, automation, AI-enabled tools, and verification efficiency enhancements
* Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance to offshore Development and V&V team members
* Support onboarding of new team members, including tool access, process training, and development environment setup
* Systems and Software Verification
* Define, review, and execute verification activities for system requirements, interface requirements, and integration requirements
* Develop and execute requirements and requirements-based testing, analysis, inspections, and reviews in accordance with certification objectives
* Author and maintain systems requirements, test procedures, test cases, automated test assets, test reports, and verification artifacts
* Partner with systems development teams to investigate coverage gaps, resolve anomalies, and close certification findings
* Certification and Compliance Support
* Support certification activities in accordance with FAA and EASA expectations
* Participate in Systems Reviews (SR) and Stage of Involvement (SOI) audits and certification reviews
* Prepare and review certification evidence packages and compliance documentation
* Author or review requirements, verification plans, procedures, test reports, traceability data, coverage reports, and certification support documentation
* Ensure requirements and design evidence is complete, traceable, and audit-ready
* Requirements Traceability and Defect Management
* Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements, design artifacts, source code, tests, verification results, and problem reports
* Utilize approved requirements, configuration management, and defect tracking tools
* Lead defect triage activities for software and integrated system anomalies
* Support root cause investigations, corrective action verification, and objective evidence collection
* Cross-Functional Leadership
* Coordinate across systems, software, hardware, quality, configuration management, certification, and program teams
* Lead technical reviews, readiness reviews, and status meetings
* Create clear work instructions and tasking packages that enable consistent execution across distributed teams
* Provide regular status reporting, metrics, risk visibility, and closure plans to program and engineering leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* 8–12 years of experience in avionics systems verification, software verification, IV&V, or embedded systems validation within regulated environments
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required to support engineering, certification, and program activities.
* Experience leading small to medium-sized engineering teams, work packages, or supplier-delivered activities
* Strong knowledge of ARP-4754A and systems lifecycle verification activities
* Familiarity with ARP4754, DO-178 and DO-254 concepts and systnes/hardware/software integration environments
* Experience supporting certification programs involving FAA, EASA, or equivalent regulatory authorities
* Hands-on troubleshooting experience within avionics or embedded systems environments
* Experience using requirements, configuration management, and defect tracking tools such as:
* IBM DOORS
* Matlab
* Windchill
* ClearCase/ClearQuest or equivalent tools

title: System Engineer
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
What You Can Expect
  
  
The Systems Engineer – Complaint & Event Investigation is responsible for conducting rigorous, compliant investigations of product complaints, nonconformances, and adverse events to determine root cause, assess device and patient impact, and support regulatory decision-making. This role plays a critical role in post-market surveillance, MDR assessment, risk management linkage, and inspection readiness.
  
  
The position partners closely with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, R&D, and Clinical teams and is especially suited to complex electromechanical or robotic medical devices.
  
  
Work Location: Bangalore
  
  
Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)
  
  
Shift Timing - 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM
  
  
How You'll Create Impact
  
  
Complaint & Event Investigation
  
  

* Conduct thorough investigations of complaints, nonconformances, and adverse events
* Determine root cause, contributing factors, and device performance impact
* Evaluate investigation data including complaint records, service data, manufacturing history, and design documentation
* Ensure investigations are completed accurately, thoroughly, and within required timelines

FDA Regulatory Compliance
  
  

* Perform investigations in accordance with 21 CFR Part 820 (Quality System Regulation)
* Support 21 CFR Part 803 (Medical Device Reporting – MDR) reportability assessments
* Provide investigation outputs that support regulatory submissions and health authority inquiries
* Ensure documentation meets FDA and internal quality expectations

Risk & Patient Safety Evaluation
  
  

* Assess patient safety, clinical risk, and device performance impact of reported events
* Link investigation outcomes to risk management activities per ISO 14971
* Support updates to risk files, hazard analyses, and risk controls based on post-market findings

Cross-Functional Coordination
  
  

* Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, R&D, Clinical, and Supplier Quality teams
* Facilitate cross-functional reviews to align on investigation conclusions and next steps
* Support escalation to CAPA, design changes, process improvements, or MDR reporting as required

Documentation & Inspection Readiness
  
  

* Produce clear, complete, and traceable investigation records
* Ensure documentation supports FDA inspections, internal audits, and management review
* Clearly document conclusions, rationale, and decision-making related to safety and compliance

What Makes You Stand Out
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4 to 6 years total experience in regulated medical device environments
* Experience investigating serious injuries, malfunctions, or death-related events
* Experience with robotic, software-driven, or capital medical equipment
* Experience collaborating with Clinical or Medical Affairs teams
* Quality or regulatory certifications (CQE, RAC, Six Sigma – preferred)

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills
* High attention to detail and documentation rigor
* Ability to make defensible, risk-based decisions
* Clear communication with technical, clinical, and regulatory stakeholders
* Strong ownership for patient safety and compliance outcomes

Your Background
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**

* Experience in medical device systems engineering, quality engineering, or post-market surveillance
* 3+ years conducting complaint investigations or adverse event investigations in FDA-regulated environments
* Demonstrated experience supporting FDA inspections or regulatory audits
* Experience with complex electromechanical devices; robotic medical device experience preferred

Technologies & Tools
  
  
Quality & Investigation Systems
  
  

* Electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS) (e.g., TrackWise, ETQ, MasterControl)
* Complaint handling and investigation workflows
* NCR, CAPA, and deviation management systems

Risk Management & Analysis
  
  

* ISO 14971 risk management frameworks
* Hazard analysis, FMEA/FMECA, fault tree analysis (support level)
* Root cause analysis tools (5 Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa)

Regulatory & Standards
  
  

* 21 CFR Part 820 (QSR)
* 21 CFR Part 803 (Medical Device Reporting)
* ISO 13485 (preferred)
* Post-market surveillance and vigilance processes

Data & Documentation
  
  

* Technical documentation systems (PLM, document control systems)
* Data analysis tools (Excel – advanced; statistical tools preferred)

EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

title: Staff QA Engineer, Performance Testing
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is seeking a
**Staff QA Engineer, Performance Testing**
to play a crucial role in our mission to make satellite connectivity accessible to everyone. You will be responsible for upholding the quality and reliability of our platform and cloud systems through rigorous testing and comprehensive quality assurance processes. Your work will be central to validating our Data Mobility Platform, Subscriber & Provisioning Platform and Cloud Services within the GCP infrastructure.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with a passion for creating best-in-class automation scripts, conducting performance & load testing, and validating Skylo’s robust cloud infrastructure. You will be an essential part of the Connectivity Platform team, ensuring we deliver a scalable, resilient, and high-quality network.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Design and implement automation test suites to validate customer-facing REST APIs and all features of our cloud components.
* Create performance benchmark for handling millions of subscriber and data transactions
* Develop frameworks and test suites for comprehensive load and regression testing.
* Validate the system with millions of data transactions and generate detailed reports and KPIs.
* Automate the build process with regression test suites using Jenkins pipelines and Robot Framework.
* Automate operational processes related to network management, provisioning, and configuration.
* Develop scripts and tools to automate repetitive tasks and enhance overall efficiency.
* Ensure that changes to the Skylo network are version-controlled and reproducible.
* Set up monitoring solutions to measure the health and performance of both software applications and network infrastructure.
* Collaborate with telecom engineers, software developers, and other cross-functional teams to streamline QA processes and foster a culture of quality.
* Promote accountability and ownership within the team by championing robust test frameworks, automation, and documentation practices.

**What We Look For**

* 8+ years of experience in validation and test automation of backend-heavy applications and services deployed in the cloud.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Cloud QA Engineer in the software industry.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, cloud technologies, and architectures.
* Validation experience in backend-heavy applications, services, databases, microservices, and scalability testing.
* Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Robot Framework, JMeter, TestNG.
* Ability to use Jenkins for test automation.
* Strong knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies, with an understanding of code quality and performance metrics.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Shell, Python, or Ruby.
* Understanding of networking concepts, protocols, and technologies relevant to the telecom industry.
* Leveraging AI tool to generate test cases and test suite
* Experience with network configuration management tools.
* Experience with cloud platforms like GCP, AWS, Azure.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially with cross-functional teams.
* Relevant certifications in Cloud QA are a plus.
* Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of folding new ones into your workflow quickly

**What We Offer**
Skylo is a global company with employees across three continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our culture supports a flexible approach to work and offers a competitive range of benefits, including:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages, including stock options.
* Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and retirement plans.
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement.
* Generous time off, holidays, and the opportunity for temporary work abroad.
* The chance to be a part of developing and operating the world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network.
* Access to a world-class team and talent across various tech domains, including software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite, and network virtualization.
* An open, transparent, and inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic, and South Asian characteristics.

**EEO Statement**
Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

title: SOC Debug tools validation Engineer
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
**The Role**
**SOC Debug tools validation Engineer:**
The right engineer will drive the success of power IP (Intellectual Property) and features in AMD (Advanced Micro Devices) products through leadership & coordination, resolution of technical dependencies, and achievement of schedule commits. This is a high-visibility and widely multi-functional role, spanning pre-silicon architecture to post-silicon implementation & product delivery.
  
  
**The Person**
The person should have hunger for understanding newer technologies and willing to take the untrodden path. The candidate should be able to work independently and also guide the team (as needed). The candidate should be able to communicate (both oral and written) and put across his ideas effectively.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the multi-functional validation of AMD Silicon Debug Tools products
* Ability to create Test strategy, Test plan and Test execution
* Work under minimal supervision
* Lead Quality assurance tasks and enhance product quality
* Work across engineering teams and subject areas spanning silicon, firmware, hardware, and software
* Coordinate debug of issues and drive them to closure
* Pull together meetings, set up clear agendas and follow up on action items
* Deliver regular progress updates toward program goals
* Make tough decisions such as priority calls based on partial or incomplete data
* Proactively drive continuous improvement for Debug Tools and performance activities
* Must be a self-starter, and able to independently drive tasks to completion
* Work with the stakeholders to gather and understand the testing requirements, define a test plan/strategy and responsible for the execution of the test plans
* Domain expert who can develop/use test tools, automation scripts and frameworks for product testing and drive process initiatives, understand customer use case and configurations
* Be a technical mentor and leader for the team and independently drive tasks to closure by possessing strong debugging & troubleshooting skills
* Design and Develop test cases for new or existing features in a product, extract test cases from bug reports
* Responsible for the installation and maintenance of the test harness/environment on various platforms
* Analyze and validate tests results- create reports of bug failures, validate bug fixes, follow up with stakeholders to ensure closure of bug reports, participate in debug and triage activities

**Preferred Experience**

* Product development/validation or systems engineering background with hardware platforms and their software & firmware ecosystems
* Familiarity with x86 Debug Tools ,DFT (Design for Testability)
* Good understanding of DFT /JTAG 1149.x / BMC (Baseboard management controller)
* Experience in any test automation tools
* Familiarity with Windows and Linux
* Excellent trouble shooting and debugging techniques with attention to detail
* Experience with standard automation and scripting (Shell programming/Ruby/Perl/Python)
* Knowledge on test tools (Coverage tools / Security testing tools / Performance / API testing and stress testing techniques)
* Experience in maintaining lab infrastructure by Setting up, Configuring and troubleshooting test environment (hardware, software)
* Sound Knowledge on Computer architecture, micro controller/microprocessor
* Experienced in configuring virtual machines, assembling systems, creating dual / multi-boot systems etc.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience in functional and regression test automation of web, desktop apps and Service APIs
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, analytical, planning, and technical leadership skills
* Excellent verbal communication and written, presentation skills

**Academic Credentials**

* MS / M Tech / BE/ in Electronics and Communication/Computer Engineering
* Should have total relevant work experience of minimum 8+ years

*Benefits offered are described:*
AMD benefits at a glance.
  
  
*AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.*

title: Senior IT Analyst Applications
description:
****Career Area:****
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Roles And Responsibilities****

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand dealer order-planning, product-structure, interface, data, reporting, and operational-planning needs.
* Collect, analyze, document, and maintain business requirements, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and traceability for application changes.
* Assess enhancement requests and production issues, clarify business value and impact, and support backlog refinement with product and technical teams.
* Level 4 support for product incidents, service requests, data issues, and recurring defects; analyze application behavior, interfaces, logs, batch dependencies, and business impact to support root cause analysis.
* Coordinate development requests with developers, database teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity partners, and vendors; validate that fixes address the documented business need.
* Manage enhancements and code fixes from demand intake through implementation, including scope clarification, test planning, business validation, release readiness, and post-production verification.
* Develop functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance test scenarios; coordinate test execution, document evidence, manage defects, and confirm solution quality.
* Create and maintain application support procedures, interface inventories, data mappings, knowledge articles, and business continuity or recovery instructions.
* Facilitate communication between business and technical teams by translating business needs into clear solution requirements and technical issues into understandable business impacts and options.
* Identify opportunities for product modernization, process simplification, automation, improved controls, stronger monitoring, and reduced manual support effort.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, testers, vendors, and business users throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

**Candidates Will Have**

* Four-year bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, solution analysis, application support, product support, or technology delivery.
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications and coordinating production incident, problem, change, and release activities.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate business-process, application, interface, and data issues.
* Experience developing test scenarios, coordinating user acceptance testing, managing defects, and validating production changes.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, interfaces, batch processing, and system integration or data-flow analysis.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences and manage work across global, cross-functional teams.
* Strong skills in accountability, organization, collaboration, customer focus, and managing priorities under time constraints.

****Top Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications****

* Experience supporting Sales & Operations Planning, dealer demand or order planning, order management, product configuration, bill of materials, or manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of S&OP business processes, data structures, batch cycles, interfaces, controls, and downstream dependencies.
* Familiarity with C#/.NET and Python applications sufficient to support requirement analysis, issue triage, testing, and collaboration with developers.
* Experience with Oracle, Snowflake, Windows Server, FTP or secure file transfer, load-balanced applications, and operational-monitoring tools.
* Experience with Agile delivery methods, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or comparable work-management and service-management tools.
* Experience supporting application-security findings, vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, and regression validation.
* Ability to use data and analytics to identify trends, validate business outcomes, define requirements, and support decision-making.
* Knowledge of Caterpillar planning, ordering, product-structure, and application-delivery processes is a plus.

****What You Will Have****
**Business Analysis:**
Knowledge of methods for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business requirements; ability to translate stakeholder needs into actionable solution requirements and acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Core Application Systems:**
Knowledge of production application systems used to support internal and external clients; ability to analyze application behavior, dependencies, interfaces, and business impacts.
  
  
**Analytical Thinking:**
Knowledge of techniques and tools that support structured analysis; ability to interpret business processes and data, identify patterns, and distinguish root causes from symptoms.
  
  
**Application Delivery Process:**
Knowledge of major delivery tasks, controls, and deliverables; ability to support requirements, testing, release readiness, implementation, and post-production validation.
  
  
**System and Technology Integration:**
Knowledge of how applications, databases, batch jobs, file transfers, and technology platforms exchange information; ability to analyze and document end-to-end data flows.
  
  
**Software Quality Management:**
Knowledge of test planning, traceability, defect management, regression testing, and acceptance practices; ability to confirm that delivered solutions meet business expectations.
  
  
**Problem Management:**
Knowledge of incident investigation and root cause analysis; ability to coordinate corrective and preventive actions for recurring operational issues.
  
  
**Information Security Technologies:**
Knowledge of application-security concepts and remediation processes; ability to coordinate business-impact assessment, test planning, and validation for security-related changes.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management:**
Ability to build effective relationships, facilitate decisions, communicate risks and dependencies, and align business and technical teams around clear outcomes.
  
  
****What Success Looks Like****

* DOP and Global BOM requirements are clear, complete, actionable, and traceable to business outcomes.
* WD 10 processing is monitored and validated, with timely coordination and transparent stakeholder communication when issues occur.
* Production issues are analyzed efficiently, business impact is understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Enhancements and fixes are thoroughly tested and released with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Application, interface, process, and support documentation remains accurate and usable.
* Business and IT teams work from a shared understanding of scope, priorities, risks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Continuous-improvement opportunities reduce recurring issues, manual effort, and operational risk.

****What You Will Get****

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.

**Holistic Development**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar's employee resource groups across the globe
* Career development opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Medical, life, and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program

**Financial Wellness**

* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance through the annual incentive bonus plan

****Additional Information****
Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. through the Caterpillar careers website. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities, are encouraged to apply.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
* Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
* Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
* Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
* Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
* Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
****Posting Dates:****
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

**Your Impact**
In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve processes, manage data, and develop features for complex commerce processes. You will be instrumental in ensuring end-to-end product quality by driving systematic testing and implementing robust, future-ready automation strategies.
  
  

* Design, build, and test software products, focusing on reliability, availability, latency, and performance through systematic and automated approaches.
* Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive software design plans, automated scripts, and test frameworks to facilitate quality gates throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Conduct root-cause analysis on software product bugs and escaped defects to provide risk assessments and collaborate with product managers to resolve design issues.
* Apply risk-based analysis to software integration points to mitigate risks and ensure high-quality functionality across the platform.
* Document test plans, release notes, and bug reports while mentoring peers and engineering interns to foster technical excellence and productive working relationships.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Domain Expertise: Extensive experience in Quote-to-Order (Q2O), eCommerce, or complex commercial business platforms, with a deep understanding of enterprise system integrations and end-to-end workflows.
* Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to analyze upstream and downstream impacts of system changes within large-scale distributed architectures, providing strategic recommendations to enhance platform resilience.
* Leadership & Mentorship: Demonstrated success acting as a technical mentor or lead for peers and interns, fostering technical excellence, code quality, and collaborative teamwork across cross-functional groups.
* Advanced Automation & CI/CD: Advanced proficiency in integrating test automation suites into CI/CD pipelines to establish robust quality gates throughout the software development lifecycle.
