title: Pre-Validation, CSV & AI Quality
description:
**Quality Engineer**
– Pre-Validation, CSV & AI Quality

Bangalore

5+ years

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Pre-Validation and Computerized System Validation (CSV) Expert with 2 to 5 years of experience in GxP validation, quality assurance, and regulated software environments**
to contribute to the quality engineering and validation of enterprise-grade SaaS and AI-powered products.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in risk-based validation, pre-validation activities, requirements assessment, validation strategy, test planning, traceability, IQ/OQ/PQ, data integrity, audit trail assessment, electronic records/signatures, and validation documentation for cloud-based and integrated systems.

The candidate will work closely with Engineering, Product, Testing, Implementation, Quality, Security, and Customer teams to assess requirements and risks early, identify validation gaps, define appropriate verification and testing approaches, review configuration and implementation evidence, and ensure systems are fit for intended use in regulated manufacturing and life-sciences environments.

AI/GenAI – Must have: Hands-on use of AI for requirements analysis, risk assessment, test/OQ script generation, traceability analysis, validation document review, defect investigation, gap identification, and AI-assisted CSV workflows. Strong understanding of the need to independently verify AI-generated outputs and maintain GxP compliance, data integrity, confidentiality, and auditability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pre-Validation & Validation Strategy**

* Lead and execute risk-based pre-validation activities for product releases, customer implementations, configuration changes, integrations, and new functionalities in regulated environments.
* Review business, user, functional, and configuration requirements to identify validation impact, GxP relevance, critical functionality, data integrity risks, and test coverage needs.
* Define validation approaches, scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and verification strategies based on intended use, system risk, complexity, and regulatory impact.
* Review and challenge Configuration Specifications, functional specifications, design/configuration documentation, and implementation details to confirm that the configured system aligns with approved requirements.
* Perform validation readiness assessments before formal OQ/PQ and identify gaps in requirements, configuration, test data, environments, traceability, documentation, and evidence.
* Support dry runs and pre-validation testing to identify defects, ambiguous requirements, usability gaps, missing scenarios, and OQ script/data-sheet issues before formal execution.
* Review release and customer-specific changes for validation impact and provide risk-based recommendations on regression testing, revalidation, or additional verification.

**Computerized System Validation (CSV) & GxP**

* Apply CSV lifecycle principles to SaaS, web applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and enterprise platforms used in GxP-regulated processes.
* Develop and review validation deliverables including validation plans/strategies, risk assessments, URS/FRS or equivalent requirements, configuration specifications, traceability matrices, test scripts, test evidence, summary reports, and validation closure documentation.
* Strong understanding of IQ, OQ, PQ and risk-based testing principles, including appropriate separation of verification activities from formal qualification execution.
* Review and assess system functionality related to audit trails, user roles and access control, electronic records, electronic signatures, data retention, data export, data integrity, and system-generated reports.
* Apply principles of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GxP, ALCOA+ data integrity, and applicable computerized-system controls when reviewing validation scope and evidence.
* Review deviations, defects, test failures, change controls, CAPA actions, and validation impacts; assess whether issues affect intended use, data integrity, or validation status.
* Support periodic review, change impact assessment, release certification, and revalidation activities for validated systems.

**Pre-Validation Testing, OQ Readiness & Quality Engineering**

* Review and challenge test scenarios, OQ scripts, datasheets, expected results, and evidence requirements for completeness, accuracy, traceability, and risk coverage.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, configuration, and end-to-end testing as part of pre-validation and validation readiness activities.
* Validate critical business workflows, configuration rules, calculations, data flows, integrations, reports, exports, audit trails, and role-based behavior against approved requirements.
* Identify edge cases, negative scenarios, boundary conditions, dependencies, data inconsistencies, and usability gaps that may not be adequately covered in formal test scripts.
* Ensure test evidence is objective, reproducible, attributable, contemporaneous, complete, and suitable for regulated validation records.
* Partner with Engineering and Testing teams to perform root-cause analysis and confirm defect fixes through appropriate regression and impact-based testing.

**AI/GenAI Validation & AI-Assisted CSV**

* Use AI/GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent tools to accelerate requirements analysis, risk identification, test scenario generation, OQ script drafting, traceability mapping, document review, and defect analysis.
* Design AI-assisted workflows that convert requirements and test cases into structured validation scenarios, OQ steps, expected results, traceability mappings, and validation documentation while retaining human review and approval.
* Evaluate AI-generated test cases and validation content for correctness, completeness, hallucinations, unsupported assumptions, regulatory suitability, and alignment with approved requirements.
* Apply AI to analyze large volumes of requirements, test results, defects, logs, audit-trail data, and validation evidence to identify trends, gaps, inconsistencies, and potential quality risks.
* Understand validation considerations for AI-enabled and AI/ML functionality, including intended use, risk classification, model/output reliability, data quality, explainability, human oversight, change management, and ongoing monitoring where applicable.
* Establish appropriate controls for the use of AI with GxP and customer data, including confidentiality, privacy, data minimization, secure prompting, output verification, and prevention of uncontrolled use of production or sensitive data.
* Contribute to AI-enabled Quality Engineering initiatives and reusable tools that improve validation efficiency, traceability, test coverage, and quality without compromising compliance.

**Domain Knowledge – Manufacturing, Life Sciences & Enterprise Systems**

* Strong understanding of GxP-regulated manufacturing or life-sciences processes and the role of computerized systems in supporting critical business and quality processes.
* Understand common enterprise systems and data flows such as ERP, MES, LIMS, QMS, WMS, supply chain, batch/material processes, genealogy, master data, reporting, and analytics platforms.
* Ability to understand manufacturing workflows, material and batch relationships, process hierarchies, genealogy/traceability, data lineage, and business-critical configuration rules.
* Assess the impact of system configuration and software changes on business processes, data integrity, downstream integrations, reporting, and validated state.
* Translate business and domain knowledge into practical validation scenarios, risk assessments, traceability, and meaningful test coverage.

**Documentation, Compliance & Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Review validation and quality documentation for consistency, completeness, traceability, clarity, and alignment with approved procedures and regulatory expectations.
* Maintain strong traceability between requirements, risks, configuration, test cases, OQ/PQ evidence, defects, and final validation conclusions.
* Prepare clear validation observations, risk assessments, review comments, certification recommendations, and release-readiness assessments.
* Work closely with Engineering, Product, Testing, Implementation, CSV, Security, and Customer teams to resolve validation gaps and ensure timely delivery.
* Support customer audits, internal quality reviews, inspection readiness, and responses to validation-related questions when required.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in CSV, Computer System Validation, Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Validation, or a closely related regulated environment.
* Strong hands-on experience with GxP validation and risk-based testing for SaaS, web applications, APIs, databases, integrations, or enterprise systems.
* Strong understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GxP principles, ALCOA+ data integrity, audit trails, electronic records, and electronic signatures.
* Hands-on experience with validation documentation, requirements, risk assessments, traceability matrices, IQ/OQ/PQ, test evidence, deviations, change controls, and validation reports.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum software development and working with Engineering, Product, Testing, DevOps, Implementation, and Quality teams.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools for requirements, defects, documentation, and traceability.
* Hands-on experience using AI/GenAI tools for quality and validation activities, with strong ability to critically review and validate AI-generated outputs.
* Experience in manufacturing, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Strong understanding of CSV lifecycle, risk-based validation, GxP controls, and data integrity principles.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess validation risk and determine appropriate testing depth.
* Ability to understand complex business workflows, system configurations, integrations, data models, and downstream impacts.
* Strong requirement-to-test traceability and validation documentation skills.
* Ability to identify functional gaps, edge cases, configuration risks, data integrity risks, and compliance gaps.
* Strong understanding of audit trails, role-based access, electronic records/signatures, data retention, and controlled changes.
* Ability to independently review OQ scripts and datasheets and identify missing coverage, ambiguous steps, incorrect expected results, and evidence gaps.
* Strong AI literacy with the ability to use AI as a productivity and quality-engineering accelerator while maintaining human oversight and regulatory accountability.
* Ability to assess AI-generated content for accuracy, hallucination, completeness, bias, confidentiality, and suitability for regulated use.
* Good understanding of manufacturing processes, enterprise data models, and GxP business workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset.
* Good communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment and manage multiple validation priorities.

**What you will get to work on:**

* Opportunity to work with AI-powered enterprise platforms and regulated digital transformation initiatives.
* Opportunity to work at the intersection of CSV, Quality Engineering, AI, Manufacturing, and Life Sciences.
* Culture focused on innovation, learning, quality, compliance, and technical excellence.
* Regular workshops, training programs, and tech talks.

**About Mareana**

Mareana builds cutting-edge enterprise digital AI products focused on Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Sustainability. Our AI-driven platforms solve complex data challenges and deliver real-time insights, enabling businesses to accelerate digital transformation.

We have delivered more than $1B+ in business value to global clients, including leading firms in life sciences, consumer goods, chemicals, food & beverage, and manufacturing. We are recognized by Gartner as a “Cool Vendor in AI” and have been featured in Silicon Review and Manufacturing Insights.

We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Oracle Functional Consultant / Test Lead**
to provide functional consultancy and testing leadership across Oracle E-Business Suite implementations, enhancements and international rollout programmes.
  
  
The successful candidate will have strong hands-on
**Oracle EBS R12 Financials**
expertise and experience across the full implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
  
  
This is a
**dual functional and testing role**
. The consultant will design and configure Oracle solutions while using their functional expertise to develop test scenarios, validate end-to-end business processes, support
**System Integration Testing (SIT)**
and
**User Acceptance Testing (UAT)**
, manage defects and provide assurance that solutions meet agreed business and statutory requirements.
  
  
Experience of
**international rollouts and new-market implementations**
is particularly important, including the establishment of new ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units and integration with third-party systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Oracle Functional Consultancy**

* Lead requirements gathering and analysis with business, Finance and technical stakeholders, translating requirements into effective Oracle EBS solutions.
* Design and configure Oracle Financials solutions, particularly General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, E-Business Tax, Fixed Assets, AGIS and related financial processes.
* Configure and support new ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units for international and new-market implementations.
* Ensure solutions meet country-specific business and statutory requirements while remaining aligned with the organisation’s wider Oracle template and financial architecture.
* Produce and maintain functional design and configuration documentation, including MC050 configuration documents and implementation artefacts.
* Develop configuration migration plans and support controlled promotion through development, SIT, UAT and production environments, using tools such as ConfigSnapshot where appropriate.
* Provide functional input into integrations with third-party applications, including procurement, payroll, foreign exchange/rate providers and retail systems.
* Work closely with technical consultants, developers and integration teams to define and validate integrations and customisations.
* Provide functional support throughout deployment, cutover, go-live and hypercare.

**Testing and Quality Assurance**

* Translate business and functional requirements into structured test scenarios, test cases and expected results.
* Define and execute functional test coverage for Oracle configurations, customisations, integrations and end-to-end business processes.
* Lead or provide senior functional support for SIT, UAT and regression testing, including country-specific and statutory requirements.
* Test both standard business processing and exception/error scenarios across Oracle and connected applications.
* Analyse defects to identify root causes across configuration, application functionality, customisation, integration, test data and business processes.
* Work with business and technical teams to reproduce, resolve and retest defects.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, functional designs, configuration and test coverage.
* Support business users during UAT, resolving functional queries and distinguishing genuine application defects from process or data issues.
* Provide functional assurance to support implementation readiness and go-live decisions.
* Validate critical configuration and business processes following deployment and continue defect investigation during hypercare.

**Qualifications**
**Functional and Technical Skills**
**Essential**

* Significant experience as a Senior Oracle E-Business Suite Functional Consultant, with strong Oracle EBS R12 Financials knowledge.
* Detailed functional experience across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Advanced Global Intercompany System (AGIS) and E-Business Tax.
* Experience configuring ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units.
* Proven delivery experience across multi-country, new-market or legal-entity implementations.
* Strong requirements gathering, functional solution design, configuration and documentation skills.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between Oracle configuration, business processes and downstream testing.
* Hands-on experience of SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management and resolution.
* Ability to create comprehensive test scenarios and test cases from business requirements and functional designs.
* Experience testing interfaces between Oracle EBS and third-party applications.
* Experience supporting deployment, cutover, go-live and post-production hypercare.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across Finance, business, functional, technical, integration and programme teams.

**Highly Desirable**

* Experience using ConfigSnapshot for configuration definition, comparison, migration or assurance.
* Experience producing and maintaining MC050 configuration documentation.
* Experience implementing statutory ledgers.
* Experience within a large international retail environment.
* Experience supporting multiple concurrent country implementations.

**Testing Competencies**
The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong
**quality and testing mindset**
, with the ability to understand how Oracle configuration decisions translate into testing requirements.
  
  
They should be capable of assessing how a business process will operate in Oracle, what configuration and integrations support it, how the solution will be validated, how exceptions and failures should be handled, and what regression testing is required when the solution changes.
  
  
The ability to combine
**deep Oracle functional expertise with structured end-to-end testing**
is a core requirement of the role.
  
  
**Seniority and Leadership**
As a senior member of the delivery team, the consultant will take ownership of assigned functional areas and provide guidance to business users, consultants and testers. Responsibilities may include coordinating functional workstreams, reviewing functional and testing deliverables, supporting planning and issue resolution, providing input into implementation readiness and go-live decisions, and supporting junior team members through knowledge transfer and solution guidance.
  
  
**Personal Attributes**
**The Ideal Candidate Will Be**

* Analytical, methodical and detail-oriented.
* Comfortable owning delivery from initial requirement through to production.
* Able to challenge requirements constructively and identify gaps and risks.
* Strong at troubleshooting complex functional, configuration and integration issues.
* Confident communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating within high-profile, business-critical programmes.
* Able to balance delivery deadlines with appropriate testing and quality controls.
* Capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a wider programme team.

**Additional Information**
Why Version 1?
  
  
At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.
  
  

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits

* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Our Purpose
  
  
At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
  
  
**About Us**
SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
  
  
Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
  
  
**What Are We Looking For?**
We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), you will be tasked with delivering high-quality products by designing and building robust test automation and related tools. You will collaborate with developers and product managers to analyze new features, define test strategies, and ensure our products meet the highest standards. Additionally, you will leverage modern AI techniques and tools to elevate test efficiency, optimization, and automation capabilities.
  
  
What Will You Do?
  
  
Primary responsibilities include:
  
  

* Design and develop scalable test automation and related tools using Python and pytest.
* Create and execute automated test cases to validate new features and product enhancements.
* Diagnose and debug failures, working with the development team to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define test plans and strategies.
* Apply your knowledge of software engineering best practices, Agile methodologies, and Windows Internals to drive excellence and quality.
* Integrate AI tools and techniques into test workflows, including AI-assisted test generation, intelligent log analysis, automated root-cause detection, and predictive test case selection.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
  
  
Ideal candidates will have:
  
  

* 2 to 5 years of experience in Product Validation or Development, with a focus on endpoint validation and automation.
* Strong proficiency in Python programming for automation development.
* Solid understanding of Windows OS, Windows Internals, Tools, APIs, and Application design.
* Experience with testing frameworks like Pytest and continuous integration tools like Jenkins and GitHub.
* Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude) for test script generation, test data synthesis, and automated failure/log analysis, along with openness to adopting emerging AI/LLM-driven testing frameworks.
* Experience with Endpoint Security products, a basic understanding of C/C++, and Computer Networking is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?
  
  
AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
  
  
We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:
  
  
**Equity & Rewards**

* Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

**Time Off & Wellbeing**

* Competitive leave benefits
* Gender-neutral parental leave

**Insurance & Financial Security**

* Medical and insurance benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**Work Perks & Flexibility**

* Global home office allowance
* Internet allowance
* LinkedIn Learning license
* Social Connect program
* Food allowance (Bangalore office)
* Meal vouchers (Sodexo)

**Wellness & Lifestyle**

* Health & wellness benefit

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

title: R&D substation automation verification and validation engineer - IDC
description:
**The Opportunity**
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 R&D engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore. IDC collaborates with the R&D and Research centers of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries.
  
  
In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents
  
  
You will be part of Hitachi Energy, Automation and Communication business in Bangalore. We are responsible for development of protection and control products for power generation, transmission and sub-transmission network applications. Our product offer includes IEDs in the Region 670/650 series as well as the COMBIFLEX family.
  
  
This team plays a key role in verifying and validating the products innovatively within bay-level solutions ensuring top-notch product quality which makes the organization one of the market leaders. Come join us in one of the best places to start your technical career and understand the engineering behind the practical realization of theoretical core concepts ranging from power system protection to digital substation solutions. You will be involved in thorough end-to-end R&D testing of bay-level solutions and support software tools. In addition, you will also work on enhancing the Verification and validation processes using innovative automation paradigms and tools.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Verification & validation of substation automation products.
* Participate in test core team workshop to understand the product test requirements and performs software/domain test activities on system/product projects, including design, coding, and black box testing of software modules in line with the quality management system
* Developing new and adaptive design of test cases for system and product requirements. Report & verify the test defect logs captured during the testing phase of the assigned product.
* Partnering well with a variety of different product stakeholder groups, including management at different levels, business analysts and developer’s community.
* Technically responsible to ensure the mutual consistency and efficient integration of the several subsystems in modular, easy-to-maintain and extendible software that meets the product specification.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* Required bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical / Electronic Engineering with 3-8 years of practical experience in Substation Automation.
* Should be technically sound in the field of protection and communication protocols used in substation.
* Should have knowledge on computer networks. OSI Layers, and different protocols in each layer is a plus.
* Should be proficient in programming languages such as Python/Java/C#.
* Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle especially the Agile development method is a plus.
* Should have effective communication skills needed to collaborate with team members.
* Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

**More About Us**
Excited about a new opportunity? If this sounds like you, we’d like to see your application! Our selection process is ongoing, so don’t wait—apply today!

**Job Description Summary**
Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable test automation solutions while ensuring high product quality through effective test strategy, framework development, CI/CD integration, and modern Quality Engineering practices. improvements
  
  
**Education**
**Job Description**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics). Experience: Minimum 6 to 8 years of relevant experience. Academic Background: Computer Science or other STEM disciplines.

**Technical Skills**

* Good Programming experience in Type script/Java script
* Experience in UI Test Automation using Selenium, Playwright, WebDriverIO Automation and specifically writing code in Type script or Java
* Experience testing API’s, and automation with Karate/ Rest Assured/playwright
* Be skilled in core data structures and algorithms
* Experience in writing, executing and monitoring automated test suites using a variety of technologies including, but not limited to, Cucumber, Playwright, Selenium.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Responsible for testing a feature and or a small feature set. Contributes to the team and works with direction from Senior Team Members or management; increasing the ability to work independently. In this role, you will:
* Break down testing problems, estimate effort, and independently deliver high-quality testing, test case creation, and automation for features and small feature sets.
* Apply SDLC principles and testing methodologies (Agile, Lean, XP, CI/CD, Continuous Testing, Scalability, and Test Design techniques) throughout the software development lifecycle.

Create, configure, and maintain automated test suites, testing tools, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins), including quality gates, parallel execution, environment validation, and system-level integration testing.
* Write effective, maintainable, and reusable automated tests that validate critical functional requirements and remain resilient to application changes and code refactoring.
* Analyze, debug, and troubleshoot issues across applications, APIs, automation frameworks, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines; collaborate with development teams to resolve defects and improve build quality.
* Collaborate with Quality Leaders and cross-functional teams to create test plans, define automation strategies, establish quality metrics, dashboards, KPIs, and continuously improve quality engineering practices.
* Demonstrate expertise in application domains, core data structures, algorithms, testing tools, automation best practices, and modern Quality Engineering technologies, including AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
* Mentor junior QA engineers, conduct code reviews, share technical knowledge, and provide guidance on automation frameworks, best practices, and testing methodologies.
* Take ownership of deliverables, identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation, implement reusable automation solutions, and contribute to organizational quality and engineering excellence.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Have a solid understanding of the underlying infrastructure needed to run a large distributed web application
* Has the ability to break down problems and estimate time for development tasks
* Has the ability to make technology choices based on experience
* Demonstrates awareness about competitors and industry

**Leadership**

* Has the ability to take ownership of small tasks and deliver without supervision while using their discretion to seek help when necessary

description:

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. Working with both the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner, helping to shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Corporate Functions Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the products supported.
  
  
This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner & partner with the business to realise product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.

* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner to identify and implement AI, automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Business knowledge in a relevant functional domain & familiarity with associated technology platforms that enable them (e.g., IT, Internal & External Communications, Corporate Secretariat), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g.Agile methodologies)

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**
Agile Kanban, Agile Methodology, Business Analysis, Corporate Secretarial Work, Documentations, Product Lifecycle, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Requirements Gathering, Scrum (Agile), Sprint Planning, Stakeholder Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: SAP QM (Quality Management)
description:
Job Description: SAP Quality Management (QM)
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**SAP Quality Management (QM) Consultant**
to design, configure, implement, and support robust SAP QM solutions across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate quality and operational requirements into scalable SAP processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in end-to-end SAP QM functionalities, seamless integration capabilities with adjacent SAP modules, and hands-on experience in S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and production support.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Process Design
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to analyze, refine, and document business requirements for Quality Management processes.
* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.
* Support system governance and project documentation using SAP Solution Manager / ALM.

Training & Documentation
  
  

* Develop detailed end-user documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process charts, and training manuals.
* Conduct training sessions and knowledge-transfer workshops for business key users and end-users.
* Required Qualifications & Skills

Functional & Domain Expertise
  
  

* SAP QM Expertise: Proven experience in SAP QM module configuration, maintenance, and support across manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Core Capabilities: In-depth knowledge of Inspection Types, Inspection Lots, Results Recording, Usage Decisions, Quality Notifications, Quality Certificates, Defect Management, and Quality Info Records.
* Master Data Management: Deep proficiency in Inspection Plans, MICs, Sampling Schemes, Catalogs, and Selected Sets.
* Traceability: Strong understanding of Batch Management, batch classification, and full forward/backward supply chain traceability.
* Domain Knowledge: solid understanding of core manufacturing quality management standards and supply chain operations.

Integration Knowledge
  
  

* Hands-on integration experience between SAP QM and:

+ SAP Production Planning (PP)
+ SAP Materials Management (MM)
+ SAP Sales & Distribution (SD)
+ SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
+ SAP Extended Warehouse Management / Warehouse Management (EWM / WM)

* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA enterprise environments.

Technical & System Exposure
  
  

* Experience writing Functional Specifications (FS) and specifying requirements for RICEF objects.
* Hands-on experience with interface testing and debugging support alongside ABAP teams.
* Proficiency with SAP Solution Manager / Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables within strict SLA timelines in production environments.
* Preferred Experience
* Participation in at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration project.
* Experience in regulated manufacturing environments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, Chemical, or Consumer Goods).

title: QA Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
As a Software Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive test planning, test execution, and defect management. You will work closely with developers and product teams to identify and address potential issues early in the software development lifecycle. You will be expected to write automated tests using Python and the Robot Framework, contribute to test processes, and manage end-to-end testing to ensure our software products deliver the best user experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Planning & Strategy:

+ Develop comprehensive test plans and test strategies for software applications based on requirements and specifications.
+ Define test cases, test data, and create a clear roadmap for testing activities.

* Automated Testing:

+ Write, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Python and Robot Framework.
+ Design and develop reusable and scalable automated tests for both functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., performance, security).
+ Integrate automated tests with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

* End-to-End Testing:

+ Lead and perform end-to-end testing for the entire software product, ensuring that all parts of the system work together as expected.
+ Conduct regression testing, smoke testing, and functional testing across multiple environments.
+ Identify, reproduce, and document defects and work with development teams to ensure timely resolution.

* Test Execution & Reporting:

+ Execute both manual and automated test cases across various platforms (web, desktop, etc.).
+ Track, report, and prioritize defects and issues found during testing, ensuring proper communication with relevant teams.
+ Ensure thorough test coverage by validating the full functionality of the product, including edge cases.

* Continuous Improvement:

+ Collaborate with development teams to improve the testing process, quality practices, and automation strategies.
+ Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to continuously improve testing workflows.

* Collaboration & Communication:

+ Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, review user stories, and ensure proper test coverage.
+ Provide detailed feedback and suggestions to the development team to enhance the quality of the product.

**Requirements**

* Educational Qualifications:

+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

* Relevant Experience:

+ 3-7 years of experience as a Software Quality Engineer or equivalent.

* Technical Skills:

+ Proficient in Python programming for test automation and scripting.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Robot Framework for automated testing.
+ Solid understanding of Test Process and Test Lifecycle (requirement analysis, test planning, test execution, defect management, etc.).
+ Experience with end-to-end testing of software applications, ensuring full coverage of all functionality.
+ Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) and integrating tests into automated pipelines.
+ Knowledge of version control systems like Git and experience with branching and merging strategies.

* Testing Experience:

+ Strong background in manual testing (functional, regression, smoke, and system testing).
+ Experience in automated testing, with a deep understanding of test frameworks and tools.
+ Familiar with test case design, test execution, and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail).
+ Exposure to performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner) is a plus.

* Soft Skills:

+ Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
+ Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
+ Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

* Nice to Have:

+ Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
+ Experience with medical device/biomedical device is a plus.
+ Exposure to agile methodologies and familiarity with Agile tools like Jira, Trello, or Asana.

We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

title: Locale Testing
description:
**Job Requirements**
Role Summary
  
  

* We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility
  
  

* Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts.
* Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes.
* Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues.
* Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings.
* Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable.
* Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e.g., Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering).
* Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e.g., date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues).
* Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC.
* Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies.
* TMS & Localization Tool

25years

title: Test Lead
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Test Engineer who can own quality across DataWeave's SaaS platform, spanning manual and automation testing, API and data validation, and testing of AI and ML driven features such as pricing insights, recommendations, and LLM powered outputs. This role requires strong testing fundamentals, comfort building and maintaining automation frameworks, and the judgment to design test strategies for features whose outputs are probabilistic rather than deterministic. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and data science to ensure releases are reliable, performant, and trustworthy at scale.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design, execute, and maintain test plans and test cases for new features, covering functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing across the DataWeave platform.
* Build and extend automation test suites (UI and API) using frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress, integrated into CI/CD pipelines for fast, reliable feedback.
* Own API testing end to end: functional, contract, negative, and performance testing of REST and internal service APIs using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent.
* Define and execute test strategies for AI and ML driven features (LLM based insights, recommendations, classification, and NLP or computer vision pipelines), including evaluation of output accuracy, consistency, edge cases, hallucination checks, and regression across model or prompt changes.
* Validate large scale data pipelines and outputs for correctness, completeness, and consistency, working closely with data engineering and data science teams.
* Set up and maintain test data, environments, and mocks needed for repeatable manual and automated testing.
* Triage defects, drive root cause analysis with engineering, and track quality metrics (coverage, defect leakage, automation ROI) to improve release quality over time.
* Contribute to test strategy, tooling choices, and best practices, and mentor junior QA engineers on the team.
* Participate in sprint planning, story grooming, and release readiness reviews, representing the quality and testability point of view.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 4 to 7 years of overall QA/testing experience, with a strong mix of manual and automation testing in a SaaS or product engineering environment.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar) and integrating them into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Strong experience in API testing (REST, JSON/XML payloads) using Postman, RestAssured, or comparable tools, including contract and performance testing.
* Practical exposure to testing AI/ML or LLM powered features, such as evaluating model outputs, prompt regression, accuracy and precision/recall style metrics, or building golden datasets for evaluation.
* Solid understanding of SQL and the ability to validate data in large datasets or data warehouses.
* Working knowledge of scripting or programming (Python, Java, or JavaScript) for automation and data validation scripts.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery, defect tracking (Jira), and test management tools.
* Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to reason about edge cases in complex, data heavy, AI driven systems.
* Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with engineering, product, and data science stakeholders.
* Proficiency in using at least one of the AI Developer Productivity Tools (like Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor..)
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

title: Solution Test Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About the Opportunity:**
At Ericsson, we're shaping the future of connectivity through cutting-edge 5G and cloud-native technologies. We're looking for a Solution Test Engineer to lead end-to-end testing, system integration, automation, and validation of Ericsson Private 5G solutions ( BEWS - Private Networks). In this role, you'll work across 5G Core, RAN, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms, drive quality through automation and CI/CD, troubleshoot complex network issues, and collaborate with global teams to deliver world-class telecom solutions.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Test Design & Execution: Design and execute detailed E2E system test plans for Ericsson Private 5G (EP5G) solutions, ensuring full coverage of 3GPP features and customer use cases.
* System Integration: Integrate and validate 5G components, including Cloud-Native Core (cn5GC), RAN, and Management/Orchestration platforms, ensuring seamless interoperability.
* Advanced Validation: Own the E2E validation for specific feature sets across performance, scaling, and stability, utilizing CI/CD pipelines for automated regression.
* Protocol Debugging: Perform deep-dive troubleshooting of complex call flows using tools like Wireshark/QXDM to analyze NAS/AS signaling and interfaces (N1, N2, N3, etc.).
* Automation Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts within a Python/Robot Framework environment to increase test velocity and reliability.
* Stability & Performance Testing: Design and run soak tests, stress tests, and load models to identify memory leaks and system bottlenecks before deployment.
* Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, conduct peer reviews of test cases, and contribute to the team's internal knowledge base.

**Skills You Bring**
Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS, EE, or related field with 6–8 years of experience in Telecom/Network testing.
  
  
5G/4G Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of 3GPP architectures and protocols (NGAP, S1AP, RRC, HTTP/2). Ability to analyze multi-interface traces to isolate faults.
  
  
Cloud-Native Skills: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and Helm. Understanding of K8s networking (Services, Load Balancers, and CNI basics) is essential.
  
  
Networking Foundations: Solid knowledge of L2/L3 networking, including IPV4/V6, VLANs, Routing, and familiarity with OSPF/BGP.
  
  
Automation Proficiency: Strong Python scripting skills and experience with Robot Framework (or similar) to automate complex system-level scenarios.
  
  
System Validation Expertise: Proven ability to design test cases for performance (throughput/latency), scaling, and stability (soak/reliability).
  
  
Infrastructure & Tools: Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments. Experience with industry tools such as Spirent (Landslide), Keysight, or Viavi.
  
  
**“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”**

• CI/CD integration and Git-based workflows.

• Solid debugging skills and attention to detail.

• Big data pipeline testing (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka).

• OpenShift/Kubernetes and cloud-native testing.

• Roaming analytics / telecom product QE background.

3–5 years in test automation / SDET roles

BE. / B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech. or M. Sc. in Computer Science / Electronics Engineering / MCA

, you will play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of initiatives across

Working closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, developers, data scientists, and reporting teams, you will help translate business needs into well-defined requirements, maintain and prioritize team backlogs, coordinate delivery activities, and support the adoption of Agile ways of working.

* Facilitate meetings, workshops, and stakeholder discussions while documenting decisions, actions, and outcomes.
* Gather, analyze, and synthesize information from multiple sources to support data-driven decision making.
* Support operational readiness activities to ensure successful adoption of new capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, team workflows, reporting capabilities, and delivery practices.
* Promote Agile best practices and continuous improvement across Payment Integrity initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with global teams across multiple time zones and functional areas.

+ Strong experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements.
+ Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder meetings, and requirements discussions.
+ Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Experience creating process flows, business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and operational documentation.
+ Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
+ Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

+ Experience working within Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or other Agile delivery frameworks.
+ Experience maintaining product backlogs and supporting Product Owners.
+ Experience using Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Salesforce, or Health Cloud.
+ Exposure to Data Science, Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, or Data Visualization projects.
+ Knowledge of dashboard development and reporting concepts (Power BI, Tableau, QlikSense, or similar tools).

title: Senior/Principal Product Analyst - Workplace Experience
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Legal & Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF). This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Senior/Principal Product Analyst - Workplace Experience supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Workplace Experience Product Owner, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Workplace Experience Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product.
  
  
This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the Workplace Experience Product Owner to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Workplace Experience Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Workplace Experience Product Owner to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Follow DTMS to ensure compliant product portfolio within WREF
* Support the Workplace Experience Product owner in the deployment and support of Workplace Experience technologies
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience delivering and supporting workplace experience technologies such as AppSpace
* Experience onboarding new sites to Workplace technologies and ensuring compliance with design standards.
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Management, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Smart Buildings, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story, Workplace Technology
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

title: Senior/Principal Product Analyst - WREF
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Legal & Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF). This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Senior/ Principal Product Analyst - WREF supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the WREF Product Owner, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The WREF Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product.
  
  
This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the WREF Product Owner to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the WREF Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Product Owner to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Follow DTMS to ensure a compliant product portfolio for WREF products
* Support the WREF Product Owner in making product changes aligned to the Smart Buildings strategy
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience delivering and supporting workplace technologies, particularly IOT, smart buildings, real estate process automation
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Buildings Management, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Digital Solutions, Internet of Things (IoT) Platforms, Process Automation, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Smart Buildings, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story, Workplace Technology
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
