title: Senior Consultant - Endur Functional
description:
**Senior Consultant – Endur Functional**

 

**Location:
India**

**Role:**
**Permanent/ Full Time**

**Why capSpire?**

 

capSpire is a fast-growing consulting and solutions company with a global footprint with eight offices in the world’s leading markets. We pride ourselves in being truly entrepreneurial, innovative, and collaborative, with a strong problem-solving ethos. We have built working relationships which span decades with many of the world’s largest energy and commodity companies. We believe that this is because we put our people first and are passionate about providing our clients with deep technical and industry insights that deliver pragmatic solutions. As we continue to grow domestically and internationally, we become more diverse. This rich diversity fuels our business and enriches our culture

 

**About the role**

 

We are currently growing our ETRM/CTRM Endur practice and are looking for experienced Endur Consultants with expertise in Commodity or Energy markets and Trading and Risk Management System Implementations. You will be part of the team involved in implementation/upgrade/support of Endur, bringing SME knowledge in deal modelling, deal valuations, risk management, scheduling, invoicing, and accounting for commodities and energy. You will ensure successful project delivery, employing consultancy and best practices. 

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Collaborate with clients and prospects to determine business requirements and processes to be addressed by key areas of the Endur solution, with the ability to identify improvement potential and drive change management.
* Work as part of a team on the functional implementation, encompassing design, configuration, functional testing and support transition to operations of Endur solution.
* Support existing solutions for bug fixes, enhancements and operations.
* Document business requirements, implementation designs, test plans/results, and other deliverables required by the project.
* Follow best practices, documentation standards, and resolution process flow for all deliverables.
* Collaborate with technical teams to create customisations based on specific client needs
* Provide industry and functional advisory as needed.
* Apply appropriate resourcing techniques given project-specific needs, risks, and differences in core project team member skill levels and relevant modules to be delivered in client projects.
* Maintain highly effective communication with client and internal stakeholders and adept in handling business changes and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Provide guidance and training on Endur functionality and general ETRM/CTRM topics.

**Skills**

 

* Endur Modules: Good working knowledge in key modules of Endur and commodity/energy operations with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* Endur Risk Management: Knowledge of Endur risk and valuation functionality including results (MTM, PnL, VAR), and EOD automation (TPM and Services Manager).
* Endur Customisation: Deep knowledge of standard and customisation approaches for implementation of requirements, support for reporting, building complex desktops, APM pages, and pre/post-processing logic.
* Endur Architecture: Understanding of Endur architecture and best implementation practices to optimize its strengths for the client solution.
* Functional Knowledge: Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG or Crude and Refined Products.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and stakeholder management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi-tasking and Project Management skills.
* Strong organisational & analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detailed oriented environment and work independently or in a team.

 

**Required Experience**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent experience in a related field
* 4+ years hands-on with Endur as a consultant, business analyst, functional specialist, QA specialist or IT support specialist with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* At least 4+ years of industry work experience.
* Good working understanding of various functional areas and relevant modules of Endur.
* Experience in conducting comprehensive testing and quality assurance activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of Endur solutions.
* Worked as part of a cross-cultural/geographical team including flexibility to support multiple time zones when necessary.
* Worked as part of a project team structure and delivered results with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel to onsite client locations for limited time as per project requirement.

**Preferred Experience**

 

* Subject matter expert or functional consultant in Commodity Trading, Risk or Logistics business areas in large enterprise environments.
* Worked in Front, Middle or Back Office functions with specialty in any of the following: Trading (Derivatives, Physical), Risk (Market, Credit, Operational, Compliance), Logistics (Pipeline, Vessel, Nomination) or Settlements (AR/AP Process, Invoice Management).
* Experience with Endur gMotion or cMotion modules would be advantageous.

**What to expect as a capSpire consultant**

 

As part of a capSpire team, you’ll experience the full project life-cycle and be part of a dynamic team in which diversity, camaraderie and professional excellence are celebrated. We like to have fun as a team, encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning and take pride in delivering the best possible outcomes for our clients. 

 

If you think you have the necessary skills and experience to excel as a capSpire Consultant we are keen to speak with you.

title: Senior System Integration and Validation Engineer
description:
The Silicon Co-Design Group (SCG) sits at the crossroads of architecture, design, marketing, operations, and productization. Our work spans early architecture through final product delivery across Datacenter, Gaming, Robotics, Automotive, and Embedded markets. We work closely across functions to deliver chips that change what is possible. System Integration sits at the intersection of all of them. It is the layer where every architecture, design, software, and manufacturing decision meets reality. When something breaks late in a program, it usually breaks here first.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
We are hiring a Senior Engineer to lead system validation, debug, and cross-functional alignment on one of our most consequential silicon programs. Your work will sit on the critical path of every flagship build, and the judgment you bring to ambiguous, multi-team failures is the difference between shipping on milestone and slipping! The two hardest, highest-leverage problems in this seat:
  
  

* Own end-to-end system validation of NVIDIA GPU, SoC, and platform programs — feature checks, PVT stress, system-stress campaigns at scale, and multi-unit fleet testing.
* Lead debug of the hardest cross-stack issues — logic, signal integrity, power delivery, firmware, and software interaction — and drive them to root cause with reusable workarounds and productized fixes.
* Develop test plans, scripts, and automation for next-generation chips ahead of physical builds, translating architecture, boot flows, high-speed I/O, and power and thermal dependencies into executable coverage.
* Design and deploy AI-enabled debug and validation workflows used by the team — with explicit guardrails (evals, regression validation, false-positive handling) and measurable impact on cycle time, debug velocity, or escape rate.
* Translate complex silicon and system risk into decision-ready options for technical and executive audiences — without padding or hand-waving.
* Partner with globally distributed teams across silicon design, DFT, firmware, software, manufacturing, and platform engineering — including counterpart engineers in India and other major hubs.
* Lead crisis-mode debug task forces when a program is stuck, and convert the learnings into reusable methodology for adjacent programs.
* Find critical silicon and platform issues before they reach the customer — by shifting validation coverage left with system stress, PVT, and feature-interaction tests that catch escapes before software hardens. Your work shows up in DPPM, escape rate, and ramp confidence.
* Build AI-enabled validation as a real capability, not a demo — by deploying debug, triage, root-cause hypothesis generation, and regression workflows with the evals and guardrails that make them trustworthy enough to gate production decisions.

**What We Need To See**

* BTech/BE or MTech/ME in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (or equivalent experience), and 6+ years of post-silicon validation, system integration, or platform debug experience on shipped GPU, CPU, or SoC products.
* Hands-on debug depth across silicon, board, and software boundaries — logic design, signal integrity, power delivery, high-speed I/O, and PVT behavior — with strong EE fundamentals across SI/PI, power delivery, and thermal, and a working understanding of GPU, CPU, or SoC architecture across PC, Datacenter, or Automotive.
* At least one specific example of taking an ambiguous, multi-team failure to root-cause closure with a productized fix, and a track record of leading a project team end-to-end through a real crisis with decision points you owned.
* Demonstrated AI-driven validation workflow you built or scaled, not just used — with adoption beyond yourself and measurable impact on debug velocity, coverage, or escape rate. You can describe the guardrails you put in place and where AI is dangerous in your workflow.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* A history of building reusable validation methodology, debug playbooks, or test frameworks that were adopted by other programs or teams — backed by patents, conference papers, invited talks, or recognized contributions.
* Hands-on subsystem depth in HBM, SerDes or high-speed I/O, power and thermal, or advanced packaging — failure modes, debug instrumentation, and the tradeoffs that show up in production.
* Experience partnering deeply with a counterpart team in India or another major engineering hub — examples of shared culture, shared metrics, and shared on-call across geographies.
* AI work that goes beyond personal-copilot use — agentic workflows, RAG-grounded debug assistants, regression bucketing, or automated triage deployed at team scope with adoption metrics.

NVIDIA is the world leader in accelerated computing, and our work powers AI, gaming, robotics, autonomous systems, and scientific discovery. We invest in our people with competitive benefits, flexible time off, and continuous learning, and we build a team where everyone can do their best work. Come help us build chips that change what is possible!

title: Automation QA Lead
description:
**About CData Software, Inc.**
CData is the data layer between AI and ROI—delivering the connectivity, context, and control that make enterprise AI more accurate. One platform for live access and data replication across 350+ sources, semantic intelligence that ensures context-aware responses, and built-in governance for every AI-to-data interaction. Powering AI and analytics workloads for Anthropic, Databricks, Microsoft, Google, Palantir, and more than 10,000 customers worldwide.
  
  
Behind that impact is a global team of passionate problem-solvers, engineers, and innovators who are redefining what’s possible in data connectivity.
  
  
Headquartered in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, CData has over 500 team members, with offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. We take pride not just in what we build, but in how we build it: together, with curiosity, creativity, and a shared drive to push boundaries.
  
  
**Role Description**
As a QA Automation Lead, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products. You will be responsible for planning, developing, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts for Sync Application. Working closely with our development, QA, and product teams, you will collaborate to understand new features, design and implement robust test automation frameworks, and continuously improve our automation processes. This assignment also requires you to work with Jr. QA members, where you will be responsible for guiding, mentoring, work planning, execution and review of your team. The role requires for the person to be pro-active, someone who can come up with new ideas and demonstrate learning new technology through implementation.
  
  
Your day-to-day tasks will involve planning, implementing and maintaining automation test suit that can run as part of CI/CD pipeline or as needed to cover regression and sanity scenarios. Conducting POCs/MVPs for new automation framework/tools and AI platform/tools. Identifying, documenting, and tracking bugs found during automation test runs. Leading the team of Jr. testers, perform code reviews, train, providing feedback.
  
  
To excel in this role, you should have a strong foundation in QA automation with a proactive, problem-solving approach. A deep understanding of software QA methodologies, combined with excellent communication skills, will enable you to lead effectively, develop and maintain a robust automation test suite, and provide insights on product quality trends. Strong programming expertise in Java and JavaScript, along with a solid grasp of SQL, is essential. Hands-on experience with Playwright is mandatory. Experience with AI tools, a history of successfully executing POCs, and a passion for continuous learning are essential. Additionally, knowledge of the Data Integration domain will be an added advantage.
  
  
**Key Duties Responsibilities**
As a Quality Assurance Team Lead, Individuals are expected to fulfil the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated QA solutions for CData’s application products, ensuring high-quality deliverables through robust test automation frameworks and reusable components.
* Collaborate closely with development and product teams to understand new features, define quality metrics, and ensure comprehensive test coverage across sprints and release cycles.
* Drive continuous improvement in automation processes by leveraging AI tools, open-source frameworks, and cloud-based test infrastructures.
* Oversee regression and performance testing, analyze test results, track defects, and report on overall product health and quality trends.
* Mentor and guide QA team members, perform code reviews, and promote best practices in software development in test (SDiT).
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and efficiency of automated tests through proactive management of test dependencies, environments, and CI/CD integration.
* Apply hands-on expertise in web application and data service testing, using modern tools such as Playwright, Cypress, RESTAssured, Docker, Jenkins/Drone/GitLab, and related QA technologies.

**Requirements - Knowledge, Skills, & Experience**

* Experience of 10-15 Years
* Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written)
* Should be excellent team player and must have ability to work independently and in a team.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills.
* Experience with creation, management & execution of automated test scripts, plans & suites and tooling such as Azure DevOps, Jira, XRay, Qase, or similar.
* Experience working with Playwright, XUnit, JUnit, Testing Library, Jest, Enzyme, Cypress or similar.
* Experience working with performance, load, and accessibility testing such as Artillery, JMeter or similar.
* Experience working in an Agile/Kanban development process.
* Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools (e.g., Github actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Travis CI).
* Experience with RESTful APIs and experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman).
* Experience with any AI tools, Claude or Co-Pilot are preferred

**Skills**

* Ability to lead from the front on technology and work execution.
* Fast learner, self-starter, should be proactive in trying new technology and processes.
* Ability to research and solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Ability to work collaboratively to promote the best practices in quality assurance.
* Proficiency in programming languages Java, TypeScript / JavaScript.
* Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Strong interpersonal skills including good written and verbal communication.

title: Lead Analyst - Master Data Management (MDM / Master Data Management))
description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Value Proposition:**
Shaping the Future of Enterprise Master Data Management within Enterprise Data & Analytics. Lead and strengthen MDM data consumption, quality, validation, and downstream reporting processes. Drive data integrity across Customer 360 / Reference 360 ecosystems while enabling high-quality, governed, and analytics-ready data for enterprise and regulatory consumption.
  
  
Contribute to the evolution of data culture by building and enhancing data infrastructure, reporting frameworks, optimizing data pipelines, Data remediation for Regulatory Reporting needs and mentoring teams on data storytelling and visualization best practices with advanced data technologies and experience.
  
  
**Job Details**

* Position Title: Lead Data Analyst – Enterprise Data & Analytics
* Career Level: P3
* Job Category: Manager
* Role Type: Hybrid
* Job Location: Bangalore
* Shift Timing - 2 pm - 11 pm

**About The Team**
This role operates within the
**MDM Data Management – Customer 360 / Reference 360 Programme**
, supporting enterprise-wide data consumption and downstream reporting. The team ensures that MDM golden records are accurately propagated across APIs, batch pipelines, Snowflake, and reporting layers.
  
  
The Lead Analyst plays a critical role in bridging
**data producers and consumers**
, ensuring that MDM data is reliable, well-documented, and aligned with business and regulatory expectations. Working collaboratively with cross-functional pod members, the Business Analyst will drive efficient workflows, optimize data systems, and support iterative delivery in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  
  
**Impact**
The P3 Junior MDM Analyst supports the analysis, validation, and documentation activities required to ensure that data flowing from MDM 360 (Customer 360 / Reference 360) into downstream systems is accurate, consistent, and fit for purposes.
  
  
This is an analyst — not a developer — role. Rather than building pipelines or writing production code, the Junior MDM Analyst interprets data flows, documents findings, validates data quality, supports requirements gathering, and assists with UAT and reconciliation reviews across consumption and reporting workstreams.
  
  
This role is an excellent entry point into MDM programme delivery, offering exposure to:
  
  
***MDM 360 → APIs / Batch → Snowflake → Financial Reporting → UI Consumption***
**Key Deliverables (Duties & Responsibilities)**

* MDM Data Understanding & Documentation
* Develop a working understanding of MDM golden record structures and how data flows from MDM 360 to downstream systems
* Document data flows, field mappings, and transformation logic under the guidance of the P4 Analyst or BA Lead
* Maintain and update data mapping registers, attribute lists, and business rule logs as requirements evolve
* Assist in maintaining the MDM data dictionary — recording field definitions, data types, and ownership
* Note and escalate data anomalies or gaps in documentation identified during analysis activities
* Data Validation & Quality Checking

Supporting validation across the consumption data flow — from MDM through to reporting:
  
  

* Run and review data validation checks across:

+ MDM golden records vs. API payload outputs
+ Batch pipeline outputs vs. expected source data
+ Snowflake consumption layer vs. MDM source records
+ UI-displayed data vs. MDM and Snowflake outputs

* Use SQL (with guidance) to query datasets, identify discrepancies, and validate attribute-level accuracy
* Apply data quality checks across key dimensions — completeness, accuracy, consistency — and document outcomes
* Log and track data quality issues in agreed tooling (e.g. JIRA, SharePoint, Excel trackers)
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact data discrepancies to the P4 Analyst or BA Lead promptly

* Downstream Reporting & Financial Data Support
* Support validation of MDM data used in financial and regulatory reporting layers
* Assist in reconciliation activities between:

+ MDM golden records and Snowflake reporting datasets
+ Reporting output and expected business values for key financial attributes and hierarchies

* Document reconciliation results clearly — noting matched records, mismatches, and volumes
* Assist in investigating data breaks and reporting discrepancies by gathering relevant data and preparing findings for P4 review
* Track and follow up on outstanding reconciliation items through to resolution
* Requirements Support & Analysis Documentation

Supporting the P4 BA in translating business needs into clear, documented requirements:
  
  

* Attend requirements workshops, take structured notes, and circulate agreed actions and decisions
* Assist in drafting user stories, acceptance criteria, and data mapping specifications under senior guidance
* Review and cross-check requirements documents for completeness, consistency, and alignment with MDM data standards
* Maintain up-to-date requirements logs and traceability matrices for the consumption workstream
* Raise questions and clarification points with the P4 Analyst when requirements are unclear or ambiguous
* API & Batch Pipeline Validation Support

**From An Analysis — Not Development — Standpoint**

* Review API payload structures (JSON) and validate that field mappings match agreed data specifications
* Use API testing tools (Postman, Swagger) under guidance to inspect responses and document findings
* Monitor batch job outcomes and validate data completeness and successful execution against expected results
* Log pipeline validation findings and assist in drafting defect descriptions for technical teams
* Track open pipeline issues through to resolution, providing status updates to the P4 lead
* UAT Support & Defect Tracking
* Support UAT activities across API, batch, Snowflake, and reporting validation scenarios
* Execute test cases defined by the P4 Analyst or BA Lead — validate data movement accuracy and business rule adherence
* Log defects clearly and completely in agreed defect tracking tools — including steps to reproduce, observed vs. expected results, and data evidence
* Track defects through to resolution and retest fixes as required
* Assist in preparing UAT summary notes and test evidence for sign-off activities

**Skills And Experience**
Analytical Skills
  
  

* Strong attention to detail — able to spot discrepancies in data across multiple systems
* Structured thinking and ability to organise findings clearly in written form
* Comfortable working with large datasets and identifying patterns, gaps, or anomalies
* Ability to ask the right questions and escalate issues appropriately

Data & Technical Acumen
  
  

* Intermediate SQL — able to write and run queries for data validation, comparison, and reconciliation (joins, filters, aggregations)
* Familiarity to some expertise in API concepts (REST/JSON) — able to read and interpret payloads with guidance
* Basic exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms (querying and exploring data)
* Understanding of data quality concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness
* Comfortable using tools such as Excel, JIRA, Confluence, Postman, or Swagger for analysis and tracking tasks

MDM & Data Knowledge
  
  

* Basic understanding of Master Data Management concepts — what MDM is, why golden records matter, and how data flows between systems
* Awareness of how downstream systems (Snowflake, reporting tools, UI applications) consume MDM data
* Exposure to Informatica Customer 360 / Reference 360 is a plus, but not required

Soft Skills
  
  

* Proactive learner — eager to build MDM and data analysis knowledge on the job
* Clear written communication — able to document findings, defects, and notes in a structured, readable format
* Reliable and organized — able to manage assigned tasks, track progress, and meet deadlines
* Collaborative team player — works effectively in an offshore delivery model with onsite and P4 colleagues
* Comfortable asking for help and working under senior guidance without needing full autonomy

**Technical Skills**

* Hands on experience in database connectivity, SQL Server / Dev, Oracle, Snowflake, Netezza, both on-prem and in cloud. And familiarity with ETL and data virtualization tools.
* Experience in MDM/360, API
* Good Knowledge or experience in Python, AI / ML , Data visualization tools like Power BI, Tableau

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field with 7-10 years’ experience
* Exposure to banking or financial services data environments
* Familiarity with Agile delivery — experience attending stand-ups, sprint reviews, or retrospectives
* Exposure to data reconciliation tasks in a reporting or analytics context
* Interest in or awareness of data governance, data cataloguing, or MDM frameworks

**What Good Looks Like in This Role**
**.**

* Data validation - Runs checks, logs results, flags mismatches

Root cause is unclear, or impact is high
  
  

* Reconciliation- Executes reconciliation steps, documents findings

Unexplained volume differences or systemic breaks
  
  

* Requirements - Takes notes, drafts user stories, checks completeness

Conflicting requirements or scope ambiguity
  
  

* Defect logging - Logs full defect detail, retests fixes

Defect is disputed or requires architectural decision
  
  

* UAT - Execute test cases, logs results

Business sign-off decisions or critical failures
  
  

* SQL queries- Writes and runs validation queries with guidance

Complex multi-system queries or performance issues
  
  
**Key Success Measures**

* Accuracy and completeness of data validation outputs and reconciliation documentation
* Quality of defect logs — clear, reproducible, and fully evidenced
* Timely escalation of data issues and discrepancies to P4 leads
* Reliable completion of assigned UAT test cases within sprint or release timelines
* Growing confidence and independence in SQL-based validation and data analysis tasks over time
* Positive feedback from Senior Leads on quality of support and documentation

**Role Positioning at a Glance**

* Primary Focus: Data validation, reconciliation support, and requirements documentation across MDM consumption workstreams
* Analyst — Not Developer: Interprets, documents, and validates data flows — does not build pipelines or write production code
* Key Strength: Attention to detail + growing MDM data knowledge + structured documentation and communication
* Supports: MDM Team, Senior, Juniors MDM Analysts and Product Lead across all consumption, Data Quality, Remediation and reporting workstreams

**Relationships & Collaboration**

* Reports to: Senior MDM Lead / Data Management Leadership
* Partners: Data Engineering, Operational/Reporting Teams, Data Stewards, Business Stakeholders, Senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

**Accessibility Needs**
We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations at any stage (e.g. application, interviews, onboarding) please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India) is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment and prohibit all forms of discrimination on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, economic status or any other characteristics protected by the law. We strive to foster a safe and respectful environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Our EEO policy ensures fairness throughout the employee life cycle.**

title: CPU Verification Infrastructure Tools Architect
description:
We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted - SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic & agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test-frameworks team.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL-simulations, c-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon.
* You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features.
* The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team.
* You would assess and build C-model or RTL-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre-silicon environment.

**What We Need To See**

* BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 5+ years of experience
* Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C++, Python.
* Understanding of SOC and System Architecture.
* Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt-engines, CPU, boot-devices, MMU/IOMMU function.
* Operating System and Device-Driver concepts and ability to write no-OS test frameworks - i.e tests that run directly on the bare-metal SOC.
* A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software.
* Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle.

**Way To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks.
* Exposure to Testbench architectures (C++ testbenches, SV/UVM based testbenches).
* Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
At Index Exchange, we’re reinventing how digital advertising works—at scale. As a global advertising supply-side platform, we empower the world’s leading media owners and marketers to thrive in a programmatic, privacy-first ecosystem.
  
We’re a proud industry pioneer with over 20 years of experience accelerating the ad technology evolution. Our proprietary tech is trusted by some of the world’s largest brands and media owners and plays a crucial role in keeping the internet open, accessible, and largely free.
  
We process more than 550 billion real-time auctions every day (in comparison, Google processes 8.5 billion searches per day) with ultra-low latency. Our platform is vertically integrated from servers to networks and runs primarily on our own metal and cloud infrastructure. This end-to-end infrastructure is designed to provide both stability and agility, enabling us to adapt quickly as the market evolves.
  
At the core of it all is our engineering-first culture. Our engineers tackle internet-scale problems across tight-knit, global teams. From moving petabytes of data and optimizing with AI to making real-time infrastructure decisions, Indexers have the agency and influence to shape the future of advertising. We move fast, build thoughtfully, and stay grounded in our core values.
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to serve as a technical leader and quality champion across Index. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad cross-team and cross-divisional influence where you will define and drive modern quality engineering practices, build scalable automation, tools, test infrastructure, and enable teams to deliver high-quality, high-performance software with confidence.
  
You will operate at the intersection of architecture, quality, developer experience, and operations, ensuring quality is built into every stage of the software lifecycle. You will also leverage AI to improve testing efficiency and insights.
  
As a SDET champion on the engineering team, you will own the vision for test infrastructures, build frameworks that allow developers to easily write reliable tests, and invent new mechanisms for ensuring that every change we make can be deployed safely and quickly. You will help solve our most difficult challenges and will coach other engineers to foster a culture of relentless high standards.
  
This position reports directly to Senior Engineering Manager based in Bangalore and will work closely with members of the Quality and Delivery teams.
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering/SDET role with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong software engineering skills, including proficiency in programming languages such as Golang, Java or C#.
* Proven experience building scalable, reusable, enterprise grade test frameworks, tools and infrastructure for large-scale distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD (GitLab preferred), Containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Experience with microservices architectures, APIs, and data-intensive systems, validating large datasets and pipelines.
* Deep expertise in test strategies, methodologies, and automation at scale.
* Have systems thinking and end-to-end accountability, proactively identifying risks and influencing cross-team quality without direct authority.
* Exceptional analytical skills and structured problem-solving to drive clarity and outcomes in ambiguous environments.
* A technical role model, guiding engineers and consistently raising the bar through design, reviews, and best practices.
* Proven ability to lead cross-team initiatives, align stakeholders, and drive engineering excellence at scale
* Demonstrates a learn-and-be-curious mindset, with a strong bias for ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement

**Here’s What You’ll Be Doing**
**Technical Leadership & Quality Strategy**

* Working on cutting edge programmatic ad tech that touches millions of users every single day.
* Collaborate with the Manager to define and evolve the quality engineering vision and strategy for Index’s high-scale distributed systems.
* Drive shift-left testing and quality-by-design principles, influencing system architecture for testability and reliability.
* Establish best practices across functional, integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing.
* Assess current practices, tooling, and workflows to identify gaps and translate them into actionable plans that balance impact, feasibility, and organizational readiness.
* Bring clarity to complexity, probing assumptions, identifying quality risks, evaluating trade-offs, and optimization opportunities.

**Test Frameworks, Tooling & Infrastructure**

* Design and build scalable, reusable automation frameworks and test infrastructure.
* Develop tools that enable teams to independently own, measure, and continuously improve quality.
* Enhance and optimize CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab) to ensure fast, safe, and reliable releases.
* Enable data validation, observability-driven testing, and production validation strategies.

**Cross-Team Influence & Developer Enablement**

* Partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, and DevOps teams to ensure high-quality releases by enforcing quality standards and best practices.
* Influence design and architecture decisions to improve scalability, performance, and testability.
* Identify systemic gaps and drive across engineering improvements in testing practices and tooling.
* Standardize quality metrics, reporting, and release quality gates across teams
* Drive improvements in production quality, incident reduction, and system resilience

**Mentorship, Coaching & Hiring**

* Mentor and coach engineers on test design, automation, tooling and quality best practices.
* Raise engineering standards through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* Actively participate in hiring and bar-raising activities.
* Foster a culture of ownership, learning, and high engineering standards.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Comprehensive health plans for you and your dependents .
* Paid time off, health days, and personal obligation days plus flexible work schedules
* Competitive retirement matching plans
* Equity packages
* Company contribution to Provident Fund
* Monthly internet stipend
* Generous parental leave available to birthing, non-birthing, and adoptive parents
* Annual well-being allowance plus fitness discounts and group wellness activities
* Employee assistance program
* Mental health first aid program that provides an in-the-moment point of contact and reassurance
* One day of volunteer time off per year and a donation-matching program
* Monthly town halls and regular community-led team events
* Multiple resources and programming to support continuous learning
* A workplace that supports a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment – learn more here

**Equal employment opportunity**
At Index Exchange, we believe that successful products are built by teams just as diverse as the audience who uses them. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunities. We celebrate diversity of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Additionally, we realize that diversity is deeper than any status or classification—diversity is the human experience. For those who show grit, passion, and humility—Index will welcome you.

If you require an accommodation, please share the details of your request and any information how we can assist you with the hiring recruiter when they contact you. Index Exchange will make reasonable efforts to ensure accommodation requests are met throughout the recruitment process.
  
**Index everywhere, Index anywhere**
Our corporate headquarters are in Toronto, with major offices in New York, Montreal, Kitchener, London, San Francisco, and many other global cities. As a major global advertising exchange, we are committed to operating as a tightly knit global team and embracing and empowering talent wherever our colleagues may be.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) or Electronics and Communication Engineering (E&C)

* Product lifecycle and business awareness

**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
***Job Family Definition:***
Set and maintain quality standards for company products through the use of systematic processes. Develops, modifies, and executes software test strategies, plans and suites. Analyzes and writes test standards and procedures. Maintains documentation of test results to assist in debugging and modification of software. Analyzes test results to ensure existing functionality and recommends corrective action. May develop tools and environments to automate test execution. Consults with development engineers in resolution of problems.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain system testbeds involving Mist Edge (L2TPv3/IPsec concentrator) along with switches, routers, and servers.
* Perform QA validation of Mist Edge datapath, tunneling, and security features.
* Validate end-to-end client-to-cloud architecture, including traffic flow across L2TPv3/IPsec tunnels.
* Recreate complex customer networking and datapath issues in lab environments and collaborate with US and Beijing Engineering teams for resolution.
* Work closely with CS teams to review customer-reported issues and enhance test coverage for real-world deployments.
* Create and manage bugs in Jira and drive closure with Engineering teams.
* Perform timely escalation of critical datapath, scale, or performance issues.
* Develop technical documentation for QA and CS teams in Confluence.
* Train and mentor Level 1/2 Engineers on advanced networking, tunneling protocols, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test creation, log analysis, and debugging workflows.
* Contribute to automation frameworks using AI-assisted code generation to improve test coverage, regression efficiency, and defect detection.
* Apply AI-assisted approaches for anomaly detection, traffic pattern analysis, and faster root cause identification.

**What You Need To Bring**

* BE/ME/MS in EE, CS, or related discipline.
* Strong understanding of low-level datapath and packet processing.
* Hands-on experience with L2TPv3 and IPsec (tunnel establishment, encapsulation, troubleshooting).
* Solid knowledge of Layer 2 Switching and Layer 3 Routing concepts (VLANs, DHCP, DNS, NAT, trunking).
* Experience with DHCP Relay, RadSec, and authentication flows.
* Working knowledge of multicast and service discovery protocols such as IGMP, MLD, and mDNS.
* Strong troubleshooting skills using packet captures (Wireshark/tcpdump) and log analysis.
* Ability to analyze and debug complex networking issues across control and data planes.
* Familiarity with automation frameworks and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot).
* Passion for solving customer issues in a fast-paced, highly technical environment.
* Ability to quickly and accurately assess and drive resolution of technical problems.
* Experience level: 10–15 years

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CWNA/CWSP/CWAP/CWNE Certified.
* Scripting in Python.
* Hands on experience on ISE/ClearPass.
* Basic knowledge of L2TPv3/IPsec.

**Accessibility**
HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
  
  
Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**
**Health & Wellbeing**
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
  
  
**Personal & Professional Development**
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
  
  
**Unconditional Inclusion**
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
  
  
**Let's Stay Connected**
Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

title: Sr Engineer Quality
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
  
  
Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
  
  
This role is to drive and implement a comprehensive test strategy using appropriate testing tools and techniques. This
  
  
role designs and delivers quality tests, automated data testing scenarios, may require development experience in python,
  
  
ETL, SQL and others. This role also facilitates knowledge transfers to other testers within the department.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* To work closely with BSAs and developers to understand and define the system requirements/acceptance criteria of user stories and upcoming features. To understand the impact of said software on other areas of the system. To identify gaps in the requirements.
* To identify the scope of testing including systems integration and regression testing. To apply test techniques to ensure coverage.
* To work with development to ensure a comprehensive and robust suite of automated tests from unit and integration tests to user journey tests.
* To identify data requirements to satisfy test cases and create and maintain test data.
* To ensure continuous exploratory/manual testing of each functional area/user story against different layers of the system such as the web service layer, user interface layer.
* to check outputs including screen, file, and database updates to ensure system effectiveness.
* To ensure comprehensive test strategies are in place for non-functional areas such as performance and load.
* To ensure processes used within the team meet quality standards and champion the use of new practices where appropriate.
* To discuss and review outputs produced by team members and ensure standards across the team are maintained.
* To demonstrate working functionality/user stories to the product owner and/or during team showcases.
* To provide input into user story points/estimates.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related experience
* Five plus years’ experience in a QA/Testing technical role.
* Proven track record of testing software developments in a structured environment.
* Experience of defect lifecycle and ability to advise on tests to put in place after fixes are made.
* Ability to work in a continually changing environment, adapting to changing requirements and priorities at short notice.
* Excellent understanding of test levels (from unit tests to UAT) and ability to advise the team on what to test (and what not to test) as part of a cohesive testing strategy.
* Ability to propose improvements on project practices and processes to improve effectiveness of the team and delivery of the software.
* Sound technical skills; understanding of high-level system architecture components such as application servers, databases, and web services.
* Understanding of basic programming constructs.
* Experience in one or more test frameworks and scripting automated functional tests.
* Good team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to interact and collaborate with people from development, business analysis, project management and SME disciplines.
* Experience working on user stories and defining clear acceptance criteria.
* Good experience in API and Microservices testing.
* Good experience in test frameworks and scripting automated functional tests.
* Experience with working in an AWS environment preferred
* Experience with creating test cases using GitHub copilot preferred
* Good experience in Accessibility and security testing will be a value add.
* Good experience in Functional Testing, End-to-End, Regression, and Smoke Testing tasks.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong sense of self-motivation, organization and attention to detail; strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to quickly comprehend project goals/requirements, identify gap/omissions and testing challenges/impediments
* Establish collaborative relationships with other teams to ensure success of project test phases
* Anticipate problems or issues that may arise, forecast high risk areas in software and drive resolution
* Provide timely and meaningful test result updates to management

title: TCMS Test Engineer
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for TCMS Test Engineer**
He/she manages validation and verification of all TCMS subsystems and components in line with make or buy strategy on the project
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Understanding the TCMS architecture of Rolling Stock platforms such as Metro and Locomotives and gaining domain knowledge of rolling stock business operations.
* 100% of TCMS requirements are covered by test.
* 100% TCMS requirements tests performed / all tests.
* On time delivery on all Verification & Test deliverables.
* Continuous improvement or REX management from previous projects.
* Level of application of standard methodologies and Processes: 100%
* 100% compliant with EHS rules (regarding activities performed on train and test bench).
* Management of TCMS validation and verification tools configuration.
* Delivery of TCMS test procedures & reports.
* Configuration Management of Verification & Test deliverables.
* Management of validation status of change requests (CR).
* Management of CR: all NOK results in test reports related to a CR
* Software quality of the vehicle control system (TCMS) by conducting tests in accordance with EN50716.
* Creating cross-project test specifications for tests in the laboratory and on the actual vehicle.
* Developing and maintaining Python-based scripts, tools, and automation frameworks to support laboratory and integration testing.
* Automating laboratory tests using Python to achieve continuous and repeatable test execution.
* Using Eclipse IDE for software integration tasks, source code navigation, debugging, log analysis, and verification of embedded TCMS applications.
* Carry out tests in accordance with specifications and document the results.
* In the event of deviations, clarify the causes with the developers.
* Further develop our existing test strategies and methods for your area of expertise and ensure the transfer of know-how between projects.
* Close collaboration with the software development engineers as well as with the software assessors.
* Together with the team plan and implement test automation

**Desired Skills**

* Successfully completed a technical degree in computer science, electrical engineering, railway engineering or a related subject.
* Alternatively, you have relevant technical vocational training supplemented by a technician's degree or several years of experience in testing embedded software in safety-related systems.
* Experience with test management and knowledge in agile software development is a plus.
* Practical knowledge of validation methods (boundary tests, equivalence class tests…).
* Practical knowledge of validation tools (model-based testing tools…).
* Practical knowledge of validation means (testbeds, simulators…).
* Hands-on testing experience in a vehicle or under lab conditions.
* Practical experience on software integration & validation phases as per EN 50657 or EN50716 (minimum of 4-5 years’ experience in Railway or Health, Defense, Aeronautical, Automative domains).
* Design for Quality (DFQ) cycle.
* Knowledge of safety critical software development and testing would be beneficial.
* Experience in Python for test automation, scripting, data analysis, and tool development.
* Hands-on experience using Eclipse IDE for software integration, debugging, and analysis of embedded systems.
* Strong interpersonal and communication abilities, with a focus on building relationships, providing constructive feedback, and fostering collaboration.
* Fluent in English and on B2-level in German language.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
This role is based in Bangalore. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
  
  
Find out more about mobility at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers #SL

title: Senior Test Engineer - FinOps & Cloud Infrastructure | 3 Years Experience | Immediate Joiners Only
description:
**About Company:**


NEXUS AIDC is advancing the next generation of intelligent data center operations through its AI-native Data Center Operating System. Our unified platform connects physical infrastructure, compute resources, AI workloads, and operational intelligence, enabling real-time visibility, predictive insights, and intelligent automation.As we expand our enterprise footprint, we continue to advance our platform capabilities to support increasingly complex AI infrastructure environments.

**Opportunity:**


We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on Senior Test Engineer (
**FinOps & Cloud Infrastructure**
) to drive quality assurance, automation, and validation of our infrastructure financial intelligence capabilities. The ideal candidate will combine strong software testing expertise with a solid understanding of data center infrastructure, cloud technologies, resource utilization, and cost economics. This role requires technical ownership, analytical depth, and the ability to validate complex infrastructure data, financial calculations, and optimization models within an enterprise-grade software platform.

**Responsibilities**

* Own functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing of FinOps and infrastructure cost management capabilities.
* Validate cost collection, allocation, chargeback/showback, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization recommendations.
* Test infrastructure usage and cost data across cloud, Kubernetes, CPU/GPU compute, storage, networking, power, and cooling systems.
* Verify pricing models, cost calculations, resource utilization metrics, financial projections, savings estimates, and reporting accuracy.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated API, UI, database, and data-validation tests integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Validate data ingestion, aggregation, reconciliation, and accuracy across multiple infrastructure and cloud data sources.
* Identify calculation discrepancies, data inconsistencies, integration defects, and performance issues.
* Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and Engineering teams to improve test coverage, reliability, and overall product quality.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing, quality assurance, and test automation.
* Strong expertise in API, UI, integration, database, and data-validation testing.
* Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Playwright, pytest, Postman/Newman, or equivalent frameworks.
* Strong understanding of data center and cloud infrastructure attributes, including compute, CPU/GPU utilization, memory, storage, networking, power consumption, cooling, capacity, resource allocation, and workload performance.
* Good understanding of FinOps principles, cloud financial management, pricing, billing, cost allocation, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP, including cloud resource metering, utilization metrics, and cost drivers.
* Ability to interpret and validate infrastructure telemetry, operational metrics, usage data, and their impact on cost calculations and optimization recommendations.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating complex datasets, numerical calculations, and analytical reports.
* Experience developing automated tests within CI/CD workflows.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities, with exceptional attention to numerical and financial accuracy.
* Ability to independently own testing deliverables and work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* FinOps Certified Practitioner certification or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience testing cloud cost management, billing, infrastructure management, or FinOps platforms.
* Familiarity with multi-cloud billing datasets, usage metering, cost allocation models, and infrastructure financial analytics.
* Exposure to AI/GPU infrastructure economics, power and cooling cost models, workload-based costing, and cost-per-unit calculations.

**Why Join NEXUS:**
Join a growing AI infrastructure technology company advancing intelligent and autonomous data center operations.Work alongside an experienced engineering team on sophisticated, real-world infrastructure challenges, contributing directly to product quality, financial accuracy, and enterprise platform reliability.

**How to Apply:**
Interested candidates must apply through the LinkedIn job posting and submit an updated resume highlighting relevant experience in test automation, data center or cloud infrastructure, and financial or data-intensive application testing. Candidates with demonstrable expertise in infrastructure data validation, automation, and cloud financial management will be prioritized.

title: Wireless Datapath Validation Engineer
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
  
  
**The Role**
AMD is seeking an experienced Wireless Datapath Validation Engineer to drive validation of next-generation wireless infrastructure and networking solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for validating high-performance datapath functionality, protocol compliance, performance, and reliability across silicon and system platforms.
  
  
You will work closely with architecture, design, firmware, and software teams to ensure robust product quality and customer readiness.
  
  
  
  
  
  
**THE PERSON:**
  
  
You have a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, digital design, and verification in general. You are a team player who has excellent communication skills and experience collaborating with other engineers located in different sites/timezones. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are willing to learn and ready to take on problems.
  
  
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
  
  

* Develop and execute validation plans for wireless datapath and networking features.
* Validate packet processing, traffic management, QoS, buffer management, and congestion handling.
* Validate O-RAN, eCPRI, Ethernet, and timing-related features.
* Drive post-silicon bring-up, debug, and root-cause analysis across hardware, firmware, and software layers.
* Execute performance, stress, scalability, and reliability testing.
* Develop automation frameworks, regression suites, and validation infrastructure.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution and improve product quality.
* Work closely with the customer on regular basis to enable them with our products

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**
  
  

* 8+ years experience in validation, networking, wireless communications, or embedded systems.
* Strong understanding of wireless systems, 4G/5G architectures, and O-RAN ecosystems.
* Experience with Ethernet, eCPRI, QoS, PTP/IEEE 1588, TCP/IP, and networking protocols.
* Hands-on experience with silicon bring-up, protocol debugging, and system-level validation.
* Proficiency in Python, Linux, and test automation development.
* Experience with traffic generators, protocol analyzers, Wireshark, and performance benchmarking tools.
* Exposure to FPGA, emulation, or post-silicon validation environments is a plus.

  
  
**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**
  
  

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

Nice to Have

**Responsibilities**

description:

It is comprised of three industry-leading businesses which, combined, provide end-to-end solutions across the investment lifecycle.
  
  
**Overview Of The Lead Associate, Quality Assurance And Engineering**
BETA is a self-clearing securities processing platform that supports critical back office, middle office, and front office capabilities for wealth management firms. Built on years of expert knowledge and hands-on experience, BETA provides critical back-office controls including corporate action management, middle office exception management, and front office account management and trading tools for advisors.
  
  
We’re seeking a Lead Associate, Quality Assurance and Engineering to join one of our Scrum teams and help shape how quality and automation scale across customers facing financial platforms. This role goes beyond test execution, you’ll influence test strategy, automation standards, and quality gates, while owning the end-to-end quality of your team’s deliverables. You’ll partner closely with developers, product owners, and fellow QEs to ensure our solutions are reliable, maintainable, and ready to scale.
  
  
Reporting to the Manager, Technology Development, you’ll be embedded within a team, supporting data‑centric platforms and services built on Snowflake, focused on large‑scale data ingestion, transformation, and downstream integrations. As part of our global Quality Engineering organization, you’ll help expand and stabilize our automated testing capabilities while working in a hybrid model alongside teams based in Bangalore, India.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities of the Lead Associate, Quality Assurance and Engineering:**
**Quality & Test Strategy**

* Own the overall quality of your team’s deliverables across functional, integration, and regression testing
* Review product requirements and design effective test plans, scenarios, and test cases with clear traceability
* Partner with stakeholders to define testing scope, inputs/outputs, and quality expectations
* Apply risk-based thinking to prioritize high value test coverage and release confidence

**Focused Testing**

* Design and execute data quality tests across Snowflake and data warehouses/data lakes.
* Hands-on in dealing complex SQL queries to validate Data completeness, consistency and Business rule enforcement.
* Test ETL/ELT pipelines that load data into Snowflake (batch and/or near‑real‑time). Validate: Incremental vs full loads, Late-arriving data handling, Schema changes and backward compatibility.
* Validate API responses against data persisted in both onprem and Snowflake.
* Build and maintain automated test suites for REST API testing and validation against non-snowflake data sources.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) to provide fast, actionable feedback
* Execute and support testing activities including functional, integration, regression, and UAT support

**Continuous Improvement**

* Troubleshoot failures end-to-end across automation code, environments, test data, and application defects
* Passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, and participating in technology communities.

**Skills and Experience of the Lead Associate, Quality assurance and Engineering:**

* 5+ years of experience testing complex web-based applications.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* Strong understanding of testing methodologies including functional, regression, negative, integration, and system testing.
* Strong SQL expertise (advanced joins, window functions, aggregations).
* Hands-on experience testing Snowflake (or similar cloud data warehouses). Experience testing data warehouses and/or data lakes.
* Solid understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data pipelines.
* Experience testing APIs using industry standard tools (e.g., Postman, ReadyAPI, or Rest APIs).
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) used for data processing. Experience validating large datasets and high‑volume data loads.
* Solid fundamentals in debugging, triage, and root cause analysis, including pipeline failures
* Strong collaboration and communication skills within Agile/Scrum environments.

**Nice to Have**

* Software testing certification.
* Knowledge of data modeling concepts (fact/dimension tables, star schemas).
* Experience across multiple automation stacks or languages.
* Exposure to AI assisted testing or automation acceleration (e.g., improving test design, maintenance, or failure triage using AI)
* Prior experience in financial services / data-heavy domains.

title: Senior Fraud QA and Enablement Analyst
description:
We are seeking a
**Fraud Operations QA & Enablement analyst**
to join our 24×7 fraud operations function and help protect our customers through rigorous quality standards, transaction auditing, and operational enablement.
  
  
You will serve as the quality anchor and "connective tissue" of our fraud team. You won't just be clearing alerts; you will drive high decision standards across the entire function. Your mission is to establish and maintain robust QA frameworks, ensure every analyst makes high-quality, compliant decisions, and turn audit insights into actionable training, SOP updates, and process improvements
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Quality Assurance & Auditing (Primary Focus): Perform regular, comprehensive audits of analyst transaction decisions, risk scores, and case notes to ensure consistency, accuracy, and strict adherence to compliance standards.
* Root-Cause & Pattern Analysis: Analyze QA audit data to identify recurring decision errors, knowledge gaps, and emerging fraud typologies, transforming findings into actionable team insights.
* Calibration & Coaching: Lead regular quality calibration sessions for the team and provide constructive feedback and targeted coaching to analysts to elevate decision quality.
* Knowledge Architecture & SOPs: Own and maintain the central "Source of Truth" (Knowledge Base) for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), updating guidelines based on QA findings and evolving fraud tactics.
* Training & Onboarding: Design and deliver onboarding modules for new hires and ongoing "delta training" to address quality trends and process updates.
* Process Excellence & System Gap Analysis: Monitor team-wide quality metrics and SLAs. Act as a feedback loop between Operations and Product/Engineering to fix system limitations causing manual error or security risks.
* Operational Visibility: Aggregate and report QA scores, error trends, and compliance metrics to provide leadership with clear visibility into operational health.

What We’re Looking For

description:
**About Chargebee**

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.

Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

**About the Team**

Our AI Products team builds Chargebee Copilot and other product experiences that bring Chargebee’s AI Agents platform to real users. We turn the platform’s agents, tools, and APIs into products people use every day, from the backend services and APIs that power them to the interfaces on top. We care about good conversational experiences and about giving people the tools to configure and improve how an AI agent behaves.

**About the role (Job Summary)**

We’re looking for an AI Quality Engineer to own the quality of our AI-powered products and agents throughout their lifecycle. Unlike traditional QA, AI systems aren’t deterministic, so they need continuous evaluation before release and ongoing improvement based on real-world usage. You’ll make sure our AI delivers accurate, reliable, high-quality experiences by designing effective evaluations, validating new capabilities, analyzing production behavior, and driving improvements across the AI stack. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding why AI systems behave the way they do and is passionate about improving AI products through evidence, experimentation, and engineering collaboration.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, review, and improve AI evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and regression suites, ensuring coverage reflects real customer scenarios, edge cases, and expected user behavior
* Validate new AI capabilities before they are released to customers, and continuously improve evaluations and release criteria
* Monitor AI quality in production using customer feedback, sampled conversations, telemetry, and quality metrics
* Perform root cause analysis to understand why AI interactions succeed or fail, classifying issues across prompts, retrieval, tool usage, model behavior, workflows, product knowledge, and application logic
* Identify recurring quality patterns and recommend engineering improvements
* Convert production learnings into evaluation cases to prevent future regressions
* Partner with Engineering, Product, and Support to improve prompts, agent workflows, retrieval systems, tools, and evaluation frameworks
* Define and track AI quality KPIs, and measure the impact of improvements using benchmarks and production metrics

**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)**

* Strong analytical and investigative mindset with excellent problem-solving skills
* 2+ years of experience
* Ability to identify root causes rather than symptoms
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills
* Comfort working with APIs, logs, structured data, and technical systems
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams
* Passion for building high-quality AI products

**Nice to have (preferred)**

* Experience in QA, SDET, Technical Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Product Analysis, or AI/ML applications
* Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, AI agents, or AI evaluation frameworks
* Experience designing evaluation datasets, benchmarks, or testing strategies
* Basic programming or scripting skills (Python, SQL, JavaScript, etc.)

**Benefits we offer**

At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. Our commitment to supporting our employees is universal, while our benefits are thoughtfully designed to meet the unique needs of each region. We offer comprehensive packages that generally include:

* Health & Wellness: Robust coverage and access to programs to support your physical and mental well-being.
* Financial Security: Initiatives to help you build long-term financial stability.
* Work-Life Balance: Flexible options and resources to help you thrive both professionally and personally.

At Chargebee, we believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences is not a “good-to-have” but a “must-have” as it strengthens us as a company and as individuals. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.*

description:

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. As a SAP Functional Testing Manager you will lead client support testing efforts within our Software and Product Innovation practice, guiding the planning and delivery of testing activities that help validate SAP solutions before they move into production. As a Manager you will lead teams, coach junior staff, manage client accounts, and take ownership of workstreams while applying sound judgment, business knowledge, and a practical approach to quality, timelines, and deliverables. In this role at PwC, you will oversee test strategy, coordinate issue tracking, review results, and help shape clear reporting that supports informed decisions across complex SAP programs.

* Leading SAP functional testing workstreams across client engagements and coordinating deliverable timelines with project leads
* Managing testing plans, estimates, and execution activities for functional, systems integration, regression, and user acceptance testing
* Directing teams in the creation, review, and maintenance of test cases, test scripts, defect logs, and testing documentation
* Overseeing defect triage, root cause review, and retesting activities to support timely resolution across release cycles
* Applying quality engineering methods and testing tools to assess application functionality, integrations, and business process performance
* Coaching junior staff on testing methods, issue tracking, and documentation standards while providing clear review feedback
* Evaluating system changes, process impacts, and business requirements to identify testing risks and coverage gaps

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 8 years of experience

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Graphic Design, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Mathematics
* Demonstrating SAP functional testing leadership across client engagements
* Managing test planning, execution, and defect triage activities
* Driving quality engineering improvements through automation and process design
* Coaching teams on UAT, regression, and systems integration testing
* Translating business needs into clear test scenarios and deliverables
