**About Autonomize AI**
Autonomize AI is on a mission to help organizations make sense of the world's dark data. Unstructured data contains critical insights that, when paired with human context, unlock transformative business outcomes. Our goal is to make that process effortless and accessible.
  
  
We are an ambitious, global, remote team committed to human-machine collaboration. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who have successfully scaled multiple venture-backed companies. We combine expertise in building cutting-edge data products, captivating user experiences, and scaling enterprise AI solutions.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a seasoned, strategic
**QA Manager**
with
**12+ years of experience**
to build, scale, and govern our quality engineering and software release ecosystem.
  
  
In this dual-impact leadership role, you will define and execute the overall QA strategy while taking end-to-end ownership of delivery schedules, CI/CD release governance, and cross-functional release management. You will manage and mentor a team of high-performing SDETs and QA Engineers, ensuring our enterprise AI products are delivered predictably, securely, and with uncompromised quality.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Quality Engineering & Leadership**

* Strategic QA Leadership: Define, own, and execute the global QA vision, quality metrics (KPIs/OKRs), and long-term testing roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Team Governance & Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-caliber team of SDETs and QA engineers; drive continuous learning and establish engineering best practices.
* Automation & ML Testing: Oversee the architectural strategy for scalable, robust test automation frameworks (Web UI, API, Data Pipelines, and Machine Learning/AI model testing).
* Enterprise Quality Assurance: Drive shift-left testing methodologies, security/compliance validations, performance/load testing, and overall dark-data pipeline reliability.

**Delivery & Release Management**

* End-to-End Release Management: Own the release lifecycle for multi-tenant and enterprise AI deployments—managing release cadence, risk assessments, scope stability, and go/no-go decisions.
* CI/CD Pipeline Governance: Collaborate closely with DevOps and Engineering to integrate automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, enabling smooth, repeatable, zero-downtime deployments.
* Cross-Functional Delivery Alignment: Act as the central liaison between Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Leadership to ensure delivery timelines are met without compromising quality.
* Incident & Risk Management: Establish post-release verification protocols, track production issues, lead root cause analyses (RCA), and implement preventive measures to continuously elevate delivery reliability.

**You’re a Fit If You Have**

* Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in Software Quality Engineering, with 5+ years in a manager or leadership capacity.
* Release & Delivery Expertise: Proven track record in release management, release governance, and orchestrating complex deployment cycles for enterprise SaaS/Cloud platforms.
* Technical & Automation Mastery: Deep expertise in building/architecting test automation frameworks using Python, Selenium, PyTest, Cypress, or similar tools, along with API testing (Postman, REST Assured).
* AI/ML & Data Platform Exposure: Demonstrated experience testing data-intensive applications, unstructured data processing pipelines, or Machine Learning/AI platforms.
* CI/CD & DevOps Integration: Hands-on familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Process & Agile Leadership: Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery models, test management systems (Jira, Xray/Zephyr), and tracking key quality metrics (Defect Escape Rate, Test Coverage, Release Cycle Time).
* Communication & Executive Presence: Outstanding stakeholder management, problem-solving skills, and the ability to articulate quality/release risks to technical and non-technical leaders alike.

**What We Offer**

* Influence & Impact: Shape the core quality and delivery strategy for enterprise AI implementations.
* Outsized Opportunity: Join at an influential level in a rapidly scaling, VC-backed startup.
* Ownership & Autonomy: End-to-end ownership of QA and release processes with the freedom to innovate.
* Learning & Growth: Constant exposure to serial founders, cutting-edge AI technologies, and a dedicated professional development budget.

* exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
* supporting global initiatives and modernizing business critical systems
* being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business
* joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes.

**Why this role exists:**

The Associate Test Analyst supports the Supply Chain Technology team by driving quality assurance and testing activities across core software applications. Operating within the Technology function, this role ensures software-based solutions, such as Blue Yonder and related enterprise supply chain platforms, are rigorously tested and validated before deployment into production.

Working closely with project teams, functional analysts, developers, and business stakeholders, the Associate Test Analyst helps prevent defects, verifies functional requirements, and streamlines testing workflows. Through the application of both automated and structured manual testing practices, the role protects system stability and enables seamless technology delivery across Officeworks' supply chain capability.

**Where you will make a difference:**

**In this role you will:**

**Test Strategy and Execution:**

* Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and test scripts based on system functional requirements and business processes.
* Perform software-focused functional, integration, regression, and system testing across core supply chain applications such as Blue Yonder.
* Prepare accurate, high-quality test data aligned with solution designs and specific test case scenarios.
* Support developers and functional analysts during unit testing and early-stage defect identification.

**Test Automation and Continuous Improvement:**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test scripts for software applications to increase test coverage and efficiency.
* Evaluate software testing tools to enhance automation frameworks and decrease release cycle times.
* Identify continuous improvement opportunities across software QA methodologies and release control processes.

**Defect Management and Reporting:**

* Identify, document, and track software defects through to successful resolution using enterprise defect management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Work closely with technical, functional, and third-party vendor teams to communicate defect severity and accelerate bug resolution.
* Deliver clear testing status reports and progress updates to project teams and IT management.

**User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Business Support:**

* Support business UAT testers during larger project rollouts by facilitating test environment readiness and defect tracking.
* Lead and coordinate UAT execution on smaller application releases and targeted functional updates.
* Assist in delivering solutions training and guidance to end-users prior to final deployment sign-off.

**Release Control and Deployment Verification:**

* Participate in release control checkpoints when application changes transition from build environments to test cycles.
* Execute production verification testing during post-deployment phases and hyper care support periods.
* Escalate risks or technical blockers that could impact release schedules, application quality, or project budgets.

**Who you will be working with:**

* Internal IT Delivery Teams: Collaborate with Supply Chain Functional Analysts, Developers, and Test Leads to align software testing cycles with delivery milestones.
* Internal Business Partners: Work directly with Supply Chain business operational teams and end-users to guide User Acceptance Testing and validate functional requirements.
* Quality Assurance Community: Partner with cross-functional QA peers across Officeworks Technology to share best practices and automation standards.
* Third-Party Software Vendors: Liaise with external application support and vendor consulting resources (e.g., Blue Yonder, SAP) to manage integration defect resolution.

**What success looks like:**

* Software Quality and Reliability: High-quality software deployments delivered with minimal post-production defects across Supply Chain Tech applications.
* Automation Efficiency: Incremental growth in automated test coverage for regression suites, reducing manual testing effort and cycle times.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong collaborative relationships with business stakeholders and IT delivery teams, ensuring smooth UAT execution.
* Timely Issue Escalation: Swift identification, logging, and escalation of testing risks and defects to prevent schedule delays.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**How you will lead:**

**Individual Contributor:**

* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviors
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behavior
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

**Our Values:**

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviors and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities.

**We begin with customer:**

* We start with our customer’ needs in every decision.
* We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions.
* We listen, learn and continuously improve.

**We do the right thing:**

* We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet.
* We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust.
* We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide.

**We execute with accountability:**

* We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes.
* We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters.
* We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes.

**We lead with ambition:**

* We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform.
* We are courageous with new ideas.
* We focus on transformation, not incremental steps.

**Qualifications and work experience:**

**Essential:**

* Education: Tertiary degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum 5+ years of dedicated software testing experience across manual and automated testing methodologies.
* Automation Capabilities: Proven experience creating and executing software automation test frameworks using industry-standard tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar).
* **Supply Chain**
  Software Context: Working knowledge or experience testing Enterprise Supply Chain/WMS/TMS software platforms (e.g., Blue Yonder / JDA, SAP, or similar).
  **Koerber HighJump, Manhattan WMS, SAP S/4 HANA**
* System SDLC Knowledge: Solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) within Agile and Waterfall delivery frameworks. Hands on testing operational experience, with exposure DC/ CFC environment.
* Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking software (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM, Confluence). Qtest
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to liaise effectively across technical and business stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Industry Experience: Prior testing experience within Retail, Omnichannel, or Supply Chain Logistics environments.
* Quality Certification: ISTQB foundation or advanced software testing certification.
* Integration Testing: Hands-on experience testing middleware integrations, APIs (Postman/REST), and complex enterprise data flows.

description:
**Meet the Team**
The Cisco IOS XR Routing and BNG Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco’s carrier-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end validation across Layer 2, Layer 3, routing, subscriber-management, and network-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, and web-scale customers operating some of the world’s largest and most demanding networks.
  
  
Our team values technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing and Broadband Network Gateway capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system-level failures, and provide data-driven release recommendations.
  
  
Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and troubleshooting workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and implement functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high-availability tests for IOS XR routing and BNG features.
* Validate BNG subscriber technologies, including IPoE, PPP, PPPoE, DHCPv4/DHCPv6, DHCP relay, Prefix Delegation, RADIUS, AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, subscriber policies, and session lifecycle management.
* Test Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies such as Ethernet, VLAN, QinQ, LACP, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, Segment Routing, L2VPN, L3VPN, EVPN, ECMP, BFD, QoS, and high-availability mechanisms.
* Develop reusable and scalable test automation using Python and frameworks such as pyATS, Genie, or equivalent tools.
* Build and maintain physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud-based test environments using Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, clustering technologies, VMware, OpenStack, and network simulation platforms.
* Validate control-plane, forwarding-plane, subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, software upgrade, rollback, process restart, route churn, and subscriber churn scenarios.
* Troubleshoot complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system-resource data.
* Validate model-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing.
* Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation.
* Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output.
* Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product-quality risks and release readiness.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field.
* 4 to 8 years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering.
* Strong knowledge of BNG architecture and subscriber-management technologies, including PPP/PPPoE, DHCP, RADIUS, AAA, accounting, and subscriber session management.
* Comprehensive understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, including TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, and MPLS.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system.
* Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting.
* Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability test scenarios.
* Strong Linux or Unix skills and experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Working experience of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools.
* Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices.
* Strong knowledge of software development life cycle.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing BNG and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, or NCS 5500/5700.
* Experience with traffic generators and subscriber-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent.
* Knowledge of advanced BNG features, including subscriber QoS, dynamic policy activation, etc.
* Experience with L2VPN, EVPN, telemetry, and network programmability.
* Familiarity with scale and performance characterization.
* CCNP Service Provider, CCIE Service Provider, DevNet Professional, or equivalent technical knowledge.

description:

Are you passionate about aviation safety and mission-critical systems?

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

**What You Will Do:**

* Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures.
* Ensure bi-directional requirements traceability from aircraft-level safety objectives down to implementation artifacts.
* Configure and manage Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), System Integration Labs (SIL), and automated test environments.

* Generate objective evidence and traceability matrices to support SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits and FAA/EASA certification.

* DO-178C: Executing high-level/system-level software integration tests.
* DO-254: Verifying complex electronic hardware behavior at the system and LRU levels.
* DO-330: Defining Tool Operational Requirements and validating automated verification toolchains.
* DO-356A: Testing system vulnerabilities and verifying airworthiness cybersecurity architectures.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or related fields.
* 3+ years of hands-on avionics testing and integration experience in a certified program.
* Proficiency in Requirements Management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion).
* Experience with test automation scripting (Python, C/C++) and aviation data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX, MIL-STD-1553B).
* A proven track record of generating certification artifacts for regulatory audits.

**communications@qubistsolutions.com**
with the subject line "Aerospace Testing Engineer - [Your Name]".

title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
The
**Senior AI Evals Test Engineer**
is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the
**Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks**
. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including
**adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement**
. The engineer will
**design scalable evaluation pipelines**
, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is
**70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing**
, and sits within the
**Applied AI: Test Engineering team**
as a key technical authority.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build agent evaluation frameworks — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
* Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)
* Build golden datasets and test harnesses — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
* Establish eval-as-a-service — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
* Automate regression and drift detection — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
* Define eval taxonomies and rubrics — establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
* Instrument production observability — build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
* Benchmark and select models — run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
* Analyze and interpret evaluation results, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
* Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies — functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
* Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
* Evaluate new technologies and patterns (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
* Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
* Provide technical leadership to engineers, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
* Collaborate cross-functionally — work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

**Required Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
* 2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
* 2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy, quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
* 1+ years in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

**Technical Skills**

* Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
* Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns — tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
* Production experience with eval pipelines — building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
* Proficiency in Python — strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
* Statistical literacy — ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
* Enterprise product sensibility — understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
* Excellent communication — ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

**Tech Stack**

* Languages: Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
* Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright
* LLM Providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
* Eval Tooling: DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses
* Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries: LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators
* Infrastructure:DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment
* Data Analysis: Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results
* Policy Background: Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development
* Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools: Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures
* Experience testing complex APIs, especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows
* Experience with prompt injection (Must) and data poisoning skills is a plus
* Certifications in AI/ML, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning.AI specializations and software testing methodologies

**Soft Skills**

* Proven ability to lead without direct authority, influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy.
* Experience working in agile environments, collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills, comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders.
* Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

title: SW Engineer - Test Systems Development
description:

title: Sr. Engineer – Pen Tester
description:
**About Us**
Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Penetration Tester is a critical member of the Application Security team, focused on identifying, validating, and resolving security vulnerabilities across our cloud infrastructure and applications. You will lead technical security assessments, including application-layer and network-layer penetration testing, to ensure all information assets are secured against evolving threats. This role is vital for maintaining our security posture and ensuring remediation efforts are effectively prioritized and executed.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Perform comprehensive manual and automated application-layer penetration tests to identify vulnerabilities, adhering to industry standards and internal methodologies.
* Conduct network-layer penetration tests encompassing all components supporting network functions and operating systems.
* Validate segmentation and scope-reduction controls at least annually and after any significant changes to ensure isolation of the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE).
* Triage and validate vulnerabilities reported through bug bounty program.
* Document and risk-rate all findings, providing actionable remediation guidance to engineering and product teams.
* Verify the correction of exploitable vulnerabilities through re-testing and post-remediation assessments.
* Collaborate with external 3rd party security firms on penetration testing and threat hunting exercises.
* Ensure all security assessments and remediation activities meet compliance and regulatory obligations (e.g., PCI DSS, SOC).

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, ethical hacking, or application security engineering.
* Deep understanding of common web-based attacks (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, XXE, etc.) and how to mitigate them at the application level.
* Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, Ruby, or Bash to automate security tasks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of network protocols and security concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, and IPSEC.
* Strong experience with security testing tools (e.g., BurpSuite Enterprise, SAST, DAST, and IAST).
* Working knowledge of OWASP security fundamentals and API identity/access management (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT).
* Ability to work with high autonomy and communicate technical security findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Relevant information security certification(s) such as OSCP, CEH, OSWE, or CISSP.

**Bonus Qualifications**

* Direct experience managing or triaging a public bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, BugCrowd).
* Experience leveraging Slack/ChatOps to automate security tasks or reporting.
* Experience with cloud orchestration and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Google Deployment Manager).
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tooling like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC2, or CCPA.

title: Network System Test Engineer (Manual/Solution)
description:
**Company Description**
**Arista Networks**
is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You’ll Work With**
You will work with software development engineers, hardware engineers, field support engineers, product managers, and software test engineers to analyse customer requirements and use cases, gather technical details, create software test plans, and validate that the product meets our customer’s requirements. You will also work with our customer support and engineering teams to help address escalated customer issues by reproducing, and debugging those in the lab.
  
  
The role will provide opportunities to create real impact in the rapidly growing Cloud IT services, and virtualization technologies.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Arista Networks is looking for world-class Software Test Engineers (aka System Test engineers) to help us in building the highest quality networking products. If you love networking. If working on complex & scaled out network topologies makes you excited.
  
  
If you like to challenge yourself to find the hard-to-find bugs and if troubleshooting & debugging network and system problems gives you a thrill, this role is tailor made for you.
  
  
At Arista, you’ll bring your intelligence, creativity, and drive every day & work with our products exactly how they are going to be used by our end customers and while doing so, make sure that the products are going to work every time.
  
  
Your job is to find the hard bugs, the ones not easily exposed by the developers’ automated unit and product level tests. You will NOT spend your time running manual regressions of mind numbing, 1000 page test plans, because Arista’s developers automate all the basic functional and integration tests.
  
  
Courtesy our super collaborative work environment, you’ll spend your time embedded deeply with multiple engineering teams, working side by side with the developers, POC engineers, account teams, working together as one team and do all of it to help us to explore, find and fix software problems before they can reach the customers. We take quality seriously and we invite you to be a champion of software quality!!
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience & Education: BE/ B.Tech/ME/ M. Tech with networking industry experience.
* Proven expertise in creating test methodologies and writing test plans.
* Strong knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, IGMP, PIM SM/SSM, QoS, L2-L3 protocols, Platform validation, HA, QOS, network management.
* Experience with IXIA and/or Spirent test tools desired.
* Work with the developers on your team in creating their plans for automated tests to complement the exploratory testing that you perform.
* Participate in functional specification and software design reviews held by your team and provide customer centric input.
* Work in a highly productive environment along with best of the engineers on Linux platform that cuts a typical development cycle by order of magnitude with a laser focus towards quality.
* Use every means possible to find the bugs in the software and/or hardware being developed by your team.
* Write test plans to validate Arista features and products.
* Design test network topologies to validate functionality, performance, stability and scalability of features and products.
* Execute test plans to verify all aspects of the product. Identify defects and validate resolution.
* Work as an agile member of a combined development and test team, running in short cycles to develop functional software in quick iterations.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

title: Senior AI QA Engineer
description:
**Opportunity**
As a Senior AI QA Engineer, you will go beyond traditional functional testing. You will be responsible for building the framework that ensures our clinical insights are accurate, safe, and reliable. This role requires a unique blend of high-level software testing and data engineering to validate complex, non-deterministic medical outputs using a hybrid of automated grading methodologies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect Multi-Layered Validation Frameworks: Design and implement structured testing strategies that combine deterministic checks, semantic similarity metrics, and model-based evaluations.
* Automated Model Grading: Develop systems to evaluate clinical pipeline outputs for faithfulness, safety, and hallucination detection using various automated scoring techniques (e.g., BERTScore, ROUGE, or custom heuristics).
* Vibe-Driven Development: Leverage agentic AI tools to rapidly prototype complex test harnesses, "red-team" clinical logic, and build internal validation utilities at high velocity.
* Data Pipeline Integrity: Execute integration and regression tests for data-heavy backend processes, ensuring medical data remains consistent from ingestion to insight generation.
* Collaborative Strategy: Work closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to define "Ground Truth" datasets and clinical evaluation rubrics.
* Root Cause Analysis: Deep-dive into complex system failures to identify whether issues stem from code logic, data drift, or model behavior.

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of technical experience in Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on system architecture and backend data validation.
* Advanced Python Proficiency: Expert-level skills in Python for building custom test scripts and working within AI/ML ecosystems.
* AI/ML Validation Experience: Proven experience testing model outputs using diverse metrics (e.g., Semantic Similarity, NLP metrics, and custom scoring algorithms). Familiarity with tools like LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or MLflow.
* Vibe Coding Mastery: Proficiency with AI-native development tools such as Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code.
* Modern Automation Stack: Proficiency with frameworks like PyTest, and experience with traditional tools (Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium) for end-to-end flows.
* API & Data Testing: Solid understanding of API testing (Postman/RestAssured) and database validation (SQL/NoSQL).
* Strategic Thinking: Experience serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on test process development for large-scale systems.

**Preferred (Good To Have)**

* Clinical Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as FHIR, HL7, or SNOMED CT.
* Healthcare Compliance: Understanding of HIPAA regulations and the nuances of handling ePHI/PHI.
* Statistical Foundation: Understanding of sensitivity, specificity, and F1-scores in a clinical context.

**About GW RhythmX**
GW RhythmX is revolutionizing healthcare through connected, AI-native intelligence that unites clinical insight, patient engagement, and system-wide care orchestration. The company combines market-leading AI precision care technology with extensive trusted patient engagement leadership to help health systems deliver the right care, at the right time, through the right clinician and channel. Its solutions are deployed across more than 150 health systems, touching more than 85M patients including 8M U.S. military veterans.

A SymphonyAI Group company, GW RhythmX leverages various firm assets, including $1B+ in R&D investment, longitudinal data related to 300 million patients, 4.4 billion total annual claims, and 1.8 million healthcare professionals at more than 3,000 facilities globally.
  
  
GW RhythmX is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age or veteran status.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the delivery of high‑quality software through a combination of manual and automated testing practices. This role works closely with Development, Product, DevOps, and Delivery teams to validate functionality, improve test coverage, identify defects early, and continuously enhance the quality of products and platforms. The QE contributes to test strategy, builds automation frameworks, and helps foster a culture of quality throughout the engineering organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Test Planning & Strategy**

* Collaborate with Product Owners and Developers to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and system behaviour.
* Participate in story refinement to ensure testability and clear acceptance criteria.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and regression suites.
* Contribute to the overall QA strategy, including test coverage goals, automation priorities, and risk-based testing.

**Functional & Non‑Functional Testing**

* Implement functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
* Validate API responses, UI behaviour, workflows, and data integrity across environments.
* Perform non‑functional testing such as performance, usability, or basic security validation as needed.
* Ensure defects are clearly documented, reproducible, and communicated effectively.

**Test Automation Development**

* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites using modern automation frameworks.
* Create and execute automated regression tests for UI, API, and service layers.
* Partner with Developers and DevOps to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with Developers to understand architecture, code changes, and risk areas.
* Collaborate with DevOps to ensure environments, data, and pipelines support effective testing.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies, defect triage, and release readiness activities.

* Advocate for quality throughout the SDLC and promote shift‑left testing.

**Release & Production Support**

**networking and cloud/application layers**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Network Management Testing**

* Test end-to-end workflows for cloud-managed Access Points, Switches, Routers and other network devices.
* Validate device onboarding, discovery, provisioning and configuration.

* Validate configuration synchronization between cloud and network devices.

* Validate firmware/software upgrade workflows.
* Test remote configuration and management capabilities.
* Validate device connectivity, disconnect/reconnect and recovery scenarios.
* Test multi-device, multi-site and large-scale network management scenarios.
* Validate behavior under network failures, latency, packet loss and intermittent connectivity.

**Test Planning & Quality Ownership**

* Review requirements, user stories, functional specifications and technical designs.
* Review ERDs and data models to understand relationships, dependencies and data flows.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews from a QA perspective.
* Identify functional, integration, data, networking and cloud risks.
* Develop test strategy, test plans, test scenarios and test cases.
* Define test scope, coverage, environments, dependencies and execution timelines.
* Create positive, negative, boundary, failure-recovery and end-to-end scenarios.
* Maintain requirements-to-test-case traceability.
* Review test cases and ensure adequate coverage.

**Test Execution**

* Execute functional, integration, system, regression and end-to-end testing.
* Perform cloud-to-device and device-to-cloud testing.
* Test networking devices together with cloud services and applications.
* Validate APIs, backend services, database state and UI behavior as part of end-to-end workflows.
* Perform interoperability and compatibility testing.
* Execute testing across different network configurations and connectivity conditions.
* Analyze failures across device, network, cloud and application layers.

**API & Cloud Testing**

* Validate API request/response, authentication, authorization and business logic.
* Test APIs used for device provisioning, configuration, monitoring and management.
* Validate data consistency between APIs, cloud services, database and UI.
* Test asynchronous workflows, events, notifications and service-to-service communication.
* Test AWS-hosted cloud applications and services.
* Validate cloud services, microservices and distributed workflows.
* Analyze cloud logs, metrics, traces and application telemetry.
* Test reliability, availability, scalability and failure/recovery scenarios.
* Validate deployments across QA, staging and production environments.

**Networking Expertise**

**Experience With**

* TCP/IP
* IPv4 / IPv6
* DHCP
* DNS
* ARP
* ICMP
* HTTP/HTTPS
* TLS/SSL
* NAT
* Routing
* Switching
* VLAN
* QoS

* Wi-Fi technologies

* Wireshark
* tcpdump
* ping
* traceroute
* iperf
* nslookup/dig

**Device → LAN/WLAN → WAN/Internet → Cloud → API → Backend → Application**

**Test Automation**
**Python**

* Strong hands-on experience developing Python-based test automation.
* Build automation for APIs, cloud workflows and network management functionality.
* Develop reusable test frameworks, libraries and utilities.
* Automate device onboarding, configuration, monitoring and management scenarios.
* Build regression automation for high-value customer workflows.
* Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines.
* Analyze automation failures and improve framework reliability.

**TypeScript / Playwright**

* Develop end-to-end UI + API automation.

* Collaborate with development, cloud, firmware and networking teams.

* Expertise in test strategy execution, complex test scenario design, test data management, and quality gates.
* Strong defect analysis, root cause support, release validation, and risk-based testing skills, with a technical mentoring capability.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and continuous improvement, with familiarity in AI-assisted test analysis.
* Experience driving QA across enterprise ecommerce releases, integrations, and production cutovers in an Agile delivery model.

description:

title: Data Test Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Data Test Analyst**
**Job Description**
This role offers an excellent opportunity for a Junior Test Analyst to build a career in a leading global financial services environment. You will support the full testing lifecycle for regulatory, control, and functional changes, ensuring systems and reports are accurate, reliable, and audit-ready. Working closely with technology and business stakeholders, you will help design and execute test cases, manage defects, and support user acceptance testing to enable highquality delivery across complex financial products and platforms.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Review business and functional requirements to understand the scope of change, regulatory and control impacts, and downstream dependencies.
* Support test preparation by helping to design, document, and maintain comprehensive test cases and scripts that provide full coverage and clear traceability to requirements and controls.
* Assist in building structured test plans, including defining execution schedules, identifying required environments, and setting clear entry and exit criteria.
* Execute system, functional, and regression test cases accurately and consistently, ensuring results are recorded in a clear and standardized manner.
* Log defects with detailed, reproducible steps, data conditions, and expected versus actual results, enabling efficient investigation and resolution.
* Maintain uptodate defect logs, track defect status through the full lifecycle, and participate in defect triage sessions to help prioritize and clarify issues.
* Liaise with technology teams to clarify defects, validate fixes, and retest once remediation is deployed, ensuring issues are fully resolved before release.
* Capture, organize, and file test evidence in line with governance standards so that all testing activities are auditready and fully versioncontrolled.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles by coordinating execution with business users, responding to testing queries, and consolidating UAT results and signoffs.
* Contribute to validating control outputs, exception reports, and regulatory reporting changes from a testing perspective to ensure compliance and control effectiveness.
* Work methodically and proactively, escalating risks or issues in a timely manner, particularly where they may impact tight regulatory or release timelines.
* Collaborate with crossfunctional teams, including change delivery, technology, and business stakeholders, to ensure alignment on testing scope, coverage, and outcomes.

**Essential Skills**

* Experience in testing, quality assurance, or change delivery within financial services, ideally 2 to 5 years, or equivalent internship exposure.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and change lifecycle, including user acceptance testing (UAT) support and release processes.
* Handson experience executing structured system, functional, and regression test cases in a controlled environment.
* Proficient use of test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
* Disciplined defect lifecycle management, including clear logging, classification, tracking, and retesting of issues.
* Ability to interpret business and functional requirements and translate them into test conditions, test cases, and expected results.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline, with a focus on traceability and maintaining auditready evidence.
* Comfort working with data sets, including validating calculations and checking report outputs for accuracy and completeness.
* Awareness of regulatory and control requirements and how they influence test coverage, test design, and evidencing.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise test documentation and defect descriptions.
* Organized and methodical working style, with the ability to manage multiple testing activities and meet tight deadlines.

**Additional Skills & Qualifications**

* Exposure to global markets or trading environments and associated fronttoback workflows, such as trade capture, risk, and reporting processes (preferred but not essential).
* Experience supporting testing in complex financial products or regulatory reporting initiatives.
* Familiarity with structured quality assurance practices and governance frameworks in large organizations.
* Masters degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with crossfunctional teams across technology, operations, and business functions.
* Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement of test processes, tools, and documentation.

**Work Environment**
You will work in a large, global financial services organization that operates across multiple countries and markets. The environment emphasizes strong governance, regulatory compliance, and robust control frameworks, requiring thorough documentation, traceability, and auditready testing evidence. You will use industrystandard test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, or Zephyr, and work closely with technology and business stakeholders across the full change lifecycle. The culture promotes continuous professional development, flexible working arrangements where possible, and opportunities for career growth within an inclusive and diverse environment. The organization values collaboration, respect, and the contribution of every team member, fostering a workplace where different perspectives are encouraged and performance is recognized.

title: Risk Assurance Advisor - Technology Control Testing (1LOD)
description:
**About Us**
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Quality Assurance Advisor plays a key role in strengthening first\-line control testing and quality assurance capability, maturity, and consistency across a defined business portfolio.
   

  

 This role supports the delivery of meaningful insights into control effectiveness, risk exposure, and non\-compliance. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the Advisor contributes to the continuous uplift of control testing practices by translating enterprise risk standards into practical testing approaches, quality benchmarks, and reporting expectations.
   

  

 The role is instrumental in supporting assurance activities that deliver clear, prioritized insights, enabling effective escalation, informed decision\-making, and timely business\-owned remediation. It also contributes to embedding specialist risk and control capabilities, standards, and practices that help the business deliver safe, compliant, and high\-quality outcomes.
   

  

 Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**What will your day look like?**
 As a Quality Assurance Advisor, you will
   

  

* Support the continuous improvement of control testing methodologies, frameworks, templates, and quality standards.Ensure testing activities are performed
* consistently and in line with approved methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to enhance testing through data\-driven techniques and automation.
* Conduct and support control testing and assurance activities to assess control effectiveness and compliance with policies and standards.
* Review testing outcomes and identify control weaknesses, process gaps, and emerging risks.
* Perform root cause analysis and provide recommendations to strengthen controls and improve business outcomes.
* Support targeted reviews and deep dives based on risk exposure and assurance priorities.
* Translate testing outcomes into meaningful risk insights and reporting.
* Support governance forums through assurance reporting and risk\-based recommendations.
* Escalate material control issues, non\-compliance, and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
* Monitor remediation activities and validate sustainable closure of actions.
* Partner with business, risk, compliance, and control stakeholders to improve risk awareness and control effectiveness.
* Provide constructive challenge and support business teams in understanding testing outcomes and remediation requirements.
* Promote a consistent understanding of first\-line control testing expectations and risk management practices.
* Contribute to the ongoing uplift of testing, assurance, and governance practices.
* Share knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices across teams.
* Demonstrate strong risk culture behaviors, including integrity, independence, accountability, and evidence\-based decision\-making.


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring:
   

  

* 5\-8 years of Experience in Control Testing, Quality Assurance, Risk Assessment, Compliance Monitoring, Audit, or Operational Risk within a regulated environment.
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, control taxonomies, and enterprise risk management standards.
* Knowledge of business process controls, control design principles, and first\-line risk management responsibilities.
* Demonstrated ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness through testing, root cause analysis, and evidence evaluation.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, evaluate risk, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Experience identifying control gaps, process weaknesses, and compliance issues.
* Exposure to assurance methodologies, risk management systems, testing tools, and reporting platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the confidence to challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
* Excellent planning, prioritization, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex risk concepts to diverse audiences.

title: Sr, Digital Quality (SAP)
description:
**Purpose of this position :** 




 Position in a global environment, responsible for defining, governing and continuously advancing the Digital Quality ecosystem across ZEISS Vision Care/ ZEISS COM. The role owns the Digital Quality strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment between Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Business Functions, e.g. Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and IT.
 



 Responsible for leading digital quality initiatives, including the Quality work package within the international implementation of SAP S/4HANA and the integration of multiple eQMS and digital platforms (e.g., Polarion, Salesforce, Veeva, eDMS \[OpenText etc.]). The role focuses on defining, harmonizing and optimizing business processes within a Digital Quality ecosystem, considering system interfaces, AI\-enabled solutions, Prompt Governance, data governance and advanced analytics (reports, dashboards) across multiple manufacturing and distribution sites as well as headquarters. The incumbent acts as the global business lead for Digital Quality capabilities and is ac\-countable for ensuring that digital platforms, AI\-enabled quality solutions and quality data architectures support business objectives while maintaining regulatory compliance, data integrity and audit readiness.
 



**Primary duties and responsibilities** 




**Digital Transformation** 



* Actively participate in all activities required for the implementation of digital compliance systems impacting business processes (primarily SAP S/4HANA, including interfaces to other systems such as Polarion, Salesforce, and other eQMS platforms)
* Lead the Quality Management (QM) work package within the global SAP S/4HANA implementation project
* Analyze newly defined and existing S/4HANA processes for feasibility in high\-volume, highly regulated environments
* Collaborate with functions and business units to Identify requirements
* Aligning requirements with global quality representative’s prior implementation
* Implement changes within the digital compliance process landscape
* Map end\-to\-end processes and system interfaces, identifying risks, including process efficiency and compliance risks
* Support global rollout activities, including system validation and testing of SAP use cases
* Troubleshoot post\-implementation issues and recommend feasible, compliant solutions
* Work autonomously to gather required information and collaborate with relevant stakeholders
* Act proactively, deriving conclusions and driving decisions based on limited or incomplete information
* Ensure timely and effective communication with all relevant stakeholders
* Support additional activities as required by line management
* Own the Quality Management digital compliance transformation Quality Plan, roadmap and related governance activities
* Define target\-state Digital Quality process architectures and system integration concepts
* Lead cross\-functional Digital Quality transformation initiatives across regions and sites
* Drive harmonization and standardization of quality processes globally
* Process Ownership of CSV / CSA, User Access Control
* Ensure business ownership, adoption and sustainability of implemented Digital Quality solutions
* Support prioritization of Digital Quality investments and resource allocation in alignment with business priorities



**Digital Quality Strategy \& Governance:** 



* Own and continuously develop the global Digital Quality Strategy
* Define and maintain the Digital Quality roadmap aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements
* Establish governance models for Digital Quality initiatives, systems and processes
* Prioritize Digital Quality projects and transformation activities based on business value, risk and compliance impact
* Act as business owner for the Digital Quality portfolio and strategic initiatives
* Define Digital Quality standards, principles and minimum requirements across ZEISS Vision Care
* Provide recommendations regarding Digital Quality investments, capabilities and technology opportunities
* Ensure alignment between Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Business Functions and IT



**AI \& Digital Quality Innovation** 



* Identify and drive opportunities for AI\-enabled quality improvements (e.g., automation, predictive quality, AI agents and intel\-ligent workflows)
* Support the creation, training and deployment of AI agents to enhance quality processes and decision\-making
* Establish and maintain governance for AI\-enabled quality solutions
* Own Prompt Governance and Prompt Lifecycle Management for quality\-relevant AI applications
* Define standards for prompt development, validation, documentation, monitoring and continual improvement
* Maintain approved prompt libraries and quality\-specific AI instructions
* Ensure traceability, auditability and version control of prompts and AI\-generated outputs
* Define validation requirements for AI\-enabled solutions and support implementation of risk\-based controls
* Ensure AI\-based solutions comply with regulatory, quality and data governance requirements
* Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation within the Digital Quality landscape
* Drive adoption of Generative AI capabilities, advanced analytics and intelligent automation within Quality processes



**Data Governance :** 



* Define and implement data governance standards for quality\-relevant data across SAP, eQMS, and interfacing systems
* Ensure data integrity, consistency, and traceability across the digital ecosystem
* Define data ownership, data flows, and lifecycle management for quality data
* Monitor and mitigate data\-related risks impacting compliance and business processes
* Own Quality Data Governance standards across Digital Quality platforms
* Define Quality Data ownership, stewardship and accountability models
* Lead development of the Quality Data Strategy supporting analytics, reporting and AI\-enabled decision making
* Establish standards for quality\-related master data management
* Drive implementation of quality dashboards and advanced reporting capabilities
* Ensure availability of quality\-relevant data for digital transformation initiatives



**Portfolio Management \& Vendor Governance** 



* Own the Digital Quality application, project and initiative portfolio
* Support budget planning and investment prioritization for Digital Quality initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and their applicability within Digital Quality
* Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with Digital Quality solution providers
* Support vendor selection, performance evaluation and governance activities for Digital Quality platforms and related services
* Monitor portfolio performance and realization of business benefits



**Quality Management System** 



* Review and provide feedback on global Quality work package documentation and implementation processes to ensure compliance with the Quality Management System and ISO 13485, MDSAP, NMPA requirements
* Create and maintain QMS documentation (procedures, work instructions, digital process documentation) required for compliance and successful system implementation in context with CSV/CSA
* Ensure alignment of digital systems with regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 13485, MDR, GxP, FDA 21 CFR)
* Support QMS team in additional digital quality\-related activities e.g. AI Agent implementation as required by line management.



  





**Key Data** 




**1\. Leadership accountability** 




 provides functional and disciplinary leadership for Digital Quality initiatives, Digital Quality champions, business process owners and cross\-functional project teams within a global matrix organization across sites, regions and functions. Leads the Digital Quality community through governance structures, influence leadership and strategic alignment of priorities.
 



**2\. Supervisory dimension** 



* CSV/CSA Manager
* Digital Data Solution Managers
* SAP Quality Expert (BPO Regulatory Compliance)



**3\. Key relationship/customers** 



* Global SAP S/4HANA and digital transformation project stakeholders
* QMS team member
* Functions and business units across manufacturing and distribution sites, and headquarters
* Owners/users of interfacing systems (e.g., Polarion, Salesforce, eQMS platforms)
* IT, Digital, and Data Governance teams
* Key interfaces/liaison/functional guidance within the organization: Global Management Systems, Manufacturing/Operations, IT, Quality, Business Units, Sites, HQ



**4\. Key interfaces/functional guidance within ZEISS group** 



* Identification of process gaps and definition of required changes within project timelines
* Successful implementation and adoption of digital quality systems
* Data integrity and compliance across systems
* Efficiency improvements through digitalization and automation
* Audit readiness and regulatory compliance



**5\. Key data / KPIs** 



* Digital Quality Roadmap Delivery
* SAP Quality Work Package Milestone Achievement
* Global Process Harmonization Progress
* eQMS, eDMS, RIMSYS Deployment and Adoption
* Data Integrity Metrics
* AI Solution Adoption and Effectiveness
* Prompt Validation Compliance Rate
* User Account (Licence) in use, not in use
* Quality Automation Benefit Realization
* Digital Audit Readiness
* User Adoption and Training Effectiveness
* System Standardization Metrics



**Education / Professional Certification** 



* Academic degree (Bachelor or higher) in Quality Management, Engineering, IT, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field



**2\. Experience** 



* 5\+ years of experience in digital quality, SAP S/4HANA, or eQMS implementation in a global environment
* Experience as SAP superuser, especially in QM\-related processes
* Experience with eQMS platforms (e.g., VEEVA, Trackwise, or similar)
* Experience with RIM platforms (e.g. IQVIA; RIMSYS)
* Experience to connect automated processes (IT \+ OT)1 to other systems and operations and leverage collective analytics and learnings to continuously improve system autonomy
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in regulated Quality Management Systems (ISO 13485 preferred)
* Experience to define and implement AI Agents (CoPilot), automation, or digital innovation projects is an ad\-vantage



**3\. Knowledge / Skills / Other characteristics** 



* Language: Fluent in English (spoken and written); German is a plus
* Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA, particularly in manufacturing environments
* Experience in integrating multiple digital systems and managing interfaces
* Knowledge of Quality Management Systems and regulatory frameworks (ISO 13485, MDR, GxP, FDA 21 CFR)
* Knowledge of quality tools and methods (e.g., CAPA, incoming inspection, recalls, quarantine, control plans)
* Experience in data governance, data structures, data lifecycle management, and analytics\-driven decision making
* Knowledge of AI concepts, including AI agent creation, Prompt Engineering, and AI Governance frameworks
* Experience in mapping complex business processes in high\-volume, regulated environments
* Experience in business process improvement (Six Sigma is a plus)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive conclusions from incomplete or ambiguous information
* Proven ability to work independently with excellent communication and organizational skills
* Proven ability to troubleshoot digital system implementation issues
* Experience in Digital Transformation, Digital Strategy Development, and governance of digital platforms and
* enterprise applications
* Experience in business ownership of enterprise quality systems
* Strong stakeholder management and influence leadership skills
* Experience in portfolio management and prioritization within global organizations

description:
**Company Description**
 Renesas is a global semiconductor company providing hardware and software solutions for a range of cutting\-edge technologies including self\-driving cars, robots, automated factory equipment, and smart home applications. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
   

  

 Renesas is a global, multi\-billion dollar, publicly traded company headquartered in Japan, and has subsidiaries in 20 countries worldwide. Renesas is a dynamic, multi\-cultural technology company where employees learn, mentor, innovate and thrive. Renesas is extending our share in fast\-growing data economy\-related markets such as infrastructure and data center and strengthening our presence in the industrial/IOT and automotive segments. Our solutions drive products developed by major innovators around the world. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Full PE product lifecycle ownership from concept to end of life with a focus on ensuring the delivery of the highest quality products to our end customers
   

  

* Definition of ATE test, qualification and manufacturing plans
* Product release into manufacturing with adherence to stringent tier 1\-customer requirements
* Datasheet and automotive compliance reports
* Real time customer support for design, product and quality related issues
* Temperature/Voltage/Process characterization and production limit setting
* Product new product introduction and yield ownership
* Product BOM release and maintenance
* Excursion management for both suppliers and customers
* Use commercially available yield tools for yield improvement and monitoring, generate weekly reports and review with PE teams

* PAT, SYL, SBL, SPC limit and disposition optimizations to protect quality without excessive waste

* Experience with common lab test equipment (DC power supply, oscilloscope, multi\-meters etc). Bench characterization experience is a plus

* Experience in yield management tools such as PDF Exensio, JMP. Apply statistical analysis to isolate the issue and make data\-driven decisions
* Ability to managing supplier excursions and customer escalations through problem solving
* Knowledge of Semiconductor Failure Analysis is preferable
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* A good team player. Effective in fast paced, dynamic work environment


**Qualifications**
* BS in Electrical/Electronic Engineering

 With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power\-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘
 **To Make Our Lives Easier** 
 .’
   

  

**At Renesas, You Can**
* Launch and advance your career in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.

 Join Renesas. Let’s

description:

**Why this role is important to us**
 Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes — we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future\-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement.
   

  

**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
 Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI \& Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front\-to\-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go\-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.

We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. * Self\-driven delivery with the ability to produce quality outcomes with minimal follow\-up.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, especially in documentation.
* A collaborative mindset and comfort working with senior subject\-matter experts and global stakeholders.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

title: Silicon Validation Manager
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states.
   

  

 At Waymo, we are designing the custom compute platform that runs the Waymo Driver, powering millions of rider\-only trips and navigating over 100 million miles on public roads. When you are deploying custom silicon for safety\-critical physical systems, the responsibility is great. You need absolute correctness, exhaustive coverage, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement. To achieve this, the Waymo Compute team is scaling worldwide. In this role you will shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration by guiding the validation of a cutting\-edge SoC.
   

  

*This role is primarily in\-office and reports to Head of Silicon.*
**You Will**
* As a Silicon Validation Manager, you will lead the group focused on post\-silicon validation of custom ML SoCs. You will set strategy and coordinate resources, planning, and execution for the team.
* You will strategize, review, and execute test plans for silicon systems and subsystems. You will own silicon bring\-up, new product introduction (NPI), and sustaining efforts. You will serve as the central coordination point between your team and systems teams, including hardware, software, manufacturing, and supply chain. You will also manage relationships with vendors and contract manufacturers.
* You will verify that silicon meets functional and performance requirements and own qualification, characterization, and deliverables for post\-silicon, including interfaces, compute cores, power, and performance. You will debug issues, suggest fixes, and ensure silicon meets quality and reliability requirements throughout the entire product life\-cycle.


**You Have**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in silicon bring\-up and validation and/or product characterization as a product development engineer.
* 5\+ years of experience managing a silicon development team and leading post\-silicon projects, including planning, execution, and team formation, mentorship, and coordination.
* Experience as a manager or technical leadership for new product introduction in custom silicon.
* Proficiency with Firmware development, C\+\+, and Python.
* Experience with lab equipment and debug tools, such as oscilloscope, protocol analyzer, JTAG debugger, etc
* Ability to work effectively within cross\-functional and cross\-site teams, strong communication and documentation capability.


**We Prefer**
* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Experience with the entire silicon development life\-cycle related to Silicon Validation, architecture and design requirements, DFx features, tapeout, planning and readiness for post\-silicon, and execution of post\-silicon.
* Experience bringing silicon to high\-volume manufacturing and sustaining programs.
* Experience in direct Silicon design or verification, and understanding of SystemVerilog.

Actual starting pay will be based on job\-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.
